1.zh: 以法莲山地的拉玛·琐非有一个以法莲人，名叫以利加拿，是苏弗的玄孙，托户的曾孙，以利户的孙子，耶罗罕的儿子。
1.en: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim Zophim, of the hill country of Ephraim, and his name was Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephraimite.

1.zh: 他有两个妻：一名哈拿，一名毗尼拿。毗尼拿有儿女，哈拿没有儿女。
1.en: He had two wives. The name of one was Hannah, and the name of the other Peninnah. Peninnah had children, but Hannah had no children.

1.zh: 这人每年从本城上到示罗，敬拜祭祀万军之耶和华；在那里有以利的两个儿子何弗尼、非尼哈当耶和华的祭司。
1.en: This man went up out of his city from year to year to worship and to sacrifice to the LORD of Armies in Shiloh. The two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, priests to the LORD, were there.

1.zh: 以利加拿每逢献祭的日子，将[祭肉]分给他的妻毗尼拿和毗尼拿所生的儿女；
1.en: When the day came that Elkanah sacrificed, he gave portions to Peninnah his wife and to all her sons and her daughters;

1.zh: 给哈拿的却是双分，因为他爱哈拿。无奈耶和华不使哈拿生育。
1.en: but he gave a double portion to Hannah, for he loved Hannah, but the LORD had shut up her womb.

1.zh: 毗尼拿见耶和华不使哈拿生育，就作她的对头，大大激动她，要使她生气。
1.en: Her rival provoked her severely, to irritate her, because the LORD had shut up her womb.

1.zh: 每年上到耶和华殿的时候，以利加拿都以双分给哈拿；毗尼拿仍是激动她，以致她哭泣不吃饭。
1.en: So year by year, when she went up to the LORD’s house, her rival provoked her. Therefore she wept, and didn’t eat.

1.zh: 她丈夫以利加拿对她说：「哈拿啊，你为何哭泣，不吃饭，心里愁闷呢？有我不比十个儿子还好吗？」
1.en: Elkanah her husband said to her, “Hannah, why do you weep? Why don’t you eat? Why is your heart grieved? Am I not better to you than ten sons?”

1.zh: 他们在示罗吃喝完了，哈拿就站起来。祭司以利在耶和华殿的门框旁边，坐在自己的位上。
1.en: So Hannah rose up after they had finished eating and drinking in Shiloh. Now Eli the priest was sitting on his seat by the doorpost of the LORD’s temple.

1.zh: 哈拿心里愁苦，就痛痛哭泣，祈祷耶和华，
1.en: She was in bitterness of soul, and prayed to the LORD, weeping bitterly.

1.zh: 许愿说：「万军之耶和华啊，你若垂顾婢女的苦情，眷念不忘婢女，赐我一个儿子，我必使他终身归与耶和华，不用剃头刀剃他的头。」
1.en: She vowed a vow, and said, “LORD of Armies, if you will indeed look at the affliction of your servant and remember me, and not forget your servant, but will give to your servant a boy, then I will give him to the LORD all the days of his life, and no razor shall come on his head.”

1.zh: 哈拿在耶和华面前不住地祈祷，以利定睛看她的嘴。（
1.en: As she continued praying before the LORD, Eli saw her mouth.

1.zh: 原来哈拿心中默祷，只动嘴唇，不出声音，因此以利以为她喝醉了。）
1.en: Now Hannah spoke in her heart. Only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard. Therefore Eli thought she was drunk.

1.zh: 以利对她说：「你要醉到几时呢？你不应该喝酒。」
1.en: Eli said to her, “How long will you be drunk? Get rid of your wine!”

1.zh: 哈拿回答说：「主啊，不是这样。我是心里愁苦的妇人，清酒浓酒都没有喝，但在耶和华面前倾心吐意。
1.en: Hannah answered, “No, my lord, I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit. I have not been drinking wine or strong drink, but I poured out my soul before the LORD.

1.zh: 不要将婢女看作不正经的女子。我因被人激动，愁苦太多，所以祈求到如今。」
1.en: Don’t consider your servant a wicked woman; for I have been speaking out of the abundance of my complaint and my provocation.”

1.zh: 以利说：「你可以平平安安地回去。愿以色列的　神允准你向他所求的！」
1.en: Then Eli answered, “Go in peace; and may the God of Israel grant your petition that you have asked of him.”

1.zh: 哈拿说：「愿婢女在你眼前蒙恩。」于是妇人走去吃饭，面上再不带愁容了。
1.en: She said, “Let your servant find favor in your sight.” So the woman went her way and ate; and her facial expression wasn’t sad any more.

1.zh: 次日清早，他们起来，在耶和华面前敬拜，就回拉玛。到了家里，以利加拿和妻哈拿同房，耶和华顾念哈拿，
1.en: They rose up in the morning early and worshiped the LORD, then returned and came to their house to Ramah. Then Elkanah knew Hannah his wife; and the LORD remembered her.

1.zh: 哈拿就怀孕。日期满足，生了一个儿子，给他起名叫撒母耳，[说]：「这是我从耶和华那里求来的。」
1.en: When the time had come, Hannah conceived, and bore a son; and she named him Samuel, saying, “Because I have asked him of the LORD.”

1.zh: 以利加拿和他全家都上示罗去，要向耶和华献年祭，并还所许的愿。
1.en: The man Elkanah, and all his house, went up to offer to the LORD the yearly sacrifice and his vow.

1.zh: 哈拿却没有上去，对丈夫说：「等孩子断了奶，我便带他上去朝见耶和华，使他永远住在那里。」
1.en: But Hannah didn’t go up, for she said to her husband, “Not until the child is weaned; then I will bring him, that he may appear before the LORD, and stay there forever.”

1.zh: 她丈夫以利加拿说：「就随你的意行吧！可以等儿子断了奶。但愿耶和华应验他的话。」于是妇人在家里乳养儿子，直到断了奶；
1.en: Elkanah her husband said to her, “Do what seems good to you. Wait until you have weaned him; only may the LORD establish his word.” So the woman waited and nursed her son until she weaned him.

1.zh: 既断了奶，就把孩子带上示罗，到了耶和华的殿；又带了三只公牛，一伊法细面，一皮袋酒。（那时，孩子还小。）
1.en: When she had weaned him, she took him up with her, with three bulls, and one ephah of meal, and a container of wine, and brought him to the LORD’s house in Shiloh. The child was young.

1.zh: 宰了一只公牛，就领孩子到以利面前。
1.en: They killed the bull, and brought the child to Eli.

1.zh: 妇人说：「主啊，我敢在你面前起誓，从前在你这里站着祈求耶和华的那妇人，就是我。
1.en: She said, “Oh, my lord, as your soul lives, my lord, I am the woman who stood by you here, praying to the LORD.

1.zh: 我祈求为要得这孩子；耶和华已将我所求的赐给我了。
1.en: I prayed for this child, and the LORD has given me my petition which I asked of him.

1.zh: 所以，我将这孩子归与耶和华，使他终身归与耶和华。」 于是在那里敬拜耶和华。
1.en: Therefore I have also given him to the LORD. As long as he lives he is given to the LORD.” He worshiped the LORD there.

2.zh: 哈拿祷告说： 我的心因耶和华快乐； 我的角因耶和华高举。 我的口向仇敌张开； 我因耶和华的救恩欢欣。
2.en: Hannah prayed, and said, “My heart exults in the LORD! My horn is exalted in the LORD. My mouth is enlarged over my enemies, because I rejoice in your salvation.

2.zh: 只有耶和华为圣； 除他以外没有可比的， 也没有磐石像我们的　神。
2.en: There is no one as holy as the LORD, for there is no one besides you, nor is there any rock like our God.

2.zh: 人不要夸口说骄傲的话， 也不要出狂妄的言语； 因耶和华是大有智识的　神， 人的行为被他衡量。
2.en: “Don’t keep talking so exceedingly proudly. Don’t let arrogance come out of your mouth, for the LORD is a God of knowledge. By him actions are weighed.

2.zh: 勇士的弓都已折断； 跌倒的人以力量束腰。
2.en: “The bows of the mighty men are broken. Those who stumbled are armed with strength.

2.zh: 素来饱足的，反作用人求食； 饥饿的，再不饥饿。 不生育的，生了七个儿子； 多有儿女的，反倒衰微。
2.en: Those who were full have hired themselves out for bread. Those who were hungry are satisfied. Yes, the barren has borne seven. She who has many children languishes.

2.zh: 耶和华使人死，也使人活， 使人下阴间，也使人往上升。
2.en: “The LORD kills and makes alive. He brings down to Sheol and brings up.

2.zh: 他使人贫穷，也使人富足， 使人卑微，也使人高贵。
2.en: The LORD makes poor and makes rich. He brings low, he also lifts up.

2.zh: 他从灰尘里抬举贫寒人， 从粪堆中提拔穷乏人， 使他们与王子同坐， 得着荣耀的座位。 地的柱子属于耶和华； 他将世界立在其上。
2.en: He raises up the poor out of the dust. He lifts up the needy from the dunghill to make them sit with princes and inherit the throne of glory. For the pillars of the earth are the LORD’s. He has set the world on them.

2.zh: 他必保护圣民的脚步， 使恶人在黑暗中寂然不动； 人都不能靠力量得胜。
2.en: He will keep the feet of his holy ones, but the wicked will be put to silence in darkness; for no man will prevail by strength.

2.zh: 与耶和华争竞的，必被打碎； 耶和华必从天上以雷攻击他， 必审判地极的人， 将力量赐与所立的王， 高举受膏者的角。
2.en: Those who strive with the LORD shall be broken to pieces. He will thunder against them in the sky. “The LORD will judge the ends of the earth. He will give strength to his king, and exalt the horn of his anointed.”

2.zh: 以利加拿往拉玛回家去了。那孩子在祭司以利面前事奉耶和华。
2.en: Elkanah went to Ramah to his house. The child served the LORD before Eli the priest.

2.zh: 以利的两个儿子是恶人，不认识耶和华。
2.en: Now the sons of Eli were wicked men. They didn’t know the LORD.

2.zh: 这二祭司待百姓是这样的规矩：凡有人献祭，正煮肉的时候，祭司的仆人就来，手拿三齿的叉子，
2.en: The custom of the priests with the people was that when anyone offered a sacrifice, the priest’s servant came while the meat was boiling, with a fork of three teeth in his hand;

2.zh: 将叉子往罐里，或鼎里，或釜里，或锅里一插，插上来的肉，祭司都取了去。凡上到示罗的以色列人，他们都是这样看待。
2.en: and he stabbed it into the pan, or kettle, or cauldron, or pot. The priest took all that the fork brought up for himself. They did this to all the Israelites who came there to Shiloh.

2.zh: 又在未烧脂油以前，祭司的仆人就来对献祭的人说：「将肉给祭司，叫他烤吧。他不要煮过的，要生的。」
2.en: Yes, before they burned the fat, the priest’s servant came, and said to the man who sacrificed, “Give meat to roast for the priest; for he will not accept boiled meat from you, but raw.”

2.zh: 献祭的人若说：「必须先烧脂油，然后你可以随意取肉。」仆人就说：「你立时给我，不然我便抢去。」
2.en: If the man said to him, “Let the fat be burned first, and then take as much as your soul desires;” then he would say, “No, but you shall give it to me now; and if not, I will take it by force.”

2.zh: 如此，这二少年人的罪在耶和华面前甚重了，因为他们藐视耶和华的祭物。
2.en: The sin of the young men was very great before the LORD; for the men despised the LORD’s offering.

2.zh: 那时，撒母耳还是孩子，穿着细麻布的以弗得，侍立在耶和华面前。
2.en: But Samuel ministered before the LORD, being a child, clothed with a linen ephod.

2.zh: 他母亲每年为他做一件小外袍，同着丈夫上来献年祭的时候带来给他。
2.en: Moreover his mother made him a little robe, and brought it to him from year to year when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice.

2.zh: 以利为以利加拿和他的妻祝福，说：「愿耶和华由这妇人再赐你后裔，代替你从耶和华求来的孩子。」他们就回本乡去了。
2.en: Eli blessed Elkanah and his wife, and said, “May the LORD give you offspring from this woman for the petition which was asked of the LORD.” Then they went to their own home.

2.zh: 耶和华眷顾哈拿，她就怀孕生了三个儿子，两个女儿。那孩子撒母耳在耶和华面前渐渐长大。
2.en: The LORD visited Hannah, and she conceived and bore three sons and two daughters. The child Samuel grew before the LORD.

2.zh: 以利年甚老迈，听见他两个儿子待以色列众人的事，又听见他们与会幕门前伺候的妇人苟合，
2.en: Now Eli was very old; and he heard all that his sons did to all Israel, and how that they slept with the women who served at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

2.zh: 他就对他们说：「你们为何行这样的事呢？我从这众百姓听见你们的恶行。
2.en: He said to them, “Why do you do such things? For I hear of your evil dealings from all these people.

2.zh: 我儿啊，不可这样！我听见你们的风声不好，你们使耶和华的百姓犯了罪。
2.en: No, my sons; for it is not a good report that I hear! You make the LORD’s people disobey.

2.zh: 人若得罪人，有士师审判他；人若得罪耶和华，谁能为他祈求呢？」然而他们还是不听父亲的话，因为耶和华想要杀他们。
2.en: If one man sins against another, God will judge him; but if a man sins against the LORD, who will intercede for him?” Notwithstanding, they didn’t listen to the voice of their father, because the LORD intended to kill them.

2.zh: 孩子撒母耳渐渐长大，耶和华与人越发喜爱他。
2.en: The child Samuel grew on, and increased in favor both with the LORD and also with men.

2.zh: 有神人来见以利，对他说：「耶和华如此说：『你祖父在埃及法老家[作奴仆]的时候，我不是向他们显现吗？
2.en: A man of God came to Eli and said to him, “The LORD says, ‘Did I reveal myself to the house of your father when they were in Egypt in bondage to Pharaoh’s house?

2.zh: 在以色列众支派中，我不是拣选人作我的祭司，使他烧香，在我坛上献祭，在我面前穿以弗得，又将以色列人所献的火祭都赐给你父家吗？
2.en: Didn’t I choose him out of all the tribes of Israel to be my priest, to go up to my altar, to burn incense, to wear an ephod before me? Didn’t I give to the house of your father all the offerings of the children of Israel made by fire?

2.zh: 我所吩咐献在我居所的祭物，你们为何践踏？尊重你的儿子过于尊重我，将我民以色列所献美好的祭物肥己呢？』
2.en: Why do you kick at my sacrifice and at my offering, which I have commanded in my habitation, and honor your sons above me, to make yourselves fat with the best of all the offerings of Israel my people?’

2.zh: 因此，耶和华—以色列的　神说：『我曾说，你和你父家必永远行在我面前；现在我却说，决不容你们这样行。因为尊重我的，我必重看他；藐视我的，他必被轻视。
2.en: “Therefore the LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘I said indeed that your house and the house of your father should walk before me forever.’ But now the LORD says, ‘Far be it from me; for those who honor me I will honor, and those who despise me will be cursed.

2.zh: 日子必到，我要折断你的膀臂和你父家的膀臂，使你家中没有一个老年人。
2.en: Behold, the days come that I will cut off your arm and the arm of your father’s house, that there will not be an old man in your house.

2.zh: 在　[神]使以色列人享福的时候，你必看见我居所的败落。在你家中必永远没有一个老年人。
2.en: You will see the affliction of my habitation, in all the wealth which I will give Israel. There shall not be an old man in your house forever.

2.zh: 我必不从我坛前灭尽你家中的人；那未灭的必使你眼目干瘪、心中忧伤。你家中所生的人都必死在中年。
2.en: The man of yours whom I don’t cut off from my altar will consume your eyes and grieve your heart. All the increase of your house will die in the flower of their age.

2.zh: 你的两个儿子何弗尼、非尼哈所遭遇的事可作你的证据：他们二人必一日同死。
2.en: This will be the sign to you that will come on your two sons, on Hophni and Phinehas: in one day they will both die.

2.zh: 我要为自己立一个忠心的祭司；他必照我的心意而行。我要为他建立坚固的家；他必永远行在我的受膏者面前。
2.en: I will raise up a faithful priest for myself who will do according to that which is in my heart and in my mind. I will build him a sure house. He will walk before my anointed forever.

2.zh: 你家所剩下的人都必来叩拜他，求块银子，求个饼，说：求你赐我祭司的职分，好叫我得点饼吃。』」
2.en: It will happen that everyone who is left in your house will come and bow down to him for a piece of silver and a loaf of bread, and will say, “Please put me into one of the priests’ offices, that I may eat a morsel of bread.”’”

3.zh: 童子撒母耳在以利面前事奉耶和华。当那些日子，耶和华的言语稀少，不常有默示。
3.en: The child Samuel ministered to the LORD before Eli. The LORD’s word was rare in those days. There were not many visions, then.

3.zh: 一日，以利睡卧在自己的地方；他眼目昏花，看不分明。
3.en: At that time, when Eli was laid down in his place (now his eyes had begun to grow dim, so that he could not see),

3.zh: 神的灯在　神耶和华殿内[约]柜那里，还没有熄灭，撒母耳已经睡了。
3.en: and God’s lamp hadn’t yet gone out, and Samuel had laid down in the LORD’s temple where God’s ark was,

3.zh: 耶和华呼唤撒母耳。撒母耳说：「我在这里！」
3.en: The LORD called Samuel. He said, “Here I am.”

3.zh: 就跑到以利那里，说：「你呼唤我？我在这里。」以利回答说：「我没有呼唤你，你去睡吧。」他就去睡了。
3.en: He ran to Eli and said, “Here I am; for you called me.” He said, “I didn’t call. Lie down again.” He went and lay down.

3.zh: 耶和华又呼唤撒母耳。撒母耳起来，到以利那里，说：「你呼唤我？我在这里。」以利回答说：「我的儿，我没有呼唤你，你去睡吧。」
3.en: The LORD called yet again, “Samuel!” Samuel arose and went to Eli and said, “Here I am; for you called me.” He answered, “I didn’t call, my son. Lie down again.”

3.zh: 那时撒母耳还未认识耶和华，也未得耶和华的默示。
3.en: Now Samuel didn’t yet know the LORD, neither was the LORD’s word yet revealed to him.

3.zh: 耶和华第三次呼唤撒母耳。撒母耳起来，到以利那里，说：「你又呼唤我？我在这里。」以利才明白是耶和华呼唤童子。
3.en: The LORD called Samuel again the third time. He arose and went to Eli and said, “Here I am; for you called me.” Eli perceived that the LORD had called the child.

3.zh: 因此以利对撒母耳说：「你仍去睡吧；若再呼唤你，你就说：『耶和华啊，请说，仆人敬听！』」撒母耳就去，仍睡在原处。
3.en: Therefore Eli said to Samuel, “Go, lie down. It shall be, if he calls you, that you shall say, ‘Speak, LORD; for your servant hears.’” So Samuel went and lay down in his place.

3.zh: 耶和华又来站着，像前三次呼唤说：「撒母耳啊！撒母耳啊！」撒母耳回答说：「请说，仆人敬听！」
3.en: The LORD came, and stood, and called as at other times, “Samuel! Samuel!” Then Samuel said, “Speak; for your servant hears.”

3.zh: 耶和华对撒母耳说：「我在以色列中必行一件事，叫听见的人都必耳鸣。
3.en: The LORD said to Samuel, “Behold, I will do a thing in Israel at which both the ears of everyone who hears it will tingle.

3.zh: 我指着以利家所说的话，到了时候，我必始终应验在以利身上。
3.en: In that day I will perform against Eli all that I have spoken concerning his house, from the beginning even to the end.

3.zh: 我曾告诉他必永远降罚与他的家，因他知道儿子作孽，自招咒诅，却不禁止他们。
3.en: For I have told him that I will judge his house forever for the iniquity which he knew, because his sons brought a curse on themselves, and he didn’t restrain them.

3.zh: 所以我向以利家起誓说：『以利家的罪孽，虽献祭奉礼物，永不能得赎去。』」
3.en: Therefore I have sworn to the house of Eli that the iniquity of Eli’s house shall not be removed with sacrifice or offering forever.”

3.zh: 撒母耳睡到天亮，就开了耶和华的殿门，不敢将默示告诉以利。
3.en: Samuel lay until the morning, and opened the doors of the LORD’s house. Samuel was afraid to show Eli the vision.

3.zh: 以利呼唤撒母耳说：「我儿撒母耳啊！」撒母耳回答说：「我在这里！」
3.en: Then Eli called Samuel and said, “Samuel, my son!” He said, “Here I am.”

3.zh: 以利说：「[耶和华]对你说什么，你不要向我隐瞒；你若将　神对你所说的隐瞒一句，愿他重重地降罚与你。」
3.en: He said, “What is the thing that he has spoken to you? Please don’t hide it from me. God do so to you, and more also, if you hide anything from me of all the things that he spoke to you.”

3.zh: 撒母耳就把一切话都告诉了以利，并没有隐瞒。以利说：「这是出于耶和华，愿他凭自己的意旨而行。」
3.en: Samuel told him every bit, and hid nothing from him. He said, “It is the LORD. Let him do what seems good to him.”

3.zh: 撒母耳长大了，耶和华与他同在，使他所说的话一句都不落空。
3.en: Samuel grew, and the LORD was with him and let none of his words fall to the ground.

3.zh: 从但到别是巴所有的以色列人都知道耶和华立撒母耳为先知。
3.en: All Israel from Dan even to Beersheba knew that Samuel was established to be a prophet of the LORD.

3.zh: 耶和华又在示罗显现；因为耶和华将自己的话默示撒母耳，撒母耳就把这话传遍以色列地。
3.en: The LORD appeared again in Shiloh; for the LORD revealed himself to Samuel in Shiloh by the LORD’s word.

4.zh: 以色列人出去与非利士人打仗，安营在以便以谢；非利士人安营在亚弗。
4.en: The word of Samuel came to all Israel. Now Israel went out against the Philistines to battle, and encamped beside Ebenezer; and the Philistines encamped in Aphek.

4.zh: 非利士人向以色列人摆阵。两军交战的时候，以色列人败在非利士人面前；非利士人在战场上杀了他们的军兵约有四千人。
4.en: The Philistines put themselves in array against Israel. When they joined battle, Israel was defeated by the Philistines, who killed about four thousand men of the army in the field.

4.zh: 百姓回到营里，以色列的长老说：「耶和华今日为何使我们败在非利士人面前呢？我们不如将耶和华的约柜从示罗抬到我们这里来，好在我们中间救我们脱离敌人的手。」
4.en: When the people had come into the camp, the elders of Israel said, “Why has the LORD defeated us today before the Philistines? Let’s get the ark of the LORD’s covenant out of Shiloh and bring it to us, that it may come among us and save us out of the hand of our enemies.”

4.zh: 于是百姓打发人到示罗，从那里将坐在二基路伯上万军之耶和华的约柜抬来。以利的两个儿子何弗尼、非尼哈与　神的约柜同来。
4.en: So the people sent to Shiloh, and they brought from there the ark of the covenant of the LORD of Armies, who sits above the cherubim; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were there with the ark of the covenant of God.

4.zh: 耶和华的约柜到了营中，以色列众人就大声欢呼，地便震动。
4.en: When the ark of the LORD’s covenant came into the camp, all Israel shouted with a great shout, so that the earth resounded.

4.zh: 非利士人听见欢呼的声音，就说：「在希伯来人营里大声欢呼，是什么缘故呢？」随后就知道耶和华的[约]柜到了营中。
4.en: When the Philistines heard the noise of the shout, they said, “What does the noise of this great shout in the camp of the Hebrews mean?” They understood that the LORD’s ark had come into the camp.

4.zh: 非利士人就惧怕起来，说：「有神到了他们营中」；又说：「我们有祸了！向来不曾有这样的事。
4.en: The Philistines were afraid, for they said, “God has come into the camp.” They said, “Woe to us! For there has not been such a thing before.

4.zh: 我们有祸了！谁能救我们脱离这些大能之神的手呢？从前在旷野用各样灾殃击打埃及人的，就是这些神。
4.en: Woe to us! Who shall deliver us out of the hand of these mighty gods? These are the gods that struck the Egyptians with all kinds of plagues in the wilderness.

4.zh: 非利士人哪，你们要刚强，要作大丈夫，免得作希伯来人的奴仆，如同他们作你们的奴仆一样。你们要作大丈夫，与他们争战。」
4.en: Be strong and behave like men, O you Philistines, that you not be servants to the Hebrews, as they have been to you. Strengthen yourselves like men, and fight!”

4.zh: 非利士人和以色列人打仗，以色列人败了，各向各家奔逃，被杀的人甚多，以色列的步兵仆倒了三万。
4.en: The Philistines fought, and Israel was defeated, and each man fled to his tent. There was a very great slaughter; for thirty thousand footmen of Israel fell.

4.zh: 神的[约]柜被掳去，以利的两个儿子何弗尼、非尼哈也都被杀了。
4.en: God’s ark was taken; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were slain.

4.zh: 当日，有一个便雅悯人从阵上逃跑，衣服撕裂，头蒙灰尘，来到示罗。
4.en: A man of Benjamin ran out of the army and came to Shiloh the same day, with his clothes torn and with dirt on his head.

4.zh: 到了的时候，以利正在道旁坐在自己的位上观望，为　神的[约]柜心里担忧。那人进城报信，合城的人就都呼喊起来。
4.en: When he came, behold, Eli was sitting on his seat by the road watching, for his heart trembled for God’s ark. When the man came into the city and told about it, all the city cried out.

4.zh: 以利听见呼喊的声音就问说：「这喧嚷是什么缘故呢？」那人急忙来报信给以利。
4.en: When Eli heard the noise of the crying, he said, “What does the noise of this tumult mean?” The man hurried, and came and told Eli.

4.zh: 那时以利九十八岁了，眼目发直，不能看见。
4.en: Now Eli was ninety-eight years old. His eyes were set, so that he could not see.

4.zh: 那人对以利说：「我是从阵上来的，今日我从阵上逃回。」以利说：「我儿，事情怎样？」
4.en: The man said to Eli, “I am he who came out of the army, and I fled today out of the army.” He said, “How did the matter go, my son?”

4.zh: 报信的回答说：「以色列人在非利士人面前逃跑，民中被杀的甚多！你的两个儿子何弗尼、非尼哈也都死了，并且　神的[约]柜被掳去。」
4.en: He who brought the news answered, “Israel has fled before the Philistines, and there has been also a great slaughter among the people. Your two sons also, Hophni and Phinehas, are dead, and God’s ark has been captured.”

4.zh: 他一提　神的[约]柜，以利就从他的位上往后跌倒，在门旁折断颈项而死；因为他年纪老迈，身体沉重。以利作以色列的士师四十年。
4.en: When he made mention of God’s ark, Eli fell from off his seat backward by the side of the gate; and his neck broke, and he died, for he was an old man and heavy. He had judged Israel forty years.

4.zh: 以利的儿妇、非尼哈的妻怀孕将到产期，她听见　神的[约]柜被掳去，公公和丈夫都死了，就猛然疼痛，曲身生产；
4.en: His daughter-in-law, Phinehas’ wife, was with child, near to giving birth. When she heard the news that God’s ark was taken and that her father-in-law and her husband were dead, she bowed herself and gave birth; for her pains came on her.

4.zh: 将要死的时候，旁边站着的妇人们对她说：「不要怕！你生了男孩子了。」她却不回答，也不放在心上。
4.en: About the time of her death the women who stood by her said to her, “Don’t be afraid, for you have given birth to a son.” But she didn’t answer, neither did she regard it.

4.zh: 她给孩子起名叫以迦博，说：「荣耀离开以色列了！」这是因　神的[约]柜被掳去，又因她公公和丈夫都死了。
4.en: She named the child Ichabod, saying, “The glory has departed from Israel!” because God’s ark was taken, and because of her father-in-law and her husband.

4.zh: 她又说：「荣耀离开以色列，因为　神的约柜被掳去了。」
4.en: She said, “The glory has departed from Israel; for God’s ark has been taken.”

5.zh: 非利士人将　神的[约]柜从以便以谢抬到亚实突。
5.en: Now the Philistines had taken God’s ark, and they brought it from Ebenezer to Ashdod.

5.zh: 非利士人将　神的[约]柜抬进大衮庙，放在大衮的旁边。
5.en: The Philistines took God’s ark, and brought it into the house of Dagon and set it by Dagon.

5.zh: 次日清早，亚实突人起来，见大衮仆倒在耶和华的[约]柜前，脸伏于地，就把大衮仍立在原处。
5.en: When the people of Ashdod arose early on the next day, behold, Dagon had fallen on his face to the ground before the LORD’s ark. They took Dagon and set him in his place again.

5.zh: 又次日清早起来，见大衮仆倒在耶和华的[约]柜前，脸伏于地，并且大衮的头和两手都在门槛上折断，只剩下大衮的[残体]。（
5.en: When they arose early on the following morning, behold, Dagon had fallen on his face to the ground before the LORD’s ark; and the head of Dagon and both the palms of his hands were cut off on the threshold. Only Dagon’s torso was intact.

5.zh: 因此，大衮的祭司和一切进亚实突、大衮庙的人都不踏大衮庙的门槛，直到今日。）
5.en: Therefore neither the priests of Dagon nor any who come into Dagon’s house step on the threshold of Dagon in Ashdod to this day.

5.zh: 耶和华的手重重加在亚实突人身上，败坏他们，使他们生痔疮。亚实突和亚实突的四境都是如此。
5.en: But the LORD’s hand was heavy on the people of Ashdod, and he destroyed them and struck them with tumors, even Ashdod and its borders.

5.zh: 亚实突人见这光景，就说：「以色列　神的[约]柜不可留在我们这里，因为他的手重重加在我们和我们神大衮的身上」；
5.en: When the men of Ashdod saw that it was so, they said, “The ark of the God of Israel shall not stay with us, for his hand is severe on us and on Dagon our god.”

5.zh: 就打发人去请非利士的众首领来聚集，问他们说：「我们向以色列　神的[约]柜应当怎样行呢？」他们回答说：「可以将以色列　神的[约]柜运到迦特去。」于是将以色列　神的[约]柜运到那里去。
5.en: They sent therefore and gathered together all the lords of the Philistines, and said, “What shall we do with the ark of the God of Israel?” They answered, “Let the ark of the God of Israel be carried over to Gath.” They carried the ark of the God of Israel there.

5.zh: 运到之后，耶和华的手攻击那城，使那城的人大大惊慌，无论大小都生痔疮。
5.en: It was so, that after they had carried it there, the LORD’s hand was against the city with a very great confusion; and he struck the men of the city, both small and great, so that tumors broke out on them.

5.zh: 他们就把　神的[约]柜送到以革伦。　神的[约]柜到了，以革伦人就喊嚷起来说：「他们将以色列　神的[约]柜运到我们这里，要害我们和我们的众民！」
5.en: So they sent God’s ark to Ekron. As God’s ark came to Ekron, the Ekronites cried out, saying, “They have brought the ark of the God of Israel here to us, to kill us and our people.”

5.zh: 于是打发人去请非利士的众首领来，说：「愿你们将以色列　神的[约]柜送回原处，免得害了我们和我们的众民！」原来　神的手重重攻击那城，城中的人有因惊慌而死的；
5.en: They sent therefore and gathered together all the lords of the Philistines, and they said, “Send the ark of the God of Israel away, and let it go again to its own place, that it not kill us and our people.” For there was a deadly panic throughout all the city. The hand of God was very heavy there.

5.zh: 未曾死的人都生了痔疮。合城呼号，声音上达于天。
5.en: The men who didn’t die were struck with the tumors; and the cry of the city went up to heaven.

6.zh: 耶和华的[约]柜在非利士人之地七个月。
6.en: The LORD’s ark was in the country of the Philistines seven months.

6.zh: 非利士人将祭司和占卜的聚了来，问他们说：「我们向耶和华的[约]柜应当怎样行？请指示我们用何法将[约]柜送回原处。」
6.en: The Philistines called for the priests and the diviners, saying, “What shall we do with the LORD’s ark? Show us how we should send it to its place.”

6.zh: 他们说：「若要将以色列　神的[约]柜送回去，不可空空地送去，必要给他献赔罪的礼物，然后你们可得痊愈，并知道他的手为何不离开你们。」
6.en: They said, “If you send away the ark of the God of Israel, don’t send it empty; but by all means return a trespass offering to him. Then you will be healed, and it will be known to you why his hand is not removed from you.”

6.zh: 非利士人说：「应当用什么献为赔罪的礼物呢？」他们回答说：「当照非利士首领的数目，用五个金痔疮，五个金老鼠，因为在你们众人和你们首领的身上都是一样的灾。
6.en: Then they said, “What should the trespass offering be which we shall return to him?” They said, “Five golden tumors and five golden mice, for the number of the lords of the Philistines; for one plague was on you all, and on your lords.

6.zh: 所以当制造你们痔疮的像和毁坏你们田地老鼠的像，并要归荣耀给以色列的　神，或者他向你们和你们的神，并你们的田地，把手放轻些。
6.en: Therefore you shall make images of your tumors and images of your mice that mar the land; and you shall give glory to the God of Israel. Perhaps he will release his hand from you, from your gods, and from your land.

6.zh: 你们为何硬着心像埃及人和法老一样呢？　神在埃及人中间行奇事，埃及人岂不释放以色列人，他们就去了吗？
6.en: Why then do you harden your hearts as the Egyptians and Pharaoh hardened their hearts? When he had worked wonderfully among them, didn’t they let the people go, and they departed?

6.zh: 现在你们应当造一辆新车，将两只未曾负轭有乳的母牛套在车上，使牛犊回家去，离开母牛。
6.en: “Now therefore take and prepare yourselves a new cart and two milk cows on which there has come no yoke; and tie the cows to the cart, and bring their calves home from them;

6.zh: 把耶和华的[约]柜放在车上，将所献赔罪的金物装在匣子里，放在柜旁，将柜送去。
6.en: and take the LORD’s ark and lay it on the cart. Put the jewels of gold, which you return him for a trespass offering, in a box by its side; and send it away, that it may go.

6.zh: 你们要看看：车若直行以色列的境界到伯·示麦去，这大灾就是耶和华降在我们身上的；若不然，便可以知道不是他的手击打我们，是我们偶然遇见的。」
6.en: Behold, if it goes up by the way of its own border to Beth Shemesh, then he has done us this great evil; but if not, then we shall know that it is not his hand that struck us. It was a chance that happened to us.”

6.zh: 非利士人就这样行：将两只有乳的母牛套在车上，将牛犊关在家里，
6.en: The men did so, and took two milk cows and tied them to the cart, and shut up their calves at home.

6.zh: 把耶和华的[约]柜和装金老鼠并金痔疮像的匣子都放在车上。
6.en: They put the LORD’s ark on the cart, and the box with the golden mice and the images of their tumors.

6.zh: 牛直行大道，往伯·示麦去，一面走一面叫，不偏左右。非利士的首领跟在后面，直到伯·示麦的境界。
6.en: The cows took the straight way by the way to Beth Shemesh. They went along the highway, lowing as they went, and didn’t turn away to the right hand or to the left; and the lords of the Philistines went after them to the border of Beth Shemesh.

6.zh: 伯·示麦人正在平原收割麦子，举目看见[约]柜，就欢喜了。
6.en: The people of Beth Shemesh were reaping their wheat harvest in the valley; and they lifted up their eyes and saw the ark, and rejoiced to see it.

6.zh: 车到了伯·示麦人约书亚的田间，就站住了。在那里有一块大磐石，他们把车劈了，将两只母牛献给耶和华为燔祭。
6.en: The cart came into the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh, and stood there, where there was a great stone. Then they split the wood of the cart and offered up the cows for a burnt offering to the LORD.

6.zh: 利未人将耶和华的[约]柜和装金物的匣子拿下来，放在大磐石上。当日伯·示麦人将燔祭和[平安]祭献给耶和华。
6.en: The Levites took down the LORD’s ark and the box that was with it, in which the jewels of gold were, and put them on the great stone; and the men of Beth Shemesh offered burnt offerings and sacrificed sacrifices the same day to the LORD.

6.zh: 非利士人的五个首领看见，当日就回以革伦去了。
6.en: When the five lords of the Philistines had seen it, they returned to Ekron the same day.

6.zh: 非利士人献给耶和华作赔罪的金痔疮像，就是这些：一个是为亚实突，一个是为迦萨，一个是为亚实基伦，一个是为迦特，一个是为以革伦。
6.en: These are the golden tumors which the Philistines returned for a trespass offering to the LORD: for Ashdod one, for Gaza one, for Ashkelon one, for Gath one, for Ekron one;

6.zh: 金老鼠的数目是照非利士五个首领的城邑，就是坚固的城邑和乡村，以及大磐石。这磐石是放耶和华[约]柜的，到今日还在伯·示麦人约书亚的田间。
6.en: and the golden mice, according to the number of all the cities of the Philistines belonging to the five lords, both of fortified cities and of country villages, even to the great stone on which they set down the LORD’s ark. That stone remains to this day in the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh.

6.zh: 耶和华因伯·示麦人擅观他的[约]柜，就击杀了他们七十人；那时有五万人在那里。百姓因耶和华大大击杀他们，就哀哭了。
6.en: He struck of the men of Beth Shemesh, because they had looked into the LORD’s ark, he struck fifty thousand seventy of the men. Then the people mourned, because the LORD had struck the people with a great slaughter.

6.zh: 伯·示麦人说：「谁能在耶和华这圣洁的　神面前侍立呢？这[约]柜可以从我们这里送到谁那里去呢？」
6.en: The men of Beth Shemesh said, “Who is able to stand before the LORD, this holy God? To whom shall he go up from us?”

6.zh: 于是打发人去见基列·耶琳的居民，说：「非利士人将耶和华的[约]柜送回来了，你们下来将[约]柜接到你们那里去吧！」
6.en: They sent messengers to the inhabitants of Kiriath Jearim, saying, “The Philistines have brought back the LORD’s ark. Come down and bring it up to yourselves.”

7.zh: 基列·耶琳人就下来，将耶和华的[约]柜接上去，放在山上亚比拿达的家中，分派他儿子以利亚撒看守耶和华的[约]柜。
7.en: The men of Kiriath Jearim came and took the LORD’s ark, and brought it into Abinadab’s house on the hill, and consecrated Eleazar his son to keep the LORD’s ark.

7.zh: [约]柜在基列·耶琳许久。过了二十年，以色列全家都倾向耶和华。
7.en: From the day that the ark stayed in Kiriath Jearim, the time was long—for it was twenty years; and all the house of Israel lamented after the LORD.

7.zh: 撒母耳对以色列全家说：「你们若一心归顺耶和华，就要把外邦的神和亚斯她录从你们中间除掉，专心归向耶和华，单单地事奉他。他必救你们脱离非利士人的手。」
7.en: Samuel spoke to all the house of Israel, saying, “If you are returning to the LORD with all your heart, then put away the foreign gods and the Ashtaroth from among you, and direct your hearts to the LORD, and serve him only; and he will deliver you out of the hand of the Philistines.”

7.zh: 以色列人就除掉诸巴力和亚斯她录，单单地事奉耶和华。
7.en: Then the children of Israel removed the Baals and the Ashtaroth, and served the LORD only.

7.zh: 撒母耳说：「要使以色列众人聚集在米斯巴，我好为你们祷告耶和华。」
7.en: Samuel said, “Gather all Israel to Mizpah, and I will pray to the LORD for you.”

7.zh: 他们就聚集在米斯巴，打水浇在耶和华面前，当日禁食，说：「我们得罪了耶和华。」于是撒母耳在米斯巴审判以色列人。
7.en: They gathered together to Mizpah, and drew water, and poured it out before the LORD, and fasted on that day, and said there, “We have sinned against the LORD.” Samuel judged the children of Israel in Mizpah.

7.zh: 非利士人听见以色列人聚集在米斯巴，非利士的首领就上来要攻击以色列人。以色列人听见，就惧怕非利士人。
7.en: When the Philistines heard that the children of Israel were gathered together at Mizpah, the lords of the Philistines went up against Israel. When the children of Israel heard it, they were afraid of the Philistines.

7.zh: 以色列人对撒母耳说：「愿你不住地为我们呼求耶和华—我们的　神，救我们脱离非利士人的手。」
7.en: The children of Israel said to Samuel, “Don’t stop crying to the LORD our God for us, that he will save us out of the hand of the Philistines.”

7.zh: 撒母耳就把一只吃奶的羊羔献与耶和华作全牲的燔祭，为以色列人呼求耶和华；耶和华就应允他。
7.en: Samuel took a suckling lamb, and offered it for a whole burnt offering to the LORD. Samuel cried to the LORD for Israel, and the LORD answered him.

7.zh: 撒母耳正献燔祭的时候，非利士人前来要与以色列人争战。当日，耶和华大发雷声，惊乱非利士人，他们就败在以色列人面前。
7.en: As Samuel was offering up the burnt offering, the Philistines came near to battle against Israel; but the LORD thundered with a great thunder on that day on the Philistines and confused them; and they were struck down before Israel.

7.zh: 以色列人从米斯巴出来，追赶非利士人，击杀他们，直到伯·甲的下边。
7.en: The men of Israel went out of Mizpah and pursued the Philistines, and struck them until they came under Beth Kar.

7.zh: 撒母耳将一块石头立在米斯巴和善的中间，给石头起名叫以便以谢，说：「到如今耶和华都帮助我们。」
7.en: Then Samuel took a stone and set it between Mizpah and Shen, and called its name Ebenezer, saying, “The LORD helped us until now.”

7.zh: 从此，非利士人就被制伏，不敢再入以色列人的境内。撒母耳作士师的时候，耶和华的手攻击非利士人。
7.en: So the Philistines were subdued, and they stopped coming within the border of Israel. The LORD’s hand was against the Philistines all the days of Samuel.

7.zh: 非利士人所取以色列人的城邑，从以革伦直到迦特，都归以色列人了。属这些城的四境，以色列人也从非利士人手下收回。那时以色列人与亚摩利人和好。
7.en: The cities which the Philistines had taken from Israel were restored to Israel, from Ekron even to Gath; and Israel recovered its border out of the hand of the Philistines. There was peace between Israel and the Amorites.

7.zh: 撒母耳平生作以色列的士师。
7.en: Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life.

7.zh: 他每年巡行到伯特利、吉甲、米斯巴，在这几处审判以色列人。
7.en: He went from year to year in a circuit to Bethel, Gilgal, and Mizpah; and he judged Israel in all those places.

7.zh: 随后回到拉玛，因为他的家在那里；也在那里审判以色列人，且为耶和华筑了一座坛。
7.en: His return was to Ramah, for his house was there, and he judged Israel there; and he built an altar to the LORD there.

8.zh: 撒母耳年纪老迈，就立他儿子作以色列的士师。
8.en: When Samuel was old, he made his sons judges over Israel.

8.zh: 长子名叫约珥，次子名叫亚比亚；他们在别是巴作士师。
8.en: Now the name of his firstborn was Joel, and the name of his second, Abijah. They were judges in Beersheba.

8.zh: 他儿子不行他的道，贪图财利，收受贿赂，屈枉正直。
8.en: His sons didn’t walk in his ways, but turned away after dishonest gain, took bribes, and perverted justice.

8.zh: 以色列的长老都聚集，来到拉玛见撒母耳，
8.en: Then all the elders of Israel gathered themselves together and came to Samuel to Ramah.

8.zh: 对他说：「你年纪老迈了，你儿子不行你的道。现在求你为我们立一个王治理我们，像列国一样。」
8.en: They said to him, “Behold, you are old, and your sons don’t walk in your ways. Now make us a king to judge us like all the nations.”

8.zh: 撒母耳不喜悦他们说「立一个王治理我们」，他就祷告耶和华。
8.en: But the thing displeased Samuel when they said, “Give us a king to judge us.” Samuel prayed to the LORD.

8.zh: 耶和华对撒母耳说：「百姓向你说的一切话，你只管依从；因为他们不是厌弃你，乃是厌弃我，不要我作他们的王。
8.en: The LORD said to Samuel, “Listen to the voice of the people in all that they tell you; for they have not rejected you, but they have rejected me as the king over them.

8.zh: 自从我领他们出埃及到如今，他们常常离弃我，事奉别神。现在他们向你所行的，是照他们素来所行的。
8.en: According to all the works which they have done since the day that I brought them up out of Egypt even to this day, in that they have forsaken me and served other gods, so they also do to you.

8.zh: 故此你要依从他们的话，只是当警戒他们，告诉他们将来那王怎样管辖他们。」
8.en: Now therefore, listen to their voice. However, you shall protest solemnly to them, and shall show them the way of the king who will reign over them.”

8.zh: 撒母耳将耶和华的话都传给求他立王的百姓，说：
8.en: Samuel told all the LORD’s words to the people who asked him for a king.

8.zh: 「管辖你们的王必这样行：他必派你们的儿子为他赶车、跟马，奔走在车前；
8.en: He said, “This will be the way of the king who shall reign over you: he will take your sons and appoint them as his servants, for his chariots and to be his horsemen; and they will run before his chariots.

8.zh: 又派他们作千夫长、五十夫长，为他耕种田地，收割庄稼，打造军器和车上的器械；
8.en: He will appoint them to him for captains of thousands and captains of fifties; and he will assign some to plow his ground and to reap his harvest; and to make his instruments of war and the instruments of his chariots.

8.zh: 必取你们的女儿为他制造香膏，做饭烤饼；
8.en: He will take your daughters to be perfumers, to be cooks, and to be bakers.

8.zh: 也必取你们最好的田地、葡萄园、橄榄园赐给他的臣仆。
8.en: He will take your fields, your vineyards, and your olive groves, even your best, and give them to his servants.

8.zh: 你们的粮食和葡萄园所出的，他必取十分之一给他的太监和臣仆；
8.en: He will take one tenth of your seed and of your vineyards, and give it to his officers and to his servants.

8.zh: 又必取你们的仆人婢女，健壮的少年人和你们的驴，供他的差役。
8.en: He will take your male servants, your female servants, your best young men, and your donkeys, and assign them to his own work.

8.zh: 你们的羊群他必取十分之一，你们也必作他的仆人。
8.en: He will take one tenth of your flocks; and you will be his servants.

8.zh: 那时你们必因所选的王哀求耶和华，耶和华却不应允你们。」
8.en: You will cry out in that day because of your king whom you will have chosen for yourselves; and the LORD will not answer you in that day.”

8.zh: 百姓竟不肯听撒母耳的话，说：「不然！我们定要一个王治理我们，
8.en: But the people refused to listen to the voice of Samuel; and they said, “No, but we will have a king over us,

8.zh: 使我们像列国一样，有王治理我们，统领我们，为我们争战。」
8.en: that we also may be like all the nations; and that our king may judge us, and go out before us, and fight our battles.”

8.zh: 撒母耳听见百姓这一切话，就将这话陈明在耶和华面前。
8.en: Samuel heard all the words of the people, and he rehearsed them in the ears of the LORD.

8.zh: 耶和华对撒母耳说：「你只管依从他们的话，为他们立王。」撒母耳对以色列人说：「你们各归各城去吧！」
8.en: The LORD said to Samuel, “Listen to their voice, and make them a king.” Samuel said to the men of Israel, “Everyone go to your own city.”

9.zh: 有一个便雅悯人，名叫基士，是便雅悯人亚斐亚的玄孙，比歌拉的曾孙，洗罗的孙子，亚别的儿子，是个大能的勇士。
9.en: Now there was a man of Benjamin, whose name was Kish the son of Abiel, the son of Zeror, the son of Becorath, the son of Aphiah, the son of a Benjamite, a mighty man of valor.

9.zh: 他有一个儿子，名叫扫罗，又健壮、又俊美，在以色列人中没有一个能比他的；身体比众民高过一头。
9.en: He had a son whose name was Saul, an impressive young man; and there was not among the children of Israel a more handsome person than he. From his shoulders and upward he was taller than any of the people.

9.zh: 扫罗的父亲基士丢了几头驴，他就吩咐儿子扫罗说：「你带一个仆人去寻找驴。」
9.en: The donkeys of Kish, Saul’s father, were lost. Kish said to Saul his son, “Now take one of the servants with you, and arise, go look for the donkeys.”

9.zh: 扫罗就走过以法莲山地，又过沙利沙地，都没有找着；又过沙琳地，驴也不在那里；又过便雅悯地，还没有找着。
9.en: He passed through the hill country of Ephraim, and passed through the land of Shalishah, but they didn’t find them. Then they passed through the land of Shaalim, and they weren’t there. Then he passed through the land of the Benjamites, but they didn’t find them.

9.zh: 到了苏弗地，扫罗对跟随他的仆人说：「我们不如回去，恐怕我父亲不为驴挂心，反为我们担忧。」
9.en: When they had come to the land of Zuph, Saul said to his servant who was with him, “Come! Let’s return, lest my father stop caring about the donkeys and be anxious for us.”

9.zh: 仆人说：「这城里有一位神人，是众人所尊重的，凡他所说的全都应验。我们不如往他那里去，或者他能将我们当走的路指示我们。」
9.en: The servant said to him, “Behold now, there is a man of God in this city, and he is a man who is held in honor. All that he says surely happens. Now let’s go there. Perhaps he can tell us which way to go.”

9.zh: 扫罗对仆人说：「我们若去，有什么可以送那人呢？我们囊中的食物都吃尽了，也没有礼物可以送那神人，我们还有什么没有？」
9.en: Then Saul said to his servant, “But behold, if we go, what should we bring the man? For the bread is spent in our sacks, and there is not a present to bring to the man of God. What do we have?”

9.zh: 仆人回答扫罗说：「我手里有银子一舍客勒的四分之一，可以送那神人，请他指示我们当走的路。」（
9.en: The servant answered Saul again and said, “Behold, I have in my hand the fourth part of a shekel of silver. I will give that to the man of God, to tell us our way.”

9.zh: 从前以色列中，若有人去问　神，就说：「我们问先见去吧！」现在称为「先知」的，从前称为「先见」。）
9.en: (In earlier times in Israel, when a man went to inquire of God, he said, “Come! Let’s go to the seer;” for he who is now called a prophet was before called a seer.)

9.zh: 扫罗对仆人说：「你说的是，我们可以去。」于是他们往神人所住的城里去了。
9.en: Then Saul said to his servant, “Well said. Come! Let’s go.” So they went to the city where the man of God was.

9.zh: 他们上坡要进城，就遇见几个少年女子出来打水，问她们说：「先见在这里没有？」
9.en: As they went up the ascent to the city, they found young maidens going out to draw water, and said to them, “Is the seer here?”

9.zh: 女子回答说：「在这里，他在你们前面。快去吧！他今日正到城里，因为今日百姓要在邱坛献祭。
9.en: They answered them and said, “He is. Behold, he is before you. Hurry now, for he has come today into the city; for the people have a sacrifice today in the high place.

9.zh: 在他还没有上邱坛吃祭物之先，你们一进城必遇见他；因他未到，百姓不能吃，必等他先祝祭，然后请的客才吃。现在你们上去，这时候必遇见他。」
9.en: As soon as you have come into the city, you will immediately find him before he goes up to the high place to eat; for the people will not eat until he comes, because he blesses the sacrifice. Afterwards those who are invited eat. Now therefore go up; for at this time you will find him.”

9.zh: 二人就上去；将进城的时候，撒母耳正迎着他们来，要上邱坛去。
9.en: They went up to the city. As they came within the city, behold, Samuel came out toward them to go up to the high place.

9.zh: 扫罗未到的前一日，耶和华已经指示撒母耳说：
9.en: Now the LORD had revealed to Samuel a day before Saul came, saying,

9.zh: 「明日这时候，我必使一个人从便雅悯地到你这里来，你要膏他作我民以色列的君。他必救我民脱离非利士人的手；因我民的哀声上达于我，我就眷顾他们。」
9.en: “Tomorrow about this time I will send you a man out of the land of Benjamin, and you shall anoint him to be prince over my people Israel. He will save my people out of the hand of the Philistines; for I have looked upon my people, because their cry has come to me.”

9.zh: 撒母耳看见扫罗的时候，耶和华对他说：「看哪，这人就是我对你所说的，他必治理我的民。」
9.en: When Samuel saw Saul, the LORD said to him, “Behold, the man of whom I spoke to you! He will have authority over my people.”

9.zh: 扫罗在城门里走到撒母耳跟前，说：「请告诉我，先见的寓所在哪里？」
9.en: Then Saul approached Samuel in the gateway, and said, “Please tell me where the seer’s house is.”

9.zh: 撒母耳回答说：「我就是先见。你在我前面上邱坛去，因为你们今日必与我同席；明日早晨我送你去，将你心里的事都告诉你。
9.en: Samuel answered Saul and said, “I am the seer. Go up before me to the high place, for you are to eat with me today. In the morning I will let you go and will tell you all that is in your heart.

9.zh: 至于你前三日所丢的那几头驴，你心里不必挂念，已经找着了。以色列众人所仰慕的是谁呢？不是仰慕你和你父的全家吗？」
9.en: As for your donkeys who were lost three days ago, don’t set your mind on them, for they have been found. For whom does all Israel desire? Is it not you and all your father’s house?”

9.zh: 扫罗说：「我不是以色列支派中至小的便雅悯人吗？我家不是便雅悯支派中至小的家吗？你为何对我说这样的话呢？」
9.en: Saul answered, “Am I not a Benjamite, of the smallest of the tribes of Israel? And my family the least of all the families of the tribe of Benjamin? Why then do you speak to me like this?”

9.zh: 撒母耳领扫罗和他仆人进了客堂，使他们在请来的客中坐首位；客约有三十个人。
9.en: Samuel took Saul and his servant and brought them into the guest room, and made them sit in the best place among those who were invited, who were about thirty persons.

9.zh: 撒母耳对厨役说：「我交给你收存的那一分[祭肉]现在可以拿来。」
9.en: Samuel said to the cook, “Bring the portion which I gave you, of which I said to you, ‘Set it aside.’”

9.zh: 厨役就把收存的腿拿来，摆在扫罗面前，撒母耳说：「这是所留下的，放在你面前。吃吧！因我请百姓的时候，特意为你存留这肉到此时。」 当日，扫罗就与撒母耳同席。
9.en: The cook took up the thigh, and that which was on it, and set it before Saul. Samuel said, “Behold, that which has been reserved! Set it before yourself and eat; because it has been kept for you for the appointed time, for I said, ‘I have invited the people.’” So Saul ate with Samuel that day.

9.zh: 众人从邱坛下来进城，撒母耳和扫罗在房顶上说话。
9.en: When they had come down from the high place into the city, he talked with Saul on the housetop.

9.zh: 次日清早起来，黎明的时候，扫罗在房顶上。撒母耳呼叫他说：「起来吧，我好送你回去。」扫罗就起来，和撒母耳一同出去。
9.en: They arose early; and about daybreak, Samuel called to Saul on the housetop, saying, “Get up, that I may send you away.” Saul arose, and they both went outside, he and Samuel, together.

9.zh: 二人下到城角，撒母耳对扫罗说：「要吩咐仆人先走（仆人就先走了）；你且站在这里，等我将　神的话传与你听。」
9.en: As they were going down at the end of the city, Samuel said to Saul, “Tell the servant to go on ahead of us.” He went ahead, then Samuel said, “But stand still first, that I may cause you to hear God’s message.”

10.zh: 撒母耳拿瓶膏油倒在扫罗的头上，与他亲嘴，说：「这不是耶和华膏你作他产业的君吗？
10.en: Then Samuel took the vial of oil and poured it on his head, then kissed him and said, “Hasn’t the LORD anointed you to be prince over his inheritance?

10.zh: 你今日与我离别之后，在便雅悯境内的泄撒，靠近拉结的坟墓，要遇见两个人。他们必对你说：『你去找的那几头驴已经找着了。现在你父亲不为驴挂心，反为你担忧，说：我为儿子怎么才好呢？』
10.en: When you have departed from me today, then you will find two men by Rachel’s tomb, on the border of Benjamin at Zelzah. They will tell you, ‘The donkeys which you went to look for have been found; and behold, your father has stopped caring about the donkeys and is anxious for you, saying, “What shall I do for my son?”’

10.zh: 你从那里往前行，到了他泊的橡树那里，必遇见三个往伯特利去拜　神的人：一个带着三只山羊羔，一个带着三个饼，一个带着一皮袋酒。
10.en: “Then you will go on forward from there, and you will come to the oak of Tabor. Three men will meet you there going up to God to Bethel: one carrying three young goats, and another carrying three loaves of bread, and another carrying a container of wine.

10.zh: 他们必问你安，给你两个饼，你就从他们手中接过来。
10.en: They will greet you and give you two loaves of bread, which you shall receive from their hand.

10.zh: 此后你到　神的山，在那里有非利士人的防兵。你到了城的时候，必遇见一班先知从邱坛下来，前面有鼓瑟的、击鼓的、吹笛的、弹琴的，他们都受感说话。
10.en: “After that you will come to the hill of God, where the garrison of the Philistines is; and it will happen, when you have come there to the city, that you will meet a band of prophets coming down from the high place with a lute, a tambourine, a pipe, and a harp before them; and they will be prophesying.

10.zh: 耶和华的灵必大大感动你，你就与他们一同受感说话；你要变为新人。
10.en: Then the LORD’s Spirit will come mightily on you, then you will prophesy with them and will be turned into another man.

10.zh: 这兆头临到你，你就可以趁时而做，因为　神与你同在。
10.en: Let it be, when these signs have come to you, that you do what is appropriate for the occasion; for God is with you.

10.zh: 你当在我以先下到吉甲，我也必下到那里献燔祭和平安祭。你要等候七日，等我到了那里，指示你当行的事。」
10.en: “Go down ahead of me to Gilgal; and behold, I will come down to you to offer burnt offerings and to sacrifice sacrifices of peace offerings. Wait seven days, until I come to you and show you what you are to do.”

10.zh: 扫罗转身离别撒母耳，　神就赐他一个新心。当日这一切兆头都应验了。
10.en: It was so, that when he had turned his back to go from Samuel, God gave him another heart; and all those signs happened that day.

10.zh: 扫罗到了那山，有一班先知遇见他，　神的灵大大感动他，他就在先知中受感说话。
10.en: When they came there to the hill, behold, a band of prophets met him; and the Spirit of God came mightily on him, and he prophesied among them.

10.zh: 素来认识扫罗的，看见他和先知一同受感说话，就彼此说：「基士的儿子遇见什么了？扫罗也列在先知中吗？」
10.en: When all who knew him before saw that, behold, he prophesied with the prophets, then the people said to one another, “What is this that has come to the son of Kish? Is Saul also among the prophets?”

10.zh: 那地方有一个人说：「这些人的父亲是谁呢？」此后有句俗语说：「扫罗也列在先知中吗？」
10.en: One from the same place answered, “Who is their father?” Therefore it became a proverb, “Is Saul also among the prophets?”

10.zh: 扫罗受感说话已毕，就上邱坛去了。
10.en: When he had finished prophesying, he came to the high place.

10.zh: 扫罗的叔叔问扫罗和他仆人说：「你们往哪里去了？」回答说：「找驴去了。我们见没有驴，就到了撒母耳那里。」
10.en: Saul’s uncle said to him and to his servant, “Where did you go?” He said, “To seek the donkeys. When we saw that they were not found, we came to Samuel.”

10.zh: 扫罗的叔叔说：「请将撒母耳向你们所说的话告诉我。」
10.en: Saul’s uncle said, “Please tell me what Samuel said to you.”

10.zh: 扫罗对他叔叔说：「他明明地告诉我们驴已经找着了。」至于撒母耳所说的国事，扫罗却没有告诉叔叔。
10.en: Saul said to his uncle, “He told us plainly that the donkeys were found.” But concerning the matter of the kingdom, of which Samuel spoke, he didn’t tell him.

10.zh: 撒母耳将百姓招聚到米斯巴耶和华那里，
10.en: Samuel called the people together to the LORD to Mizpah;

10.zh: 对他们说：「耶和华—以色列的　神如此说：『我领你们以色列人出埃及，救你们脱离埃及人的手，又救你们脱离欺压你们各国之人的手。』
10.en: and he said to the children of Israel, “The LORD, the God of Israel, says ‘I brought Israel up out of Egypt and I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all the kingdoms that oppressed you.’

10.zh: 你们今日却厌弃了救你们脱离一切灾难的　神，说：『求你立一个王治理我们。』现在你们应当按着支派、宗族都站在耶和华面前。」
10.en: But you have today rejected your God, who himself saves you out of all your calamities and your distresses; and you have said to him, ‘No! Set a king over us!’ Now therefore present yourselves before the LORD by your tribes and by your thousands.”

10.zh: 于是，撒母耳使以色列众支派近前来掣签，就掣出便雅悯支派来；
10.en: So Samuel brought all the tribes of Israel near, and the tribe of Benjamin was chosen.

10.zh: 又使便雅悯支派按着宗族近前来，就掣出玛特利族，从其中又掣出基士的儿子扫罗。众人寻找他却寻不着，
10.en: He brought the tribe of Benjamin near by their families and the family of the Matrites was chosen. Then Saul the son of Kish was chosen; but when they looked for him, he could not be found.

10.zh: 就问耶和华说：「那人到这里来了没有？」耶和华说：「他藏在器具中了。」
10.en: Therefore they asked of the LORD further, “Is there yet a man to come here?” The LORD answered, “Behold, he has hidden himself among the baggage.”

10.zh: 众人就跑去从那里领出他来。他站在百姓中间，身体比众民高过一头。
10.en: They ran and got him there. When he stood among the people, he was higher than any of the people from his shoulders and upward.

10.zh: 撒母耳对众民说：「你们看耶和华所拣选的人，众民中有可比他的吗？」众民就大声欢呼说：「愿王万岁！」
10.en: Samuel said to all the people, “Do you see him whom the LORD has chosen, that there is no one like him among all the people?” All the people shouted and said, “Long live the king!”

10.zh: 撒母耳将国法对百姓说明，又记在书上，放在耶和华面前，然后遣散众民，各回各家去了。
10.en: Then Samuel told the people the regulations of the kingdom, and wrote it in a book and laid it up before the LORD. Samuel sent all the people away, every man to his house.

10.zh: 扫罗往基比亚回家去，有　神感动的一群人跟随他。
10.en: Saul also went to his house in Gibeah; and the army went with him, whose hearts God had touched.

10.zh: 但有些匪徒说：「这人怎能救我们呢？」就藐视他，没有送他礼物；扫罗却不理会。
10.en: But certain worthless fellows said, “How could this man save us?” They despised him, and brought him no tribute. But he held his peace.

11.zh: 亚扪人[的王]拿辖上来，对着基列·雅比安营。雅比众人对拿辖说：「你与我们立约，我们就服事你。」
11.en: Then Nahash the Ammonite came up and encamped against Jabesh Gilead; and all the men of Jabesh said to Nahash, “Make a covenant with us, and we will serve you.”

11.zh: 亚扪人拿辖说：「你们若由我剜出你们各人的右眼，以此凌辱以色列众人，我就与你们立约。」
11.en: Nahash the Ammonite said to them, “On this condition I will make it with you, that all your right eyes be gouged out. I will make this dishonor all Israel.”

11.zh: 雅比的长老对他说：「求你宽容我们七日，等我们打发人往以色列的全境去；若没有人救我们，我们就出来归顺你。」
11.en: The elders of Jabesh said to him, “Give us seven days, that we may send messengers to all the borders of Israel; and then, if there is no one to save us, we will come out to you.”

11.zh: 使者到了扫罗住的基比亚，将这话说给百姓听，百姓就都放声而哭。
11.en: Then the messengers came to Gibeah of Saul, and spoke these words in the ears of the people, then all the people lifted up their voice and wept.

11.zh: 扫罗正从田间赶牛回来，问说：「百姓为什么哭呢？」众人将雅比人的话告诉他。
11.en: Behold, Saul came following the oxen out of the field; and Saul said, “What ails the people that they weep?” They told him the words of the men of Jabesh.

11.zh: 扫罗听见这话，就被　神的灵大大感动，甚是发怒。
11.en: God’s Spirit came mightily on Saul when he heard those words, and his anger burned hot.

11.zh: 他将一对牛切成块子，托付使者传送以色列的全境，说：「凡不出来跟随扫罗和撒母耳的，也必这样切开他的牛。」于是耶和华使百姓惧怕，他们就都出来，如同一人。
11.en: He took a yoke of oxen and cut them in pieces, then sent them throughout all the borders of Israel by the hand of messengers, saying, “Whoever doesn’t come out after Saul and after Samuel, so shall it be done to his oxen.” The dread of the LORD fell on the people, and they came out as one man.

11.zh: 扫罗在比色数点他们：以色列人有三十万，犹大人有三万。
11.en: He counted them in Bezek; and the children of Israel were three hundred thousand, and the men of Judah thirty thousand.

11.zh: 众人对那使者说：「你们要回复基列·雅比人说，明日太阳近午的时候，你们必得解救。」使者回去告诉雅比人，他们就欢喜了。
11.en: They said to the messengers who came, “Tell the men of Jabesh Gilead, ‘Tomorrow, by the time the sun is hot, you will be rescued.’” The messengers came and told the men of Jabesh; and they were glad.

11.zh: 于是雅比人对亚扪人说：「明日我们出来归顺你们，你们可以随意待我们。」
11.en: Therefore the men of Jabesh said, “Tomorrow we will come out to you, and you shall do with us all that seems good to you.”

11.zh: 第二日，扫罗将百姓分为三队，在晨更的时候入了亚扪人的营，击杀他们直到太阳近午，剩下的人都逃散，没有二人同在一处的。
11.en: On the next day, Saul put the people in three companies; and they came into the middle of the camp in the morning watch, and struck the Ammonites until the heat of the day. Those who remained were scattered, so that no two of them were left together.

11.zh: 百姓对撒母耳说：「那说『扫罗岂能管理我们』的是谁呢？可以将他交出来，我们好杀死他。」
11.en: The people said to Samuel, “Who is he who said, ‘Shall Saul reign over us?’ Bring those men, that we may put them to death!”

11.zh: 扫罗说：「今日耶和华在以色列中施行拯救，所以不可杀人。」
11.en: Saul said, “No man shall be put to death today; for today the LORD has rescued Israel.”

11.zh: 撒母耳对百姓说：「我们要往吉甲去，在那里立国。」
11.en: Then Samuel said to the people, “Come! Let’s go to Gilgal, and renew the kingdom there.”

11.zh: 众百姓就到了吉甲那里，在耶和华面前立扫罗为王，又在耶和华面前献平安祭。扫罗和以色列众人大大欢喜。
11.en: All the people went to Gilgal; and there they made Saul king before the LORD in Gilgal. There they offered sacrifices of peace offerings before the LORD; and there Saul and all the men of Israel rejoiced greatly.

12.zh: 撒母耳对以色列众人说：「你们向我所求的，我已应允了，为你们立了一个王；
12.en: Samuel said to all Israel, “Behold, I have listened to your voice in all that you said to me, and have made a king over you.

12.zh: 现在有这王在你们前面行。我已年老发白，我的儿子都在你们这里。我从幼年直到今日都在你们前面行。
12.en: Now, behold, the king walks before you. I am old and gray-headed. Behold, my sons are with you. I have walked before you from my youth to this day.

12.zh: 我在这里，你们要在耶和华和他的受膏者面前给我作见证。我夺过谁的牛，抢过谁的驴，欺负过谁，虐待过谁，从谁手里受过贿赂因而眼瞎呢？若有，我必偿还。」
12.en: Here I am. Witness against me before the LORD and before his anointed. Whose ox have I taken? Whose donkey have I taken? Whom have I defrauded? Whom have I oppressed? Of whose hand have I taken a bribe to make me blind my eyes? I will restore it to you.”

12.zh: 众人说：「你未曾欺负我们，虐待我们，也未曾从谁手里受过什么。」
12.en: They said, “You have not defrauded us, nor oppressed us, neither have you taken anything from anyone’s hand.”

12.zh: 撒母耳对他们说：「你们在我手里没有找着什么，有耶和华和他的受膏者今日为证。」他们说：「愿他为证。」
12.en: He said to them, “The LORD is witness against you, and his anointed is witness today, that you have not found anything in my hand.” They said, “He is witness.”

12.zh: 撒母耳对百姓说：「从前立摩西、亚伦，又领你们列祖出埃及地的是耶和华。
12.en: Samuel said to the people, “It is the LORD who appointed Moses and Aaron, and that brought your fathers up out of the land of Egypt.

12.zh: 现在你们要站住，等我在耶和华面前对你们讲论耶和华向你们和你们列祖所行一切公义的事。
12.en: Now therefore stand still, that I may plead with you before the LORD concerning all the righteous acts of the LORD, which he did to you and to your fathers.

12.zh: 从前雅各到了埃及，后来你们列祖呼求耶和华，耶和华就差遣摩西、亚伦领你们列祖出埃及，使他们在这地方居住。
12.en: “When Jacob had come into Egypt, and your fathers cried to the LORD, then the LORD sent Moses and Aaron, who brought your fathers out of Egypt, and made them to dwell in this place.

12.zh: 他们却忘记耶和华—他们的　神，他就把他们付与夏琐将军西西拉的手里，和非利士人并摩押王的手里。于是这些人常来攻击他们。
12.en: But they forgot the LORD their God; and he sold them into the hand of Sisera, captain of the army of Hazor, and into the hand of the Philistines, and into the hand of the king of Moab; and they fought against them.

12.zh: 他们就呼求耶和华说：『我们离弃耶和华，事奉巴力和亚斯她录，是有罪了。现在求你救我们脱离仇敌的手，我们必事奉你。』
12.en: They cried to the LORD, and said, ‘We have sinned, because we have forsaken the LORD and have served the Baals and the Ashtaroth; but now deliver us out of the hand of our enemies, and we will serve you.’

12.zh: 耶和华就差遣耶路·巴力、比但、耶弗他、撒母耳救你们脱离四围仇敌的手，你们才安然居住。
12.en: The LORD sent Jerubbaal, Bedan, Jephthah, and Samuel, and delivered you out of the hand of your enemies on every side; and you lived in safety.

12.zh: 你们见亚扪人的王拿辖来攻击你们，就对我说：『我们定要一个王治理我们。』其实耶和华—你们的　神是你们的王。
12.en: “When you saw that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon came against you, you said to me, ‘No, but a king shall reign over us,’ when the LORD your God was your king.

12.zh: 现在，你们所求所选的王在这里。看哪，耶和华已经为你们立王了。
12.en: Now therefore see the king whom you have chosen and whom you have asked for. Behold, the LORD has set a king over you.

12.zh: 你们若敬畏耶和华，事奉他，听从他的话，不违背他的命令，你们和治理你们的王也都顺从耶和华—你们的　神就好了。
12.en: If you will fear the LORD, and serve him, and listen to his voice, and not rebel against the commandment of the LORD, then both you and also the king who reigns over you are followers of the LORD your God.

12.zh: 倘若不听从耶和华的话，违背他的命令，耶和华的手必攻击你们，像从前攻击你们列祖一样。
12.en: But if you will not listen to the LORD’s voice, but rebel against the commandment of the LORD, then the LORD’s hand will be against you, as it was against your fathers.

12.zh: 现在你们要站住，看耶和华在你们眼前要行一件大事。
12.en: “Now therefore stand still and see this great thing, which the LORD will do before your eyes.

12.zh: 这不是割麦子的时候吗？我求告耶和华，他必打雷降雨，使你们又知道又看出，你们求立王的事是在耶和华面前犯大罪了。」
12.en: Isn’t it wheat harvest today? I will call to the LORD, that he may send thunder and rain; and you will know and see that your wickedness is great, which you have done in the LORD’s sight, in asking for a king.”

12.zh: 于是撒母耳求告耶和华，耶和华就在这日打雷降雨，众民便甚惧怕耶和华和撒母耳。
12.en: So Samuel called to the LORD, and the LORD sent thunder and rain that day. Then all the people greatly feared the LORD and Samuel.

12.zh: 众民对撒母耳说：「求你为仆人们祷告耶和华—你的　神，免得我们死亡，因为我们求立王的事正是罪上加罪了。」
12.en: All the people said to Samuel, “Pray for your servants to the LORD your God, that we not die; for we have added to all our sins this evil, to ask for a king.”

12.zh: 撒母耳对百姓说：「不要惧怕！你们虽然行了这恶，却不要偏离耶和华，只要尽心事奉他。
12.en: Samuel said to the people, “Don’t be afraid. You have indeed done all this evil; yet don’t turn away from following the LORD, but serve the LORD with all your heart.

12.zh: 若偏离[耶和华]去顺从那不能救人的虚神是无益的。
12.en: Don’t turn away to go after vain things which can’t profit or deliver, for they are vain.

12.zh: 耶和华既喜悦选你们作他的子民，就必因他的大名不撇弃你们。
12.en: For the LORD will not forsake his people for his great name’s sake, because it has pleased the LORD to make you a people for himself.

12.zh: 至于我，断不停止为你们祷告，以致得罪耶和华。我必以善道正路指教你们。
12.en: Moreover, as for me, far be it from me that I should sin against the LORD in ceasing to pray for you; but I will instruct you in the good and the right way.

12.zh: 只要你们敬畏耶和华，诚诚实实地尽心事奉他，想念他向你们所行的事何等大。
12.en: Only fear the LORD, and serve him in truth with all your heart; for consider what great things he has done for you.

12.zh: 你们若仍然作恶，你们和你们的王必一同灭亡。」
12.en: But if you keep doing evil, you will be consumed, both you and your king.”

13.zh: 扫罗登基年[四十岁]；作以色列王二年的时候，
13.en: Saul was thirty years old when he became king, and he reigned over Israel forty-two years.

13.zh: 就从以色列中拣选了三千人：二千跟随扫罗在密抹和伯特利山，一千跟随约拿单在便雅悯的基比亚；其余的人扫罗都打发各回各家去了。
13.en: Saul chose for himself three thousand men of Israel, of which two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and in the Mount of Bethel, and one thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin. He sent the rest of the people to their own tents.

13.zh: 约拿单攻击在迦巴的非利士人的防营，非利士人听见了。扫罗就在遍地吹角，意思说，要使希伯来人听见。
13.en: Jonathan struck the garrison of the Philistines that was in Geba, and the Philistines heard of it. Saul blew the trumpet throughout all the land, saying, “Let the Hebrews hear!”

13.zh: 以色列众人听见扫罗攻击非利士人的防营，又听见以色列人为非利士人所憎恶，就跟随扫罗聚集在吉甲。
13.en: All Israel heard that Saul had struck the garrison of the Philistines, and also that Israel was considered an abomination to the Philistines. The people were gathered together after Saul to Gilgal.

13.zh: 非利士人聚集，要与以色列人争战，有车三万辆，马兵六千，步兵像海边的沙那样多，就上来在伯·亚文东边的密抹安营。
13.en: The Philistines assembled themselves together to fight with Israel: thirty thousand chariots, six thousand horsemen, and people as the sand which is on the seashore in multitude. They came up and encamped in Michmash, eastward of Beth Aven.

13.zh: 以色列百姓见自己危急窘迫，就藏在山洞、丛林、石穴、隐密处，和坑中。
13.en: When the men of Israel saw that they were in trouble (for the people were distressed), then the people hid themselves in caves, in thickets, in rocks, in tombs, and in pits.

13.zh: 有些希伯来人过了约旦河，逃到迦得和基列地。扫罗还是在吉甲，百姓都战战兢兢地跟随他。
13.en: Now some of the Hebrews had gone over the Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead; but as for Saul, he was yet in Gilgal, and all the people followed him trembling.

13.zh: 扫罗照着撒母耳所定的日期等了七日。撒母耳还没有来到吉甲，百姓也离开扫罗散去了。
13.en: He stayed seven days, according to the time set by Samuel; but Samuel didn’t come to Gilgal, and the people were scattering from him.

13.zh: 扫罗说：「把燔祭和平安祭带到我这里来。」扫罗就献上燔祭。
13.en: Saul said, “Bring the burnt offering to me here, and the peace offerings.” He offered the burnt offering.

13.zh: 刚献完燔祭，撒母耳就到了。扫罗出去迎接他，要问他好。
13.en: It came to pass that as soon as he had finished offering the burnt offering, behold, Samuel came; and Saul went out to meet him, that he might greet him.

13.zh: 撒母耳说：「你做的是什么事呢？」扫罗说：「因为我见百姓离开我散去，你也不照所定的日期来到，而且非利士人聚集在密抹。
13.en: Samuel said, “What have you done?” Saul said, “Because I saw that the people were scattered from me, and that you didn’t come within the days appointed, and that the Philistines assembled themselves together at Michmash,

13.zh: 所以我心里说：恐怕我没有祷告耶和华。非利士人下到吉甲攻击我，我就勉强献上燔祭。」
13.en: therefore I said, ‘Now the Philistines will come down on me to Gilgal, and I haven’t entreated the favor of the LORD.’ I forced myself therefore, and offered the burnt offering.”

13.zh: 撒母耳对扫罗说：「你做了糊涂事了，没有遵守耶和华—你　神所吩咐你的命令。若遵守，耶和华必在以色列中坚立你的王位，直到永远。
13.en: Samuel said to Saul, “You have done foolishly. You have not kept the commandment of the LORD your God, which he commanded you; for now the LORD would have established your kingdom on Israel forever.

13.zh: 现在你的王位必不长久。耶和华已经寻着一个合他心意的人，立他作百姓的君，因为你没有遵守耶和华所吩咐你的。」
13.en: But now your kingdom will not continue. The LORD has sought for himself a man after his own heart, and the LORD has appointed him to be prince over his people, because you have not kept that which the LORD commanded you.”

13.zh: 撒母耳就起来，从吉甲上到便雅悯的基比亚。 扫罗数点跟随他的，约有六百人。
13.en: Samuel arose, and went from Gilgal to Gibeah of Benjamin. Saul counted the people who were present with him, about six hundred men.

13.zh: 扫罗和他儿子约拿单，并跟随他们的人，都住在便雅悯的迦巴；但非利士人安营在密抹。
13.en: Saul, and Jonathan his son, and the people who were present with them, stayed in Geba of Benjamin; but the Philistines encamped in Michmash.

13.zh: 有掠兵从非利士营中出来，分为三队：一队往俄弗拉向书亚地去，
13.en: The raiders came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies: one company turned to the way that leads to Ophrah, to the land of Shual;

13.zh: 一队往伯·和 去，一队往洗波音谷对面的地境向旷野去。
13.en: another company turned the way to Beth Horon; and another company turned the way of the border that looks down on the valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness.

13.zh: 那时，以色列全地没有一个铁匠；因为非利士人说，恐怕希伯来人制造刀枪。
13.en: Now there was no blacksmith found throughout all the land of Israel, for the Philistines said, “Lest the Hebrews make themselves swords or spears”;

13.zh: 以色列人要磨锄、犁、斧、铲，就下到非利士人那里去磨。
13.en: but all the Israelites went down to the Philistines, each man to sharpen his own plowshare, mattock, ax, and sickle.

13.zh: 但有锉可以锉铲、犁、三齿叉、斧子，并赶牛锥。
13.en: The price was one payim each to sharpen mattocks, plowshares, pitchforks, axes, and goads.

13.zh: 所以到了争战的日子，跟随扫罗和约拿单的人没有一个手里有刀有枪的，惟独扫罗和他儿子约拿单有。
13.en: So it came to pass in the day of battle that neither sword nor spear was found in the hand of any of the people who were with Saul and Jonathan; but Saul and Jonathan his son had them.

13.zh: 非利士人的一队防兵到了密抹的隘口。
13.en: The garrison of the Philistines went out to the pass of Michmash.

14.zh: 有一日，扫罗的儿子约拿单对拿他兵器的少年人说：「我们不如过到那边，到非利士人的防营那里去。」但他没有告诉父亲。
14.en: Now it happened on a day that Jonathan the son of Saul said to the young man who bore his armor, “Come! Let’s go over to the Philistines’ garrison that is on the other side.” But he didn’t tell his father.

14.zh: 扫罗在基比亚的尽边，坐在米矶 的石榴树下，跟随他的约有六百人。
14.en: Saul stayed in the uttermost part of Gibeah under the pomegranate tree which is in Migron; and the people who were with him were about six hundred men,

14.zh: 在那里有亚希突的儿子亚希亚，穿着以弗得。（亚希突是以迦博的哥哥，非尼哈的儿子，以利的孙子。以利从前在示罗作耶和华的祭司。）约拿单去了，百姓却不知道。
14.en: including Ahijah the son of Ahitub, Ichabod’s brother, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eli the priest of the LORD in Shiloh, wearing an ephod. The people didn’t know that Jonathan was gone.

14.zh: 约拿单要从隘口过到非利士防营那里去。这隘口两边各有一个山峰：一名播薛，一名西尼；
14.en: Between the passes, by which Jonathan sought to go over to the Philistines’ garrison, there was a rocky crag on the one side and a rocky crag on the other side; and the name of the one was Bozez, and the name of the other Seneh.

14.zh: 一峰向北，与密抹相对，一峰向南，与迦巴相对。
14.en: The one crag rose up on the north in front of Michmash, and the other on the south in front of Geba.

14.zh: 约拿单对拿兵器的少年人说：「我们不如过到未受割礼人的防营那里去，或者耶和华为我们施展能力；因为耶和华使人得胜，不在乎人多人少。」
14.en: Jonathan said to the young man who bore his armor, “Come! Let’s go over to the garrison of these uncircumcised. It may be that the LORD will work for us, for there is no restraint on the LORD to save by many or by few.”

14.zh: 拿兵器的对他说：「随你的心意行吧。你可以上去，我必跟随你，与你同心。」
14.en: His armor bearer said to him, “Do all that is in your heart. Go, and behold, I am with you according to your heart.”

14.zh: 约拿单说：「我们要过到那些人那里去，使他们看见我们。
14.en: Then Jonathan said, “Behold, we will pass over to the men, and we will reveal ourselves to them.

14.zh: 他们若对我们说：『你们站住，等我们到你们那里去』，我们就站住，不上他们那里去。
14.en: If they say this to us, ‘Wait until we come to you!’ then we will stand still in our place and will not go up to them.

14.zh: 他们若说：『你们上到我们这里来』，这话就是我们的证据；我们便上去，因为耶和华将他们交在我们手里了。」
14.en: But if they say this, ‘Come up to us!’ then we will go up, for the LORD has delivered them into our hand. This shall be the sign to us.”

14.zh: 二人就使非利士的防兵看见。非利士人说：「希伯来人从所藏的洞穴里出来了！」
14.en: Both of them revealed themselves to the garrison of the Philistines; and the Philistines said, “Behold, the Hebrews are coming out of the holes where they had hidden themselves!”

14.zh: 防兵对约拿单和拿兵器的人说：「你们上到这里来，我们有一件事指示你们。」约拿单就对拿兵器的人说：「你跟随我上去，因为耶和华将他们交在以色列人手里了。」
14.en: The men of the garrison answered Jonathan and his armor bearer, and said, “Come up to us, and we will show you something!” Jonathan said to his armor bearer, “Come up after me, for the LORD has delivered them into the hand of Israel.”

14.zh: 约拿单就爬上去，拿兵器的人跟随他。约拿单杀倒非利士人，拿兵器的人也随着杀他们。
14.en: Jonathan climbed up on his hands and on his feet, and his armor bearer after him, and they fell before Jonathan; and his armor bearer killed them after him.

14.zh: 约拿单和拿兵器的人起头所杀的约有二十人，都在一亩地的半犁沟之内。
14.en: That first slaughter, which Jonathan and his armor bearer made, was about twenty men, within as it were half a furrow’s length in an acre of land.

14.zh: 于是在营中、在田野、在众民内都有战兢，防兵和掠兵也都战兢，地也震动，战兢之势甚大。
14.en: There was a trembling in the camp, in the field, and among all the people; the garrison and the raiders also trembled; and the earth quaked, so there was an exceedingly great trembling.

14.zh: 在便雅悯的基比亚，扫罗的守望兵看见非利士的军众溃散，四围乱窜。
14.en: The watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked; and behold, the multitude melted away and scattered.

14.zh: 扫罗就对跟随他的民说：「你们查点查点，看从我们这里出去的是谁？」他们一查点，就知道约拿单和拿兵器的人没有在这里。
14.en: Then Saul said to the people who were with him, “Count now, and see who is missing from us.” When they had counted, behold, Jonathan and his armor bearer were not there.

14.zh: 那时　神的[约]柜在以色列人那里。扫罗对亚希亚说：「你将　神的[约]柜运了来。」
14.en: Saul said to Ahijah, “Bring God’s ark here.” For God’s ark was with the children of Israel at that time.

14.zh: 扫罗正与祭司说话的时候，非利士营中的喧嚷越发大了；扫罗就对祭司说：「停手吧！」
14.en: While Saul talked to the priest, the tumult that was in the camp of the Philistines went on and increased; and Saul said to the priest, “Withdraw your hand!”

14.zh: 扫罗和跟随他的人都聚集，来到战场，看见非利士人用刀互相击杀，大大惶乱。
14.en: Saul and all the people who were with him were gathered together, and came to the battle; and behold, they were all striking each other with their swords in very great confusion.

14.zh: 从前由四方来跟随非利士军的希伯来人现在也转过来，帮助跟随扫罗和约拿单的以色列人了。
14.en: Now the Hebrews who were with the Philistines before and who went up with them into the camp from all around, even they also turned to be with the Israelites who were with Saul and Jonathan.

14.zh: 那藏在以法莲山地的以色列人听说非利士人逃跑，就出来紧紧地追杀他们。
14.en: Likewise all the men of Israel who had hidden themselves in the hill country of Ephraim, when they heard that the Philistines fled, even they also followed hard after them in the battle.

14.zh: 那日，耶和华使以色列人得胜，一直战到伯·亚文。
14.en: So the LORD saved Israel that day; and the battle passed over by Beth Aven.

14.zh: 扫罗叫百姓起誓说，凡不等到晚上向敌人报完了仇吃什么的，必受咒诅。因此这日百姓没有吃什么，就极其困惫。
14.en: The men of Israel were distressed that day; for Saul had adjured the people, saying, “Cursed is the man who eats any food until it is evening, and I am avenged of my enemies.” So none of the people tasted food.

14.zh: 众民进入树林，见有蜜在地上。
14.en: All the people came into the forest; and there was honey on the ground.

14.zh: 他们进了树林，见有蜜流下来，却没有人敢用手[取蜜]入口，因为他们怕那誓言。
14.en: When the people had come to the forest, behold, honey was dripping, but no one put his hand to his mouth, for the people feared the oath.

14.zh: 约拿单没有听见他父亲叫百姓起誓，所以伸手中的杖，用杖头蘸在蜂房里，转手送入口内，眼睛就明亮了。
14.en: But Jonathan didn’t hear when his father commanded the people with the oath. Therefore he put out the end of the rod that was in his hand and dipped it in the honeycomb, and put his hand to his mouth; and his eyes brightened.

14.zh: 百姓中有一人对他说：「你父亲曾叫百姓严严地起誓说，今日吃什么的，必受咒诅；因此百姓就疲乏了。」
14.en: Then one of the people answered, and said, “Your father directly commanded the people with an oath, saying, ‘Cursed is the man who eats food today.’” So the people were faint.

14.zh: 约拿单说：「我父亲连累你们了。你看，我尝了这一点蜜，眼睛就明亮了。
14.en: Then Jonathan said, “My father has troubled the land. Please look how my eyes have brightened because I tasted a little of this honey.

14.zh: 今日百姓若任意吃了从仇敌所夺的物，击杀的非利士人岂不更多吗？」
14.en: How much more, if perhaps the people had eaten freely today of the plunder of their enemies which they found? For now there has been no great slaughter among the Philistines.”

14.zh: 这日，以色列人击杀非利士人，从密抹直到亚雅 。百姓甚是疲乏，
14.en: They struck the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon. The people were very faint;

14.zh: 就急忙将所夺的牛羊和牛犊宰于地上，肉还带血就吃了。
14.en: and the people pounced on the plunder, and took sheep, cattle, and calves, and killed them on the ground; and the people ate them with the blood.

14.zh: 有人告诉扫罗说：「百姓吃带血的肉，得罪耶和华了。」扫罗说：「你们有罪了，今日要将大石头滚到我这里来。」
14.en: Then they told Saul, saying, “Behold, the people are sinning against the LORD, in that they eat meat with the blood.” He said, “You have dealt treacherously. Roll a large stone to me today!”

14.zh: 扫罗又说：「你们散在百姓中，对他们说，你们各人将牛羊牵到我这里来宰了吃，不可吃带血的肉得罪耶和华。」这夜，百姓就把牛羊牵到那里宰了。
14.en: Saul said, “Disperse yourselves among the people, and tell them, ‘Every man bring me here his ox, and every man his sheep, and kill them here, and eat; and don’t sin against the LORD in eating meat with the blood.’” All the people brought every man his ox with him that night, and killed them there.

14.zh: 扫罗为耶和华筑了一座坛，这是他初次为耶和华筑的坛。
14.en: Saul built an altar to the LORD. This was the first altar that he built to the LORD.

14.zh: 扫罗说：「我们不如夜里下去追赶非利士人，抢掠他们，直到天亮，不留他们一人。」众民说：「你看怎样好就去行吧！」祭司说：「我们先当亲近　神。」
14.en: Saul said, “Let’s go down after the Philistines by night, and take plunder among them until the morning light. Let’s not leave a man of them.” They said, “Do whatever seems good to you.” Then the priest said, “Let’s draw near here to God.”

14.zh: 扫罗求问　神说：「我下去追赶非利士人可以不可以？你将他们交在以色列人手里不交？」这日　神没有回答他。
14.en: Saul asked counsel of God: “Shall I go down after the Philistines? Will you deliver them into the hand of Israel?” But he didn’t answer him that day.

14.zh: 扫罗说：「你们百姓中的长老都上这里来，查明今日是谁犯了罪。
14.en: Saul said, “Draw near here, all you chiefs of the people, and know and see in whom this sin has been today.

14.zh: 我指着救以色列—永生的耶和华起誓，就是我儿子约拿单犯了罪，他也必死。」但百姓中无一人回答他。
14.en: For as the LORD lives, who saves Israel, though it is in Jonathan my son, he shall surely die.” But there was not a man among all the people who answered him.

14.zh: 扫罗就对以色列众人说：「你们站在一边，我与我儿子约拿单也站在一边。」百姓对扫罗说：「你看怎样好就去行吧！」
14.en: Then he said to all Israel, “You be on one side, and I and Jonathan my son will be on the other side.” The people said to Saul, “Do what seems good to you.”

14.zh: 扫罗祷告耶和华—以色列的　神说：「求你指示实情。」于是[掣签]掣出扫罗和约拿单来；百姓尽都无事。
14.en: Therefore Saul said to the LORD, the God of Israel, “Show the right.” Jonathan and Saul were chosen, but the people escaped.

14.zh: 扫罗说：「你们再[掣签]，看是我，是我儿子约拿单」，就掣出约拿单来。
14.en: Saul said, “Cast lots between me and Jonathan my son.” Jonathan was selected.

14.zh: 扫罗对约拿单说：「你告诉我，你做了什么事？」约拿单说：「我实在以手里的杖，用杖头蘸了一点蜜尝了一尝。这样我就死吗？」
14.en: Then Saul said to Jonathan, “Tell me what you have done!” Jonathan told him, and said, “I certainly did taste a little honey with the end of the rod that was in my hand; and behold, I must die.”

14.zh: 扫罗说：「约拿单哪，你定要死！若不然，愿　神重重地降罚与我。」
14.en: Saul said, “God do so and more also; for you shall surely die, Jonathan.”

14.zh: 百姓对扫罗说：「约拿单在以色列人中这样大行拯救，岂可使他死呢？断乎不可！我们指着永生的耶和华起誓，连他的一根头发也不可落地，因为他今日与　神一同做事。」于是百姓救约拿单免了死亡。
14.en: The people said to Saul, “Shall Jonathan die, who has worked this great salvation in Israel? Far from it! As the LORD lives, there shall not one hair of his head fall to the ground, for he has worked with God today!” So the people rescued Jonathan, so he didn’t die.

14.zh: 扫罗回去，不追赶非利士人；非利士人也回本地去了。
14.en: Then Saul went up from following the Philistines; and the Philistines went to their own place.

14.zh: 扫罗执掌以色列的国权，常常攻击他四围的一切仇敌，就是摩押人、亚扪人、以东人，和琐巴诸王，并非利士人。他无论往何处去，都打败仇敌。
14.en: Now when Saul had taken the kingdom over Israel, he fought against all his enemies on every side: against Moab, and against the children of Ammon, and against Edom, and against the kings of Zobah, and against the Philistines. Wherever he turned himself, he defeated them.

14.zh: 扫罗奋勇攻击亚玛力人，救了以色列人脱离抢掠他们之人的手。
14.en: He did valiantly and struck the Amalekites, and delivered Israel out of the hands of those who plundered them.

14.zh: 扫罗的儿子是约拿单、亦施韦、麦基舒亚。他的两个女儿：长女名米拉，次女名米甲。
14.en: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan, Ishvi, and Malchishua; and the names of his two daughters were these: the name of the firstborn Merab, and the name of the younger Michal.

14.zh: 扫罗的妻名叫亚希暖，是亚希玛斯的女儿。扫罗的元帅名叫押尼珥，是尼珥的儿子；尼珥是扫罗的叔叔。
14.en: The name of Saul’s wife was Ahinoam the daughter of Ahimaaz. The name of the captain of his army was Abner the son of Ner, Saul’s uncle.

14.zh: 扫罗的父亲基士，押尼珥的父亲尼珥，都是亚别的儿子。
14.en: Kish was the father of Saul, and Ner the father of Abner was the son of Abiel.

14.zh: 扫罗平生常与非利士人大大争战。扫罗遇见有能力的人或勇士，都招募了来跟随他。
14.en: There was severe war against the Philistines all the days of Saul; and when Saul saw any mighty man or any valiant man, he took him into his service.

15.zh: 撒母耳对扫罗说：「耶和华差遣我膏你为王，治理他的百姓以色列；所以你当听从耶和华的话。
15.en: Samuel said to Saul, “The LORD sent me to anoint you to be king over his people, over Israel. Now therefore listen to the voice of the LORD’s words.

15.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说：『以色列人出埃及的时候，在路上亚玛力人怎样待他们，怎样抵挡他们，我都没忘。
15.en: The LORD of Armies says, ‘I remember what Amalek did to Israel, how he set himself against him on the way when he came up out of Egypt.

15.zh: 现在你要去击打亚玛力人，灭尽他们所有的，不可怜惜他们，将男女、孩童、吃奶的，并牛、羊、骆驼，和驴尽行杀死。』」
15.en: Now go and strike Amalek, and utterly destroy all that they have, and don’t spare them; but kill both man and woman, infant and nursing baby, ox and sheep, camel and donkey.’”

15.zh: 于是扫罗招聚百姓在提拉因，数点他们，共有步兵二十万，另有犹大人一万。
15.en: Saul summoned the people, and counted them in Telaim, two hundred thousand footmen and ten thousand men of Judah.

15.zh: 扫罗到了亚玛力的[京]城，在谷中设下埋伏。
15.en: Saul came to the city of Amalek, and set an ambush in the valley.

15.zh: 扫罗对基尼人说：「你们离开亚玛力人下去吧，恐怕我将你们和亚玛力人一同杀灭；因为以色列人出埃及的时候，你们曾恩待他们。」于是基尼人离开亚玛力人去了。
15.en: Saul said to the Kenites, “Go, depart, go down from among the Amalekites, lest I destroy you with them; for you showed kindness to all the children of Israel when they came up out of Egypt.” So the Kenites departed from among the Amalekites.

15.zh: 扫罗击打亚玛力人，从哈腓拉直到埃及前的书珥，
15.en: Saul struck the Amalekites, from Havilah as you go to Shur, which is before Egypt.

15.zh: 生擒了亚玛力王亚甲，用刀杀尽亚玛力的众民。
15.en: He took Agag the king of the Amalekites alive, and utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword.

15.zh: 扫罗和百姓却怜惜亚甲，也爱惜上好的牛、羊、牛犊、羊羔，并一切美物，不肯灭绝。凡下贱瘦弱的，尽都杀了。
15.en: But Saul and the people spared Agag and the best of the sheep, of the cattle, of the fat calves, of the lambs, and all that was good, and were not willing to utterly destroy them; but everything that was vile and refuse, that they destroyed utterly.

15.zh: 耶和华的话临到撒母耳说：
15.en: Then the LORD’s word came to Samuel, saying,

15.zh: 「我立扫罗为王，我后悔了；因为他转去不跟从我，不遵守我的命令。」撒母耳便甚忧愁，终夜哀求耶和华。
15.en: “It grieves me that I have set up Saul to be king, for he has turned back from following me, and has not performed my commandments.” Samuel was angry; and he cried to the LORD all night.

15.zh: 撒母耳清早起来，迎接扫罗。有人告诉撒母耳说：「扫罗到了迦密，在那里立了纪念碑，又转身下到吉甲。」
15.en: Samuel rose early to meet Saul in the morning; and Samuel was told, saying, “Saul came to Carmel, and behold, he set up a monument for himself, turned, passed on, and went down to Gilgal.”

15.zh: 撒母耳到了扫罗那里，扫罗对他说：「愿耶和华赐福与你，耶和华的命令我已遵守了。」
15.en: Samuel came to Saul; and Saul said to him, “You are blessed by the LORD! I have performed the commandment of the LORD.”

15.zh: 撒母耳说：「我耳中听见有羊叫、牛鸣，是从哪里来的呢？」
15.en: Samuel said, “Then what does this bleating of the sheep in my ears and the lowing of the cattle which I hear mean?”

15.zh: 扫罗说：「这是百姓从亚玛力人那里带来的；因为他们爱惜上好的牛羊，要献与耶和华—你的　神；其余的，我们都灭尽了。」
15.en: Saul said, “They have brought them from the Amalekites; for the people spared the best of the sheep and of the cattle, to sacrifice to the LORD your God. We have utterly destroyed the rest.”

15.zh: 撒母耳对扫罗说：「你住口吧！等我将耶和华昨夜向我所说的话告诉你。」扫罗说：「请讲。」
15.en: Then Samuel said to Saul, “Stay, and I will tell you what the LORD said to me last night.” He said to him, “Say on.”

15.zh: 撒母耳对扫罗说：「从前你虽然以自己为小，岂不是被立为以色列支派的元首吗？耶和华膏你作以色列的王。
15.en: Samuel said, “Though you were little in your own sight, weren’t you made the head of the tribes of Israel? The LORD anointed you king over Israel;

15.zh: 耶和华差遣你，吩咐你说，你去击打那些犯罪的亚玛力人，将他们灭绝净尽。
15.en: and the LORD sent you on a journey, and said, ‘Go, and utterly destroy the sinners the Amalekites, and fight against them until they are consumed.’

15.zh: 你为何没有听从耶和华的命令，急忙掳掠财物，行耶和华眼中看为恶的事呢？」
15.en: Why then didn’t you obey the LORD’s voice, but took the plunder, and did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight?”

15.zh: 扫罗对撒母耳说：「我实在听从了耶和华的命令，行了耶和华所差遣我行的路，擒了亚玛力王亚甲来，灭尽了亚玛力人。
15.en: Saul said to Samuel, “But I have obeyed the LORD’s voice, and have gone the way which the LORD sent me, and have brought Agag the king of Amalek, and have utterly destroyed the Amalekites.

15.zh: 百姓却在所当灭的物中，取了最好的牛羊，要在吉甲献与耶和华—你的　神。」
15.en: But the people took of the plunder, sheep and cattle, the best of the devoted things, to sacrifice to the LORD your God in Gilgal.”

15.zh: 撒母耳说： 耶和华喜悦燔祭和[平安]祭， 岂如喜悦人听从他的话呢？ 听命胜于献祭； 顺从胜于公羊的脂油。
15.en: Samuel said, “Has the LORD as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying the LORD’s voice? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to listen than the fat of rams.

15.zh: 悖逆的罪与行邪术的罪相等； 顽梗的罪与拜虚神和偶像的罪相同。 你既厌弃耶和华的命令， 耶和华也厌弃你作王。
15.en: For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as idolatry and teraphim. Because you have rejected the LORD’s word, he has also rejected you from being king.”

15.zh: 扫罗对撒母耳说：「我有罪了，我因惧怕百姓，听从他们的话，就违背了耶和华的命令和你的言语。
15.en: Saul said to Samuel, “I have sinned; for I have transgressed the commandment of the LORD and your words, because I feared the people and obeyed their voice.

15.zh: 现在求你赦免我的罪，同我回去，我好敬拜耶和华。」
15.en: Now therefore, please pardon my sin, and turn again with me, that I may worship the LORD.”

15.zh: 撒母耳对扫罗说：「我不同你回去；因为你厌弃耶和华的命令，耶和华也厌弃你作以色列的王。」
15.en: Samuel said to Saul, “I will not return with you; for you have rejected the LORD’s word, and the LORD has rejected you from being king over Israel.”

15.zh: 撒母耳转身要走，扫罗就扯住他外袍的衣襟，衣襟就撕断了。
15.en: As Samuel turned around to go away, Saul grabbed the skirt of his robe, and it tore.

15.zh: 撒母耳对他说：「如此，今日耶和华使以色列国与你断绝，将这国赐与比你更好的人。
15.en: Samuel said to him, “The LORD has torn the kingdom of Israel from you today, and has given it to a neighbor of yours who is better than you.

15.zh: 以色列的大能者必不致说谎，也不致后悔；因为他迥非世人，决不后悔。」
15.en: Also the Strength of Israel will not lie nor repent; for he is not a man, that he should repent.”

15.zh: 扫罗说：「我有罪了，虽然如此，求你在我百姓的长老和以色列人面前抬举我，同我回去，我好敬拜耶和华—你的　神。」
15.en: Then he said, “I have sinned; yet please honor me now before the elders of my people and before Israel, and come back with me, that I may worship the LORD your God.”

15.zh: 于是撒母耳转身跟随扫罗回去，扫罗就敬拜耶和华。
15.en: So Samuel went back with Saul; and Saul worshiped the LORD.

15.zh: 撒母耳说：「要把亚玛力王亚甲带到我这里来。」亚甲就欢欢喜喜地来到他面前，心里说，死亡的苦难必定过去了。
15.en: Then Samuel said, “Bring Agag the king of the Amalekites here to me!” Agag came to him cheerfully. Agag said, “Surely the bitterness of death is past.”

15.zh: 撒母耳说：「你既用刀使妇人丧子，这样，你母亲在妇人中也必丧子。」于是，撒母耳在吉甲耶和华面前将亚甲杀死。
15.en: Samuel said, “As your sword has made women childless, so your mother will be childless among women!” Then Samuel cut Agag in pieces before the LORD in Gilgal.

15.zh: 撒母耳回了拉玛。扫罗上他所住的基比亚，回自己的家去了。
15.en: Then Samuel went to Ramah; and Saul went up to his house to Gibeah of Saul.

15.zh: 撒母耳直到死的日子，再没有见扫罗；但撒母耳为扫罗悲伤，是因耶和华后悔立他为以色列的王。
15.en: Samuel came no more to see Saul until the day of his death, but Samuel mourned for Saul. The LORD grieved that he had made Saul king over Israel.

16.zh: 耶和华对撒母耳说：「我既厌弃扫罗作以色列的王，你为他悲伤要到几时呢？你将膏油盛满了角，我差遣你往伯利恒人耶西那里去；因为我在他众子之内，预定一个作王的。」
