16.en: The LORD said to Samuel, “How long will you mourn for Saul, since I have rejected him from being king over Israel? Fill your horn with oil, and go. I will send you to Jesse the Bethlehemite, for I have provided a king for myself among his sons.”

16.zh: 撒母耳说：「我怎能去呢？扫罗若听见，必要杀我。」耶和华说：「你可以带一只牛犊去，就说：『我来是要向耶和华献祭。』
16.en: Samuel said, “How can I go? If Saul hears it, he will kill me.” The LORD said, “Take a heifer with you, and say, ‘I have come to sacrifice to the LORD.’

16.zh: 你要请耶西来吃祭肉，我就指示你所当行的事。我所指给你的人，你要膏他。」
16.en: Call Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will show you what you shall do. You shall anoint to me him whom I name to you.”

16.zh: 撒母耳就照耶和华的话去行。到了伯利恒，那城里的长老都战战兢兢地出来迎接他，问他说：「你是为平安来的吗？」
16.en: Samuel did that which the LORD spoke, and came to Bethlehem. The elders of the city came to meet him trembling, and said, “Do you come peaceably?”

16.zh: 他说：「为平安来的，我是给耶和华献祭。你们当自洁，来与我同吃祭肉。」撒母耳就使耶西和他众子自洁，请他们来吃祭肉。
16.en: He said, “Peaceably; I have come to sacrifice to the LORD. Sanctify yourselves, and come with me to the sacrifice.” He sanctified Jesse and his sons, and called them to the sacrifice.

16.zh: 他们来的时候，撒母耳看见以 利押，就心里说，耶和华的受膏者必定在他面前。
16.en: When they had come, he looked at Eliab, and said, “Surely the LORD’s anointed is before him.”

16.zh: 耶和华却对撒母耳说：「不要看他的外貌和他身材高大，我不拣选他。因为，[耶和华]不像人看人：人是看外貌；耶和华是看内心。」
16.en: But the LORD said to Samuel, “Don’t look on his face, or on the height of his stature, because I have rejected him; for I don’t see as man sees. For man looks at the outward appearance, but the LORD looks at the heart.”

16.zh: 耶西叫亚比拿达从撒母耳面前经过，撒母耳说：「耶和华也不拣选他。」
16.en: Then Jesse called Abinadab, and made him pass before Samuel. He said, “The LORD has not chosen this one, either.”

16.zh: 耶西又叫沙玛从撒母耳面前经过，撒母耳说：「耶和华也不拣选他。」
16.en: Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by. He said, “The LORD has not chosen this one, either.”

16.zh: 耶西叫他七个儿子都从撒母耳面前经过，撒母耳说：「这都不是耶和华所拣选的。」
16.en: Jesse made seven of his sons to pass before Samuel. Samuel said to Jesse, “The LORD has not chosen these.”

16.zh: 撒母耳对耶西说：「你的儿子都在这里吗？」他回答说：「还有个小的，现在放羊。」撒母耳对耶西说：「你打发人去叫他来；他若不来，我们必不坐席。」
16.en: Samuel said to Jesse, “Are all your children here?” He said, “There remains yet the youngest. Behold, he is keeping the sheep.” Samuel said to Jesse, “Send and get him, for we will not sit down until he comes here.”

16.zh: 耶西就打发人去叫了他来。他面色光红，双目清秀，容貌俊美。耶和华说：「这就是他，你起来膏他。」
16.en: He sent, and brought him in. Now he was ruddy, with a handsome face and good appearance. The LORD said, “Arise! Anoint him, for this is he.”

16.zh: 撒母耳就用角里的膏油，在他诸兄中膏了他。从这日起，耶和华的灵就大大感动大卫。撒母耳起身回拉玛去了。
16.en: Then Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the middle of his brothers. Then the LORD’s Spirit came mightily on David from that day forward. So Samuel rose up and went to Ramah.

16.zh: 耶和华的灵离开扫罗，有恶魔从耶和华那里来扰乱他。
16.en: Now the LORD’s Spirit departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from the LORD troubled him.

16.zh: 扫罗的臣仆对他说：「现在有恶魔从　神那里来扰乱你。
16.en: Saul’s servants said to him, “See now, an evil spirit from God troubles you.

16.zh: 我们的主可以吩咐面前的臣仆，找一个善于弹琴的来，等　神那里来的恶魔临到你身上的时候，使他用手弹琴，你就好了。」
16.en: Let our lord now command your servants who are in front of you to seek out a man who is a skillful player on the harp. Then when the evil spirit from God is on you, he will play with his hand, and you will be well.”

16.zh: 扫罗对臣仆说：「你们可以为我找一个善于弹琴的，带到我这里来。」
16.en: Saul said to his servants, “Provide me now a man who can play well, and bring him to me.”

16.zh: 其中有一个少年人说：「我曾见伯利恒人耶西的一个儿子善于弹琴，是大有勇敢的战士，说话合宜，容貌俊美，耶和华也与他同在。」
16.en: Then one of the young men answered and said, “Behold, I have seen a son of Jesse the Bethlehemite who is skillful in playing, a mighty man of valor, a man of war, prudent in speech, and a handsome person; and the LORD is with him.”

16.zh: 于是扫罗差遣使者去见耶西，说：「请你打发你放羊的儿子大卫到我这里来。」
16.en: Therefore Saul sent messengers to Jesse, and said, “Send me David your son, who is with the sheep.”

16.zh: 耶西就把几个饼和一皮袋酒，并一只山羊羔，都驮在驴上，交给他儿子大卫，送与扫罗。
16.en: Jesse took a donkey loaded with bread, a container of wine, and a young goat, and sent them by David his son to Saul.

16.zh: 大卫到了扫罗那里，就侍立在扫罗面前。扫罗甚喜爱他，他就作了扫罗拿兵器的人。
16.en: David came to Saul and stood before him. He loved him greatly; and he became his armor bearer.

16.zh: 扫罗差遣人去见耶西，说：「求你容大卫侍立在我面前，因为他在我眼前蒙了恩。」
16.en: Saul sent to Jesse, saying, “Please let David stand before me, for he has found favor in my sight.”

16.zh: 从　神那里来的恶魔临到扫罗身上的时候，大卫就拿琴，用手而弹，扫罗便舒畅爽快，恶魔离了他。
16.en: When the spirit from God was on Saul, David took the harp and played with his hand; so Saul was refreshed and was well, and the evil spirit departed from him.

17.zh: 非利士人招聚他们的军旅，要来争战；聚集在属犹大的梭哥，安营在梭哥和亚西加中间的以弗·大悯。
17.en: Now the Philistines gathered together their armies to battle; and they were gathered together at Socoh, which belongs to Judah, and encamped between Socoh and Azekah in Ephesdammim.

17.zh: 扫罗和以色列人也聚集，在以拉谷安营，摆列队伍，要与非利士人打仗。
17.en: Saul and the men of Israel were gathered together, and encamped in the valley of Elah, and set the battle in array against the Philistines.

17.zh: 非利士人站在这边山上，以色列人站在那边山上，当中有谷。
17.en: The Philistines stood on the mountain on the one side, and Israel stood on the mountain on the other side: and there was a valley between them.

17.zh: 从非利士营中出来一个讨战的人，名叫歌利亚，是迦特人，身高六肘零一虎口；
17.en: A champion out of the camp of the Philistines named Goliath of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span went out.

17.zh: 头戴铜盔，身穿铠甲，甲重五千舍客勒；
17.en: He had a helmet of bronze on his head, and he wore a coat of mail; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of bronze.

17.zh: 腿上有铜护膝，两肩之中背负铜戟；
17.en: He had bronze shin armor on his legs and a bronze javelin between his shoulders.

17.zh: 枪杆粗如织布的机轴，铁枪头重六百舍客勒。有一个拿盾牌的人在他前面走。
17.en: The staff of his spear was like a weaver’s beam; and his spear’s head weighed six hundred shekels of iron. His shield bearer went before him.

17.zh: 歌利亚对着以色列的军队站立，呼叫说：「你们出来摆列队伍做什么呢？我不是非利士人吗？你们不是扫罗的仆人吗？可以从你们中间拣选一人，使他下到我这里来。
17.en: He stood and cried to the armies of Israel, and said to them, “Why have you come out to set your battle in array? Am I not a Philistine, and you servants to Saul? Choose a man for yourselves, and let him come down to me.

17.zh: 他若能与我战斗，将我杀死，我们就作你们的仆人；我若胜了他，将他杀死，你们就作我们的仆人，服事我们。」
17.en: If he is able to fight with me and kill me, then will we be your servants; but if I prevail against him and kill him, then you will be our servants and serve us.”

17.zh: 那非利士人又说：「我今日向以色列人的军队骂阵。你们叫一个人出来，与我战斗。」
17.en: The Philistine said, “I defy the armies of Israel today! Give me a man, that we may fight together!”

17.zh: 扫罗和以色列众人听见非利士人的这些话，就惊惶，极其害怕。
17.en: When Saul and all Israel heard those words of the Philistine, they were dismayed and greatly afraid.

17.zh: 大卫是犹大伯利恒的以法他人耶西的儿子。耶西有八个儿子。当扫罗的时候，耶西已经老迈。
17.en: Now David was the son of that Ephrathite of Bethlehem Judah, whose name was Jesse; and he had eight sons. The man was an elderly old man in the days of Saul.

17.zh: 耶西的三个大儿子跟随扫罗出征。这出征的三个儿子：长子名叫以利押，次子名叫亚比拿达，三子名叫沙玛。
17.en: The three oldest sons of Jesse had gone after Saul to the battle; and the names of his three sons who went to the battle were Eliab the firstborn, and next to him Abinadab, and the third Shammah.

17.zh: 大卫是最小的；那三个大儿子跟随扫罗。
17.en: David was the youngest; and the three oldest followed Saul.

17.zh: 大卫有时离开扫罗，回伯利恒放他父亲的羊。
17.en: Now David went back and forth from Saul to feed his father’s sheep at Bethlehem.

17.zh: 那非利士人早晚都出来站着，如此四十日。
17.en: The Philistine came near morning and evening, and presented himself forty days.

17.zh: 一日，耶西对他儿子大卫说：「你拿一伊法烘了的穗子和十个饼，速速地送到营里去，交给你哥哥们；
17.en: Jesse said to David his son, “Now take for your brothers an ephah of this parched grain and these ten loaves, and carry them quickly to the camp to your brothers;

17.zh: 再拿这十块奶饼，送给他们的千夫长，且问你哥哥们好，向他们要一封信来。」
17.en: and bring these ten cheeses to the captain of their thousand; and see how your brothers are doing, and bring back news.”

17.zh: 扫罗与大卫的三个哥哥和以色列众人，在以拉谷与非利士人打仗。
17.en: Now Saul, and they, and all the men of Israel were in the valley of Elah, fighting with the Philistines.

17.zh: 大卫早晨起来，将羊交托一个看守的人，照着他父亲所吩咐的话，带着食物去了。到了辎重营，军兵刚出到战场，呐喊要战。
17.en: David rose up early in the morning and left the sheep with a keeper, and took the provisions and went, as Jesse had commanded him. He came to the place of the wagons as the army which was going out to the fight shouted for the battle.

17.zh: 以色列人和非利士人都摆列队伍，彼此相对。
17.en: Israel and the Philistines put the battle in array, army against army.

17.zh: 大卫把他带来的食物留在看守物件人的手下，跑到战场，问他哥哥们安。
17.en: David left his baggage in the hand of the keeper of the baggage and ran to the army, and came and greeted his brothers.

17.zh: 与他们说话的时候，那讨战的，就是属迦特的非利士人歌利亚，从非利士队中出来，说从前所说的话；大卫都听见了。
17.en: As he talked with them, behold, the champion, the Philistine of Gath, Goliath by name, came up out of the ranks of the Philistines, and said the same words; and David heard them.

17.zh: 以色列众人看见那人，就逃跑，极其害怕。
17.en: All the men of Israel, when they saw the man, fled from him and were terrified.

17.zh: 以色列人彼此说：「这上来的人你看见了吗？他上来是要向以色列人骂阵。若有能杀他的，王必赏赐他大财，将自己的女儿给他为妻，并在以色列人中免他父家纳粮当差。」
17.en: The men of Israel said, “Have you seen this man who has come up? He has surely come up to defy Israel. The king will give great riches to the man who kills him, and will give him his daughter, and will make his father’s house tax-free in Israel.”

17.zh: 大卫问站在旁边的人说：「有人杀这非利士人，除掉以色列人的耻辱，怎样待他呢？这未受割礼的非利士人是谁呢？竟敢向永生　神的军队骂阵吗？」
17.en: David spoke to the men who stood by him, saying, “What shall be done to the man who kills this Philistine and takes away the reproach from Israel? For who is this uncircumcised Philistine, that he should defy the armies of the living God?”

17.zh: 百姓照先前的话回答他说：「有人能杀这非利士人，必如此如此待他。」
17.en: The people answered him in this way, saying, “So shall it be done to the man who kills him.”

17.zh: 大卫的长兄以利押听见大卫与他们所说的话，就向他发怒，说：「你下来做什么呢？在旷野的那几只羊，你交托了谁呢？我知道你的骄傲和你心里的恶意，你下来特为要看争战！」
17.en: Eliab his oldest brother heard when he spoke to the men; and Eliab’s anger burned against David, and he said, “Why have you come down? With whom have you left those few sheep in the wilderness? I know your pride and the evil of your heart; for you have come down that you might see the battle.”

17.zh: 大卫说：「我做了什么呢？我来岂没有缘故吗？」
17.en: David said, “What have I now done? Is there not a cause?”

17.zh: 大卫就离开他转向别人，照先前的话而问；百姓仍照先前的话回答他。
17.en: He turned away from him toward another, and spoke like that again; and the people answered him again the same way.

17.zh: 有人听见大卫所说的话，就告诉了扫罗；扫罗便打发人叫他来。
17.en: When the words were heard which David spoke, they rehearsed them before Saul; and he sent for him.

17.zh: 大卫对扫罗说：「人都不必因那非利士人胆怯。你的仆人要去与那非利士人战斗。」
17.en: David said to Saul, “Let no man’s heart fail because of him. Your servant will go and fight with this Philistine.”

17.zh: 扫罗对大卫说：「你不能去与那非利士人战斗；因为你年纪太轻，他自幼就作战士。」
17.en: Saul said to David, “You are not able to go against this Philistine to fight with him; for you are but a youth, and he a man of war from his youth.”

17.zh: 大卫对扫罗说：「你仆人为父亲放羊，有时来了狮子，有时来了熊，从群中衔一只羊羔去。
17.en: David said to Saul, “Your servant was keeping his father’s sheep; and when a lion or a bear came and took a lamb out of the flock,

17.zh: 我就追赶它，击打它，将羊羔从它口中救出来。它起来要害我，我就揪着它的胡子，将它打死。
17.en: I went out after him, struck him, and rescued it out of his mouth. When he arose against me, I caught him by his beard, struck him, and killed him.

17.zh: 你仆人曾打死狮子和熊，这未受割礼的非利士人向永生　神的军队骂阵，也必像狮子和熊一般。」
17.en: Your servant struck both the lion and the bear. This uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them, since he has defied the armies of the living God.”

17.zh: 大卫又说：「耶和华救我脱离狮子和熊的爪，也必救我脱离这非利士人的手。」扫罗对大卫说：「你可以去吧！耶和华必与你同在。」
17.en: David said, “The LORD, who delivered me out of the paw of the lion and out of the paw of the bear, will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine.” Saul said to David, “Go! The LORD will be with you.”

17.zh: 扫罗就把自己的战衣给大卫穿上，将铜盔给他戴上，又给他穿上铠甲。
17.en: Saul dressed David with his clothing. He put a helmet of bronze on his head, and he clad him with a coat of mail.

17.zh: 大卫把刀跨在战衣外，试试能走不能走；因为素来没有穿惯，就对扫罗说：「我穿戴这些不能走，因为素来没有穿惯。」于是摘脱了。
17.en: David strapped his sword on his clothing and he tried to move, for he had not tested it. David said to Saul, “I can’t go with these, for I have not tested them.” Then David took them off.

17.zh: 他手中拿杖，又在溪中挑选了五块光滑石子，放在袋里，就是牧人带的囊里；手中拿着甩石的机弦，就去迎那非利士人。
17.en: He took his staff in his hand, and chose for himself five smooth stones out of the brook, and put them in the pouch of his shepherd’s bag which he had. His sling was in his hand; and he came near to the Philistine.

17.zh: 非利士人也渐渐地迎着大卫来，拿盾牌的走在前头。
17.en: The Philistine walked and came near to David; and the man who bore the shield went before him.

17.zh: 非利士人观看，见了大卫，就藐视他；因为他年轻，面色光红，容貌俊美。
17.en: When the Philistine looked around and saw David, he disdained him; for he was but a youth, and ruddy, and had a good looking face.

17.zh: 非利士人对大卫说：「你拿杖到我这里来，我岂是狗呢？」非利士人就指着自己的神咒诅大卫。
17.en: The Philistine said to David, “Am I a dog, that you come to me with sticks?” The Philistine cursed David by his gods.

17.zh: 非利士人又对大卫说：「来吧！我将你的肉给空中的飞鸟、田野的走兽吃。」
17.en: The Philistine said to David, “Come to me, and I will give your flesh to the birds of the sky and to the animals of the field.”

17.zh: 大卫对非利士人说：「你来攻击我，是靠着刀枪和[铜]戟；我来攻击你，是靠着万军之耶和华的名，就是你所怒骂带领以色列军队的　神。
17.en: Then David said to the Philistine, “You come to me with a sword, with a spear, and with a javelin; but I come to you in the name of the LORD of Armies, the God of the armies of Israel, whom you have defied.

17.zh: 今日耶和华必将你交在我手里。我必杀你，斩你的头，又将非利士军兵的尸首给空中的飞鸟、地上的野兽吃，使普天下的人都知道以色列中有　神；
17.en: Today, the LORD will deliver you into my hand. I will strike you and take your head from off you. I will give the dead bodies of the army of the Philistines today to the birds of the sky and to the wild animals of the earth, that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel,

17.zh: 又使这众人知道耶和华使人得胜，不是用刀用枪，因为争战的胜败全在乎耶和华。他必将你们交在我们手里。」
17.en: and that all this assembly may know that the LORD doesn’t save with sword and spear; for the battle is the LORD’s, and he will give you into our hand.”

17.zh: 非利士人起身，迎着大卫前来。大卫急忙迎着非利士人，往战场跑去。
17.en: When the Philistine arose, and walked and came near to meet David, David hurried and ran toward the army to meet the Philistine.

17.zh: 大卫用手从囊中掏出一块石子来，用机弦甩去，打中非利士人的额，石子进入额内，他就仆倒，面伏于地。
17.en: David put his hand in his bag, took a stone and slung it, and struck the Philistine in his forehead. The stone sank into his forehead, and he fell on his face to the earth.

17.zh: 这样，大卫用机弦甩石，胜了那非利士人，打死他；大卫手中却没有刀。
17.en: So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and with a stone, and struck the Philistine and killed him; but there was no sword in David’s hand.

17.zh: 大卫跑去，站在非利士人身旁，将他的刀从鞘中拔出来，杀死他，割了他的头。非利士众人看见他们讨战的勇士死了，就都逃跑。
17.en: Then David ran, stood over the Philistine, took his sword, drew it out of its sheath, killed him, and cut off his head with it. When the Philistines saw that their champion was dead, they fled.

17.zh: 以色列人和犹大人便起身呐喊，追赶非利士人，直到迦特和以革伦的城门。被杀的非利士人倒在沙拉音的路上，直到迦特和以革伦。
17.en: The men of Israel and of Judah arose and shouted, and pursued the Philistines as far as Gai and to the gates of Ekron. The wounded of the Philistines fell down by the way to Shaaraim, even to Gath and to Ekron.

17.zh: 以色列人追赶非利士人回来，就夺了他们的营盘。
17.en: The children of Israel returned from chasing after the Philistines, and they plundered their camp.

17.zh: 大卫将那非利士人的头拿到耶路撒冷，却将他军装放在自己的帐棚里。
17.en: David took the head of the Philistine and brought it to Jerusalem, but he put his armor in his tent.

17.zh: 扫罗看见大卫去攻击非利士人，就问元帅押尼珥说：「押尼珥啊，那少年人是谁的儿子？」押尼珥说：「我敢在王面前起誓，我不知道。」
17.en: When Saul saw David go out against the Philistine, he said to Abner, the captain of the army, “Abner, whose son is this youth?” Abner said, “As your soul lives, O king, I can’t tell.”

17.zh: 王说：「你可以问问那幼年人是谁的儿子。」
17.en: The king said, “Inquire whose son the young man is!”

17.zh: 大卫打死非利士人回来，押尼珥领他到扫罗面前，他手中拿着非利士人的头。
17.en: As David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, Abner took him and brought him before Saul with the head of the Philistine in his hand.

17.zh: 扫罗问他说：「少年人哪，你是谁的儿子？」大卫说：「我是你仆人伯利恒人耶西的儿子。」
17.en: Saul said to him, “Whose son are you, you young man?” David answered, “I am the son of your servant Jesse the Bethlehemite.”

18.zh: 大卫对扫罗说完了话，约拿单的心与大卫的心深相契合。约拿单爱大卫，如同爱自己的性命。
18.en: When he had finished speaking to Saul, the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.

18.zh: 那日扫罗留住大卫，不容他再回父家。
18.en: Saul took him that day, and wouldn’t let him go home to his father’s house any more.

18.zh: 约拿单爱大卫如同爱自己的性命，就与他结盟。
18.en: Then Jonathan and David made a covenant, because he loved him as his own soul.

18.zh: 约拿单从身上脱下外袍，给了大卫，又将战衣、刀、弓、腰带都给了他。
18.en: Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that was on him and gave it to David with his clothing, even including his sword, his bow, and his sash.

18.zh: 扫罗无论差遣大卫往何处去，他都做事精明。扫罗就立他作战士长，众百姓和扫罗的臣仆无不喜悦。
18.en: David went out wherever Saul sent him, and behaved himself wisely; and Saul set him over the men of war. It was good in the sight of all the people, and also in the sight of Saul’s servants.

18.zh: 大卫打死了那非利士人，同众人回来的时候，妇女们从以色列各城里出来，欢欢喜喜，打鼓击磬，歌唱跳舞，迎接扫罗王。
18.en: As they came, when David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, the women came out of all the cities of Israel, singing and dancing, to meet King Saul with tambourines, with joy, and with instruments of music.

18.zh: 众妇女舞蹈唱和，说：「扫罗杀死千千，大卫杀死万万。」
18.en: The women sang to one another as they played, and said, “Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands.”

18.zh: 扫罗甚发怒，不喜悦这话，就说：「将万万归大卫，千千归我，只剩下王位没有给他了。」
18.en: Saul was very angry, and this saying displeased him. He said, “They have credited David with ten thousands, and they have only credited me with thousands. What can he have more but the kingdom?”

18.zh: 从这日起，扫罗就怒视大卫。
18.en: Saul watched David from that day and forward.

18.zh: 次日，从　神那里来的恶魔大大降在扫罗身上，他就在家中胡言乱语。大卫照常弹琴，扫罗手里拿着枪。
18.en: On the next day, an evil spirit from God came mightily on Saul, and he prophesied in the middle of the house. David played with his hand, as he did day by day. Saul had his spear in his hand;

18.zh: 扫罗把枪一抡，心里说，我要将大卫刺透，钉在墙上。大卫躲避他两次。
18.en: and Saul threw the spear, for he said, “I will pin David to the wall!” David escaped from his presence twice.

18.zh: 扫罗惧怕大卫；因为耶和华离开自己，与大卫同在。
18.en: Saul was afraid of David, because the LORD was with him, and had departed from Saul.

18.zh: 所以扫罗使大卫离开自己，立他为千夫长，他就领兵出入。
18.en: Therefore Saul removed him from his presence, and made him his captain over a thousand; and he went out and came in before the people.

18.zh: 大卫做事无不精明，耶和华也与他同在。
18.en: David behaved himself wisely in all his ways; and the LORD was with him.

18.zh: 扫罗见大卫做事精明，就甚怕他。
18.en: When Saul saw that he behaved himself very wisely, he stood in awe of him.

18.zh: 但以色列和犹大众人都爱大卫，因为他领他们出入。
18.en: But all Israel and Judah loved David; for he went out and came in before them.

18.zh: 扫罗对大卫说：「我将大女儿米拉给你为妻，只要你为我奋勇，为耶和华争战。」扫罗心里说：「我不好亲手害他，要借非利士人的手害他。」
18.en: Saul said to David, “Behold, my elder daughter Merab. I will give her to you as wife. Only be valiant for me, and fight the LORD’s battles.” For Saul said, “Don’t let my hand be on him, but let the hand of the Philistines be on him.”

18.zh: 大卫对扫罗说：「我是谁，我是什么出身，我父家在以色列中是何等的家，岂敢作王的女婿呢？」
18.en: David said to Saul, “Who am I, and what is my life, or my father’s family in Israel, that I should be son-in-law to the king?”

18.zh: 扫罗的女儿米拉到了当给大卫的时候，扫罗却给了米何拉人亚得列为妻。
18.en: But at the time when Merab, Saul’s daughter, should have been given to David, she was given to Adriel the Meholathite as wife.

18.zh: 扫罗的次女米甲爱大卫。有人告诉扫罗，扫罗就喜悦。
18.en: Michal, Saul’s daughter, loved David; and they told Saul, and the thing pleased him.

18.zh: 扫罗心里说：「我将这女儿给大卫，作他的网罗，好借非利士人的手害他。」所以扫罗对大卫说：「你今日可以第二次作我的女婿。」
18.en: Saul said, I will give her to him, that she may be a snare to him and that the hand of the Philistines may be against him. Therefore Saul said to David a second time, “You shall today be my son-in-law.”

18.zh: 扫罗吩咐臣仆[说]：「你们暗中对大卫说：『王喜悦你，王的臣仆也都喜爱你，所以你当作王的女婿。』」
18.en: Saul commanded his servants, “Talk with David secretly, and say, ‘Behold, the king has delight in you, and all his servants love you. Now therefore be the king’s son-in-law.’”

18.zh: 扫罗的臣仆就照这话说给大卫听。大卫说：「你们以为作王的女婿是一件小事吗？我是贫穷卑微的人。」
18.en: Saul’s servants spoke those words in the ears of David. David said, “Does it seem to you a light thing to be the king’s son-in-law, since I am a poor man and little known?”

18.zh: 扫罗的臣仆回奏说，大卫所说的如此如此。
18.en: The servants of Saul told him, saying, “David spoke like this.”

18.zh: 扫罗说：「你们要对大卫这样说：『王不要什么聘礼，只要一百非利士人的阳皮，好在王的仇敌身上报仇。』」扫罗的意思要使大卫丧在非利士人的手里。
18.en: Saul said, “Tell David, ‘The king desires no dowry except one hundred foreskins of the Philistines, to be avenged of the king’s enemies.’” Now Saul thought he would make David fall by the hand of the Philistines.

18.zh: 扫罗的臣仆将这话告诉大卫，大卫就欢喜作王的女婿。日期还没有到，
18.en: When his servants told David these words, it pleased David well to be the king’s son-in-law. Before the deadline,

18.zh: 大卫和跟随他的人起身前往，杀了二百非利士人，将阳皮满数交给王，为要作王的女婿。于是扫罗将女儿米甲给大卫为妻。
18.en: David arose and went, he and his men, and killed two hundred men of the Philistines. Then David brought their foreskins, and they gave them in full number to the king, that he might be the king’s son-in-law. Then Saul gave him Michal his daughter as wife.

18.zh: 扫罗见耶和华与大卫同在，又知道女儿米甲爱大卫，
18.en: Saul saw and knew that the LORD was with David; and Michal, Saul’s daughter, loved him.

18.zh: 就更怕大卫，常作大卫的仇敌。
18.en: Saul was even more afraid of David; and Saul was David’s enemy continually.

18.zh: 每逢非利士军长出来[打仗]，大卫比扫罗的臣仆做事精明，因此他的名被人尊重。
18.en: Then the princes of the Philistines went out; and as often as they went out, David behaved himself more wisely than all the servants of Saul, so that his name was highly esteemed.

19.zh: 扫罗对他儿子约拿单和众臣仆说，要杀大卫；扫罗的儿子约拿单却甚喜爱大卫。
19.en: Saul spoke to Jonathan his son and to all his servants, that they should kill David. But Jonathan, Saul’s son, greatly delighted in David.

19.zh: 约拿单告诉大卫说：「我父扫罗想要杀你，所以明日早晨你要小心，到一个僻静地方藏身。
19.en: Jonathan told David, saying, “Saul my father seeks to kill you. Now therefore, please take care of yourself in the morning, live in a secret place, and hide yourself.

19.zh: 我就出到你所藏的田里，站在我父亲旁边与他谈论。我看他情形怎样，我必告诉你。」
19.en: I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where you are, and I will talk with my father about you; and if I see anything, I will tell you.”

19.zh: 约拿单向他父亲扫罗替大卫说好话，说：「王不可得罪王的仆人大卫；因为他未曾得罪你，他所行的都与你大有益处。
19.en: Jonathan spoke good of David to Saul his father, and said to him, “Don’t let the king sin against his servant, against David; because he has not sinned against you, and because his works have been very good toward you;

19.zh: 他拚命杀那非利士人，耶和华为以色列众人大行拯救；那时你看见，甚是欢喜，现在为何无故要杀大卫，流无辜人的血，自己取罪呢？」
19.en: for he put his life in his hand and struck the Philistine, and the LORD worked a great victory for all Israel. You saw it and rejoiced. Why then will you sin against innocent blood, to kill David without a cause?”

19.zh: 扫罗听了约拿单的话，就指着永生的耶和华起誓说：「我必不杀他。」
19.en: Saul listened to the voice of Jonathan; and Saul swore, “As the LORD lives, he shall not be put to death.”

19.zh: 约拿单叫大卫来，把这一切事告诉他，带他去见扫罗。他就仍然侍立在扫罗面前。
19.en: Jonathan called David, and Jonathan showed him all those things. Then Jonathan brought David to Saul, and he was in his presence as before.

19.zh: 此后又有争战的事。大卫出去与非利士人打仗，大大杀败他们，他们就在他面前逃跑。
19.en: There was war again. David went out and fought with the Philistines, and killed them with a great slaughter; and they fled before him.

19.zh: 从耶和华那里来的恶魔又降在扫罗身上（扫罗手里拿枪坐在屋里），大卫就用手弹琴。
19.en: An evil spirit from the LORD was on Saul as he sat in his house with his spear in his hand; and David was playing music with his hand.

19.zh: 扫罗用枪想要刺透大卫，钉在墙上，他却躲开，扫罗的枪刺入墙内。当夜大卫逃走，躲避了。
19.en: Saul sought to pin David to the wall with the spear, but he slipped away out of Saul’s presence; and he stuck the spear into the wall. David fled and escaped that night.

19.zh: 扫罗打发人到大卫的房屋那里窥探他，要等到天亮杀他。大卫的妻米甲对他说：「你今夜若不逃命，明日你要被杀。」
19.en: Saul sent messengers to David’s house to watch him and to kill him in the morning. Michal, David’s wife, told him, saying, “If you don’t save your life tonight, tomorrow you will be killed.”

19.zh: 于是米甲将大卫从窗户里缒下去，大卫就逃走，躲避了。
19.en: So Michal let David down through the window. He went away, fled, and escaped.

19.zh: 米甲把家中的神像放在床上，头枕在山羊毛装的枕头上，用被遮盖。
19.en: Michal took the teraphim and laid it in the bed, and put a pillow of goats’ hair at its head and covered it with clothes.

19.zh: 扫罗打发人去捉拿大卫，米甲说：「他病了。」
19.en: When Saul sent messengers to take David, she said, “He is sick.”

19.zh: 扫罗又打发人去看大卫，说：「当连床将他抬来，我好杀他。」
19.en: Saul sent the messengers to see David, saying, “Bring him up to me in the bed, that I may kill him.”

19.zh: 使者进去，看见床上有神像，头枕在山羊毛装的枕头上。
19.en: When the messengers came in, behold, the teraphim was in the bed, with the pillow of goats’ hair at its head.

19.zh: 扫罗对米甲说：「你为什么这样欺哄我，放我仇敌逃走呢？」米甲回答说：「他对我说：『你放我走，不然我要杀你。』」
19.en: Saul said to Michal, “Why have you deceived me like this and let my enemy go, so that he has escaped?” Michal answered Saul, “He said to me, ‘Let me go! Why should I kill you?’”

19.zh: 大卫逃避，来到拉玛见撒母耳，将扫罗向他所行的事述说了一遍。他和撒母耳就往拿约去居住。
19.en: Now David fled and escaped, and came to Samuel at Ramah, and told him all that Saul had done to him. He and Samuel went and lived in Naioth.

19.zh: 有人告诉扫罗，说大卫在拉玛的拿约。
19.en: Saul was told, saying, “Behold, David is at Naioth in Ramah.”

19.zh: 扫罗打发人去捉拿大卫。去的人见有一班先知都受感说话，撒母耳站在其中监管他们；打发去的人也受　神的灵感动说话。
19.en: Saul sent messengers to seize David; and when they saw the company of the prophets prophesying, and Samuel standing as head over them, God’s Spirit came on Saul’s messengers, and they also prophesied.

19.zh: 有人将这事告诉扫罗，他又打发人去，他们也受感说话。扫罗第三次打发人去，他们也受感说话。
19.en: When Saul was told, he sent other messengers, and they also prophesied. Saul sent messengers again the third time, and they also prophesied.

19.zh: 然后扫罗自己往拉玛去，到了西沽的大井，问人说：「撒母耳和大卫在哪里呢？」有人说：「在拉玛的拿约。」
19.en: Then he also went to Ramah, and came to the great well that is in Secu: and he asked, “Where are Samuel and David?” One said, “Behold, they are at Naioth in Ramah.”

19.zh: 他就往拉玛的拿约去。　神的灵也感动他，一面走一面说话，直到拉玛的拿约。
19.en: He went there to Naioth in Ramah. Then God’s Spirit came on him also, and he went on, and prophesied, until he came to Naioth in Ramah.

19.zh: 他就脱了衣服，在撒母耳面前受感说话，一昼一夜露体躺卧。因此有句俗语说：「扫罗也列在先知中吗？」
19.en: He also stripped off his clothes. He also prophesied before Samuel and lay down naked all that day and all that night. Therefore they say, “Is Saul also among the prophets?”

20.zh: 大卫从拉玛的拿约逃跑，来到约拿单那里，对他说：「我做了什么？有什么罪孽呢？在你父亲面前犯了什么罪，他竟寻索我的性命呢？」
20.en: David fled from Naioth in Ramah, and came and said to Jonathan, “What have I done? What is my iniquity? What is my sin before your father, that he seeks my life?”

20.zh: 约拿单回答说：「断然不是！你必不致死。我父做事，无论大小，没有不叫我知道的。怎么独有这事隐瞒我呢？决不如此。」
20.en: He said to him, “Far from it; you will not die. Behold, my father does nothing either great or small, but that he discloses it to me. Why would my father hide this thing from me? It is not so.”

20.zh: 大卫又起誓说：「你父亲准知我在你眼前蒙恩。他心里说，不如不叫约拿单知道，恐怕他愁烦。我指着永生的耶和华，又敢在你面前起誓，我离死不过一步。」
20.en: David swore moreover, and said, “Your father knows well that I have found favor in your eyes; and he says, ‘Don’t let Jonathan know this, lest he be grieved;’ but truly as the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, there is but a step between me and death.”

20.zh: 约拿单对大卫说：「你心里所求的，我必为你成就。」
20.en: Then Jonathan said to David, “Whatever your soul desires, I will even do it for you.”

20.zh: 大卫对约拿单说：「明日是初一，我当与王同席，求你容我去藏在田野，直到第三日晚上。
20.en: David said to Jonathan, “Behold, tomorrow is the new moon, and I should not fail to dine with the king; but let me go, that I may hide myself in the field to the third day at evening.

20.zh: 你父亲若见我不在席上，你就说：『大卫切求我许他回本城伯利恒去，因为他全家在那里献年祭。』
20.en: If your father misses me at all, then say, ‘David earnestly asked leave of me that he might run to Bethlehem, his city; for it is the yearly sacrifice there for all the family.’

20.zh: 你父亲若说好，仆人就平安了；他若发怒，你就知道他决意要害我。
20.en: If he says, ‘It is well,’ your servant shall have peace; but if he is angry, then know that evil is determined by him.

20.zh: 求你施恩与仆人，因你在耶和华面前曾与仆人结盟。我若有罪，不如你自己杀我，何必将我交给你父亲呢？」
20.en: Therefore deal kindly with your servant, for you have brought your servant into a covenant of the LORD with you; but if there is iniquity in me, kill me yourself, for why should you bring me to your father?”

20.zh: 约拿单说：「断无此事！我若知道我父亲决意害你，我岂不告诉你呢？」
20.en: Jonathan said, “Far be it from you; for if I should at all know that evil were determined by my father to come on you, then wouldn’t I tell you that?”

20.zh: 大卫对约拿单说：「你父亲若用厉言回答你，谁来告诉我呢？」
20.en: Then David said to Jonathan, “Who will tell me if your father answers you roughly?”

20.zh: 约拿单对大卫说：「你我且往田野去。」二人就往田野去了。
20.en: Jonathan said to David, “Come! Let’s go out into the field.” They both went out into the field.

20.zh: 约拿单对大卫说：「愿耶和华—以色列的　神[为证]。明日约在这时候，或第三日，我探我父亲的意思，若向你有好意，我岂不打发人告诉你吗？
20.en: Jonathan said to David, “By the LORD, the God of Israel, when I have sounded out my father about this time tomorrow, or the third day, behold, if there is good toward David, won’t I then send to you and disclose it to you?

20.zh: 我父亲若有意害你，我不告诉你使你平平安安地走，愿耶和华重重地降罚与我。愿耶和华与你同在，如同从前与我父亲同在一样。
20.en: The LORD do so to Jonathan and more also, should it please my father to do you evil, if I don’t disclose it to you and send you away, that you may go in peace. May the LORD be with you as he has been with my father.

20.zh: 你要照耶和华的慈爱恩待我，不但我活着的时候免我死亡，
20.en: You shall not only show me the loving kindness of the LORD while I still live, that I not die;

20.zh: 就是我死后，耶和华从地上剪除你仇敌的时候，你也永不可向我家绝了恩惠。」
20.en: but you shall also not cut off your kindness from my house forever, no, not when the LORD has cut off every one of the enemies of David from the surface of the earth.”

20.zh: 于是约拿单与大卫家结盟，[说]：「愿耶和华借大卫的仇敌追讨[背约]的罪。」
20.en: So Jonathan made a covenant with David’s house, saying, “The LORD will require it at the hand of David’s enemies.”

20.zh: 约拿单因爱大卫如同爱自己的性命，就使他再起誓。
20.en: Jonathan caused David to swear again, for the love that he had for him; for he loved him as he loved his own soul.

20.zh: 约拿单对他说：「明日是初一，你的座位空设，人必理会你不在那里。
20.en: Then Jonathan said to him, “Tomorrow is the new moon, and you will be missed, because your seat will be empty.

20.zh: 你等三日，就要速速下去，到你从前遇事所藏的地方，在以色磐石那里等候。
20.en: When you have stayed three days, go down quickly and come to the place where you hid yourself when this started, and remain by the stone Ezel.

20.zh: 我要向磐石旁边射三箭，如同射箭靶一样。
20.en: I will shoot three arrows on its side, as though I shot at a mark.

20.zh: 我要打发童子，[说]：『去把箭找来。』我若对童子说：『箭在后头，把箭拿来』，你就可以回来；我指着永生的耶和华起誓，你必平安无事。
20.en: Behold, I will send the boy, saying, ‘Go, find the arrows!’ If I tell the boy, ‘Behold, the arrows are on this side of you. Take them;’ then come, for there is peace to you and no danger, as the LORD lives.

20.zh: 我若对童子说：『箭在前头』，你就要去，因为是耶和华打发你去的。
20.en: But if I say this to the boy, ‘Behold, the arrows are beyond you,’ then go your way, for the LORD has sent you away.

20.zh: 至于你我今日所说的话，有耶和华在你我中间[为证]，直到永远。」
20.en: Concerning the matter which you and I have spoken of, behold, the LORD is between you and me forever.”

20.zh: 大卫就去藏在田野。到了初一日，王坐席要吃饭。
20.en: So David hid himself in the field. When the new moon had come, the king sat himself down to eat food.

20.zh: 王照常坐在靠墙的位上，约拿单侍立，押尼珥坐在扫罗旁边，大卫的座位空设。
20.en: The king sat on his seat, as at other times, even on the seat by the wall; and Jonathan stood up, and Abner sat by Saul’s side, but David’s place was empty.

20.zh: 然而这日扫罗没有说什么，他想大卫遇事，偶染不洁，他必定是不洁。
20.en: Nevertheless Saul didn’t say anything that day, for he thought, “Something has happened to him. He is not clean. Surely he is not clean.”

20.zh: 初二日大卫的座位还空设。扫罗问他儿子约拿单说：「耶西的儿子为何昨日、今日没有来吃饭呢？」
20.en: On the next day after the new moon, the second day, David’s place was empty. Saul said to Jonathan his son, “Why didn’t the son of Jesse come to eat, either yesterday, or today?”

20.zh: 约拿单回答扫罗说：「大卫切求我容他往伯利恒去。
20.en: Jonathan answered Saul, “David earnestly asked permission of me to go to Bethlehem.

20.zh: 他说：『求你容我去，因为我家在城里有献祭的事；我长兄吩咐我去。如今我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你容我去见我的弟兄』；所以大卫没有赴王的席。」
20.en: He said, ‘Please let me go, for our family has a sacrifice in the city. My brother has commanded me to be there. Now, if I have found favor in your eyes, please let me go away and see my brothers.’ Therefore he has not come to the king’s table.”

20.zh: 扫罗向约拿单发怒，对他说：「你这顽梗背逆之妇人所生的，我岂不知道你喜悦耶西的儿子，自取羞辱，以致你母亲露体蒙羞吗？
20.en: Then Saul’s anger burned against Jonathan, and he said to him, “You son of a perverse rebellious woman, don’t I know that you have chosen the son of Jesse to your own shame, and to the shame of your mother’s nakedness?

20.zh: 耶西的儿子若在世间活着，你和你的国位必站立不住。现在你要打发人去，将他捉拿交给我；他是该死的。」
20.en: For as long as the son of Jesse lives on the earth, you will not be established, nor will your kingdom. Therefore now send and bring him to me, for he shall surely die!”

20.zh: 约拿单对父亲扫罗说：「他为什么该死呢？他做了什么呢？」
20.en: Jonathan answered Saul his father, and said to him, “Why should he be put to death? What has he done?”

20.zh: 扫罗向约拿单抡枪要刺他，约拿单就知道他父亲决意要杀大卫。
20.en: Saul cast his spear at him to strike him. By this Jonathan knew that his father was determined to put David to death.

20.zh: 于是约拿单气忿忿地从席上起来，在这初二日没有吃饭。他因见父亲羞辱大卫，就为大卫愁烦。
20.en: So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and ate no food the second day of the month; for he was grieved for David, because his father had treated him shamefully.

20.zh: 次日早晨，约拿单按着与大卫约会的时候出到田野，有一个童子跟随。
20.en: In the morning, Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little boy with him.

20.zh: 约拿单对童子说：「你跑去，把我所射的箭找来。」童子跑去，约拿单就把箭射在童子前头。
20.en: He said to his boy, “Run, find now the arrows which I shoot.” As the boy ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.

20.zh: 童子到了约拿单落箭之地，约拿单呼叫童子说：「箭不是在你前头吗？」
20.en: When the boy had come to the place of the arrow which Jonathan had shot, Jonathan cried after the boy, and said, “Isn’t the arrow beyond you?”

20.zh: 约拿单又呼叫童子说：「速速地去，不要迟延！」童子就拾起箭来，回到主人那里。
20.en: Jonathan cried after the boy, “Go fast! Hurry! Don’t delay!” Jonathan’s boy gathered up the arrows, and came to his master.

20.zh: 童子却不知道这是什么意思，只有约拿单和大卫知道。
20.en: But the boy didn’t know anything. Only Jonathan and David knew the matter.

20.zh: 约拿单将弓箭交给童子，吩咐说：「你拿到城里去。」
20.en: Jonathan gave his weapons to his boy, and said to him, “Go, carry them to the city.”

20.zh: 童子一去，大卫就从[磐石]的南边出来，俯伏在地，拜了三拜；二人亲嘴，彼此哭泣，大卫哭得更恸。
20.en: As soon as the boy was gone, David arose out of the south, and fell on his face to the ground, and bowed himself three times. They kissed one another and wept with one another, and David wept the most.

20.zh: 约拿单对大卫说：「我们二人曾指着耶和华的名起誓说：『愿耶和华在你我中间，并你我后裔中间[为证]，直到永远。』如今你平平安安地去吧！」大卫就起身走了；约拿单也回城里去了。
20.en: Jonathan said to David, “Go in peace, because we have both sworn in the LORD’s name, saying, ‘The LORD is between me and you, and between my offspring and your offspring, forever.’” He arose and departed; and Jonathan went into the city.

21.zh: 大卫到了挪伯祭司亚希米勒那里，亚希米勒战战兢兢地出来迎接他，问他说：「你为什么独自来，没有人跟随呢？」
21.en: Then David came to Nob to Ahimelech the priest. Ahimelech came to meet David trembling, and said to him, “Why are you alone, and no man with you?”

21.zh: 大卫回答祭司亚希米勒说：「王吩咐我一件事说：『我差遣你委托你的这件事，不要使人知道。』故此我已派定少年人在某处等候我。
21.en: David said to Ahimelech the priest, “The king has commanded me to do something, and has said to me, ‘Let no one know anything about the business about which I send you, and what I have commanded you. I have sent the young men to a certain place.’

21.zh: 现在你手下有什么？求你给我五个饼或是别样的食物。」
21.en: Now therefore what is under your hand? Please give me five loaves of bread in my hand, or whatever is available.”

21.zh: 祭司对大卫说：「我手下没有寻常的饼，只有圣饼；若少年人没有亲近妇人才可以给。」
21.en: The priest answered David, and said, “I have no common bread, but there is holy bread; if only the young men have kept themselves from women.”

21.zh: 大卫对祭司说：「实在约有三日我们没有亲近妇人；我出来的时候，虽是寻常行路，少年人的器皿还是洁净的；何况今日不更是洁净吗？」
21.en: David answered the priest, and said to him, “Truly, women have been kept from us as usual these three days. When I came out, the vessels of the young men were holy, though it was only a common journey. How much more then today shall their vessels be holy?”

21.zh: 祭司就拿圣[饼]给他；因为在那里没有别样饼，只有更换新饼，从耶和华面前撤下来的陈设饼。 （
21.en: So the priest gave him holy bread; for there was no bread there but the show bread that was taken from before the LORD, to be replaced with hot bread in the day when it was taken away.

21.zh: 当日有扫罗的一个臣子留在耶和华面前。他名叫多益，是以东人，作扫罗的司牧长。）
21.en: Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day, detained before the LORD; and his name was Doeg the Edomite, the best of the herdsmen who belonged to Saul.

21.zh: 大卫问亚希米勒说：「你手下有枪有刀没有？因为王的事甚急，连刀剑器械我都没有带。」
21.en: David said to Ahimelech, “Isn’t there here under your hand spear or sword? For I haven’t brought my sword or my weapons with me, because the king’s business required haste.”

21.zh: 祭司说：「你在以拉谷杀非利士人歌利亚的那刀在这里，裹在布中，放在以弗得后边，你要就可以拿去；除此以外，再没有别的。」大卫说：「这刀没有可比的！求你给我。」
21.en: The priest said, “Behold, the sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom you killed in the valley of Elah, is here wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod. If you would like to take that, take it, for there is no other except that here.” David said, “There is none like that. Give it to me.”

21.zh: 那日大卫起来，躲避扫罗，逃到迦特王亚吉那里。
21.en: David arose and fled that day for fear of Saul, and went to Achish the king of Gath.

21.zh: 亚吉的臣仆对亚吉说：「这不是[以色列]国王大卫吗？那里的妇女跳舞唱和，不是指着他说『扫罗杀死千千，大卫杀死万万』吗？」
21.en: The servants of Achish said to him, “Isn’t this David the king of the land? Didn’t they sing to one another about him in dances, saying, ‘Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands’?”

21.zh: 大卫将这话放在心里，甚惧怕迦特王亚吉，
21.en: David laid up these words in his heart, and was very afraid of Achish the king of Gath.

21.zh: 就在众人面前改变了寻常的举动，在他们手下假装疯癫，在城门的门扇上胡写乱画，使唾沫流在胡子上。
21.en: He changed his behavior before them and pretended to be insane in their hands, and scribbled on the doors of the gate, and let his spittle fall down on his beard.

21.zh: 亚吉对臣仆说：「你们看，这人是疯子。为什么带他到我这里来呢？
21.en: Then Achish said to his servants, “Look, you see the man is insane. Why then have you brought him to me?

21.zh: 我岂缺少疯子，你们带这人来在我面前疯癫吗？这人岂可进我的家呢？」
21.en: Do I lack madmen, that you have brought this fellow to play the madman in my presence? Should this fellow come into my house?”

22.zh: 大卫就离开那里，逃到亚杜兰洞。他的弟兄和他父亲的全家听见了，就都下到他那里。
22.en: David therefore departed from there and escaped to Adullam’s cave. When his brothers and all his father’s house heard it, they went down there to him.

22.zh: 凡受窘迫的、欠债的、心里苦恼的都聚集到大卫那里；大卫就作他们的头目，跟随他的约有四百人。
22.en: Everyone who was in distress, everyone who was in debt, and everyone who was discontented gathered themselves to him; and he became captain over them. There were with him about four hundred men.

22.zh: 大卫从那里往摩押的米斯巴去，对摩押王说：「求你容我父母搬来，住在你们这里，等我知道　神要为我怎样行。」
22.en: David went from there to Mizpeh of Moab; and he said to the king of Moab, “Please let my father and my mother come out to you, until I know what God will do for me.”

22.zh: 大卫领他父母到摩押王面前。大卫住山寨多少日子，他父母也住摩押王那里多少日子。
22.en: He brought them before the king of Moab; and they lived with him all the time that David was in the stronghold.

22.zh: 先知迦得对大卫说：「你不要住在山寨，要往犹大地去。」大卫就离开那里，进入哈列的树林。
22.en: The prophet Gad said to David, “Don’t stay in the stronghold. Depart, and go into the land of Judah.” Then David departed, and came into the forest of Hereth.

22.zh: 扫罗在基比亚的拉玛，坐在垂丝柳树下，手里拿着枪，众臣仆侍立在左右。扫罗听见大卫和跟随他的人在何处，
22.en: Saul heard that David was discovered, with the men who were with him. Now Saul was sitting in Gibeah, under the tamarisk tree in Ramah, with his spear in his hand, and all his servants were standing around him.

22.zh: 就对左右侍立的臣仆说：「便雅悯人哪，你们要听我的话！耶西的儿子能将田地和葡萄园赐给你们各人吗？能立你们各人作千夫长百夫长吗？
22.en: Saul said to his servants who stood around him, “Hear now, you Benjamites! Will the son of Jesse give everyone of you fields and vineyards? Will he make you all captains of thousands and captains of hundreds?

22.zh: 你们竟都结党害我！我的儿子与耶西的儿子结盟的时候，无人告诉我；我的儿子挑唆我的臣子谋害我，就如今日的光景，也无人告诉我，为我忧虑。」
22.en: Is that why all of you have conspired against me, and there is no one who discloses to me when my son makes a treaty with the son of Jesse, and there is none of you who is sorry for me, or discloses to me that my son has stirred up my servant against me, to lie in wait, as it is today?”

22.zh: 那时以东人多益站在扫罗的臣仆中，对他说：「我曾看见耶西的儿子到了挪伯，亚希突的儿子亚希米勒那里。
22.en: Then Doeg the Edomite, who stood by the servants of Saul, answered and said, “I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.

22.zh: 亚希米勒为他求问耶和华，又给他食物，并给他[杀]非利士人歌利亚的刀。」
22.en: He inquired of the LORD for him, gave him food, and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine.”

22.zh: 王就打发人将祭司亚希突的儿子亚希米勒和他父亲的全家，就是住挪伯的祭司都召了来；他们就来见王。
22.en: Then the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub, and all his father’s house, the priests who were in Nob; and they all came to the king.

22.zh: 扫罗说：「亚希突的儿子，要听我的话！」他回答说：「主啊，我在这里。」
22.en: Saul said, “Hear now, you son of Ahitub.” He answered, “Here I am, my lord.”

22.zh: 扫罗对他说：「你为什么与耶西的儿子结党害我，将食物和刀给他，又为他求问　神，使他起来谋害我，就如今日的光景？」
22.en: Saul said to him, “Why have you conspired against me, you and the son of Jesse, in that you have given him bread, and a sword, and have inquired of God for him, that he should rise against me, to lie in wait, as it is today?”

22.zh: 亚希米勒回答王说：「王的臣仆中有谁比大卫忠心呢？他是王的女婿，又是王的参谋，并且在王家中是尊贵的。
22.en: Then Ahimelech answered the king, and said, “Who among all your servants is so faithful as David, who is the king’s son-in-law, captain of your body guard, and honored in your house?

22.zh: 我岂是从今日才为他求问　神呢？断不是这样！王不要将罪归我和我父的全家；因为这事，无论大小，仆人都不知道。」
22.en: Have I today begun to inquire of God for him? Be it far from me! Don’t let the king impute anything to his servant, nor to all the house of my father; for your servant knew nothing of all this, less or more.”

22.zh: 王说：「亚希米勒啊，你和你父的全家都是该死的！」
22.en: The king said, “You shall surely die, Ahimelech, you and all your father’s house.”

22.zh: 王就吩咐左右的侍卫说：「你们去杀耶和华的祭司；因为他们帮助大卫，又知道大卫逃跑，竟没有告诉我。」扫罗的臣子却不肯伸手杀耶和华的祭司。
22.en: The king said to the guard who stood about him, “Turn and kill the priests of the LORD, because their hand also is with David, and because they knew that he fled and didn’t disclose it to me.” But the servants of the king wouldn’t put out their hand to fall on the priests of the LORD.

22.zh: 王吩咐多益说：「你去杀祭司吧！」以东人多益就去杀祭司，那日杀了穿细麻布以弗得的八十五人；
22.en: The king said to Doeg, “Turn and attack the priests!” Doeg the Edomite turned, and he attacked the priests, and he killed on that day eighty-five people who wore a linen ephod.

22.zh: 又用刀将祭司城挪伯中的男女、孩童、吃奶的，和牛、羊、驴尽都杀灭。
22.en: He struck Nob, the city of the priests, with the edge of the sword—both men and women, children and nursing babies, and cattle, donkeys, and sheep, with the edge of the sword.

22.zh: 亚希突的儿子亚希米勒有一个儿子，名叫亚比亚他，逃到大卫那里。
22.en: One of the sons of Ahimelech the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped and fled after David.

22.zh: 亚比亚他将扫罗杀耶和华祭司的事告诉大卫。
22.en: Abiathar told David that Saul had slain the LORD’s priests.

22.zh: 大卫对亚比亚他说：「那日我见以东人多益在那里，就知道他必告诉扫罗。你父的全家[丧]命，都是因我的缘故。
22.en: David said to Abiathar, “I knew on that day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, that he would surely tell Saul. I am responsible for the death of all the persons of your father’s house.

22.zh: 你可以住在我这里，不要惧怕。因为寻索你命的就是寻索我的命；你在我这里可得保全。」
22.en: Stay with me. Don’t be afraid, for he who seeks my life seeks your life. You will be safe with me.”

23.zh: 有人告诉大卫说：「非利士人攻击基伊拉，抢夺禾场。」
23.en: David was told, “Behold, the Philistines are fighting against Keilah, and are robbing the threshing floors.”

23.zh: 所以大卫求问耶和华说：「我去攻打那些非利士人可以不可以？」耶和华对大卫说：「你可以去攻打非利士人，拯救基伊拉。」
23.en: Therefore David inquired of the LORD, saying, “Shall I go and strike these Philistines?” The LORD said to David, “Go strike the Philistines, and save Keilah.”

23.zh: 跟随大卫的人对他说：「我们在犹大地这里尚且惧怕，何况往基伊拉去攻打非利士人的军旅呢？」
23.en: David’s men said to him, “Behold, we are afraid here in Judah. How much more then if we go to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?”

23.zh: 大卫又求问耶和华。耶和华回答说：「你起身下基伊拉去，我必将非利士人交在你手里。」
23.en: Then David inquired of the LORD yet again. The LORD answered him, and said, “Arise, go down to Keilah; for I will deliver the Philistines into your hand.”

23.zh: 大卫和跟随他的人往基伊拉去，与非利士人打仗，大大杀败他们，又夺获他们的牲畜。这样，大卫救了基伊拉的居民。
23.en: David and his men went to Keilah and fought with the Philistines, and brought away their livestock, and killed them with a great slaughter. So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah.

23.zh: 亚希米勒的儿子亚比亚他逃到基伊拉见大卫的时候，手里拿着以弗得。
23.en: When Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David to Keilah, he came down with an ephod in his hand.

23.zh: 有人告诉扫罗说：「大卫到了基伊拉。」扫罗说：「他进了有门有闩的城，困闭在里头；这是　神将他交在我手里了。」
23.en: Saul was told that David had come to Keilah. Saul said, “God has delivered him into my hand, for he is shut in by entering into a town that has gates and bars.”

23.zh: 于是扫罗招聚众民，要下去攻打基伊拉城，围困大卫和跟随他的人。
23.en: Saul summoned all the people to war, to go down to Keilah to besiege David and his men.

23.zh: 大卫知道扫罗设计谋害他，就对祭司亚比亚他说：「将以弗得拿过来。」
23.en: David knew that Saul was devising mischief against him. He said to Abiathar the priest, “Bring the ephod here.”

23.zh: 大卫祷告说：「耶和华—以色列的　神啊，你仆人听真了扫罗要往基伊拉来，为我的缘故灭城。
23.en: Then David said, “O LORD, the God of Israel, your servant has surely heard that Saul seeks to come to Keilah to destroy the city for my sake.

23.zh: 基伊拉人将我交在扫罗手里不交？扫罗照着你仆人所听的话下来不下来？耶和华—以色列的　神啊，求你指示仆人！」耶和华说：「扫罗必下来。」
23.en: Will the men of Keilah deliver me up into his hand? Will Saul come down, as your servant has heard? LORD, the God of Israel, I beg you, tell your servant.” The LORD said, “He will come down.”

23.zh: 大卫又说：「基伊拉人将我和跟随我的人交在扫罗手里不交？」耶和华说：「必交出来。」
23.en: Then David said, “Will the men of Keilah deliver me and my men into the hand of Saul?” The LORD said, “They will deliver you up.”

23.zh: 大卫和跟随他的约有六百人，就起身出了基伊拉，往他们所能往的地方去。有人告诉扫罗，大卫离开基伊拉逃走；于是扫罗不出来了。
23.en: Then David and his men, who were about six hundred, arose and departed out of Keilah and went wherever they could go. Saul was told that David had escaped from Keilah; and he gave up going there.

23.zh: 大卫住在旷野的山寨里，常在西弗旷野的山地。扫罗天天寻索大卫，　神却不将大卫交在他手里。
23.en: David stayed in the wilderness in the strongholds, and remained in the hill country in the wilderness of Ziph. Saul sought him every day, but God didn’t deliver him into his hand.

23.zh: 大卫知道扫罗出来寻索他的命。那时，他住在西弗旷野的树林里；
23.en: David saw that Saul had come out to seek his life. David was in the wilderness of Ziph in the woods.

23.zh: 扫罗的儿子约拿单起身，往那树林里去见大卫，使他倚靠　神得以坚固，
23.en: Jonathan, Saul’s son, arose and went to David into the woods, and strengthened his hand in God.

23.zh: 对他说：「不要惧怕！我父扫罗的手必不加害于你；你必作以色列的王，我也作你的宰相。这事我父扫罗知道了。」
23.en: He said to him, “Don’t be afraid, for the hand of Saul my father won’t find you; and you will be king over Israel, and I will be next to you; and Saul my father knows that also.”

23.zh: 于是二人在耶和华面前立约。大卫仍住在树林里，约拿单回家去了。
23.en: They both made a covenant before the LORD. Then David stayed in the woods and Jonathan went to his house.

23.zh: 西弗人上到基比亚见扫罗，说：「大卫不是在我们那里的树林里山寨中、旷野南边的哈基拉山藏着吗？
23.en: Then the Ziphites came up to Saul to Gibeah, saying, “Doesn’t David hide himself with us in the strongholds in the woods, in the hill of Hachilah, which is on the south of the desert?

23.zh: 王啊，请你随你的心愿下来，我们必亲自将他交在王的手里。」
23.en: Now therefore, O king, come down. According to all the desire of your soul to come down; and our part will be to deliver him up into the king’s hand.”

23.zh: 扫罗说：「愿耶和华赐福与你们，因你们顾恤我。
23.en: Saul said, “You are blessed by the LORD, for you have had compassion on me.

23.zh: 请你们回去，再确实查明他的住处和行踪，是谁看见他在那里，因为我听见人说他甚狡猾。
23.en: Please go make yet more sure, and know and see his place where his haunt is, and who has seen him there; for I have been told that he is very cunning.

23.zh: 所以要看准他藏匿的地方，回来据实地告诉我，我就与你们同去。他若在犹大的境内，我必从千门万户中搜出他来。」
23.en: See therefore, and take knowledge of all the lurking places where he hides himself; and come again to me with certainty, and I will go with you. It shall happen, if he is in the land, that I will search him out among all the thousands of Judah.”

23.zh: 西弗人就起身，在扫罗以先往西弗去。 大卫和跟随他的人却在玛云旷野南边的亚拉巴。
23.en: They arose, and went to Ziph before Saul; but David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, in the Arabah on the south of the desert.

23.zh: 扫罗和跟随他的人去寻找大卫；有人告诉大卫，他就下到磐石，住在玛云的旷野。扫罗听见，便在玛云的旷野追赶大卫。
23.en: Saul and his men went to seek him. When David was told, he went down to the rock, and stayed in the wilderness of Maon. When Saul heard that, he pursued David in the wilderness of Maon.

23.zh: 扫罗在山这边走，大卫和跟随他的人在山那边走。大卫急忙躲避扫罗；因为扫罗和跟随他的人，四面围住大卫和跟随他的人，要拿获他们。
23.en: Saul went on this side of the mountain, and David and his men on that side of the mountain; and David hurried to get away for fear of Saul, for Saul and his men surrounded David and his men to take them.

23.zh: 忽有使者来报告扫罗说：「非利士人犯境抢掠，请王快快回去！」
23.en: But a messenger came to Saul, saying, “Hurry and come, for the Philistines have made a raid on the land!”

23.zh: 于是扫罗不追赶大卫，回去攻打非利士人。因此那地方名叫西拉·哈玛希罗结。
23.en: So Saul returned from pursuing David, and went against the Philistines. Therefore they called that place Sela Hammahlekoth.

23.zh: 大卫从那里上去，住在隐·基底的山寨里。
23.en: David went up from there and lived in the strongholds of En Gedi.

24.zh: 扫罗追赶非利士人回来，有人告诉他说：「大卫在隐·基底的旷野。」
24.en: When Saul had returned from following the Philistines, he was told, “Behold, David is in the wilderness of En Gedi.”

24.zh: 扫罗就从以色列人中挑选三千精兵，率领他们往野羊的磐石去，寻索大卫和跟随他的人。
24.en: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and went to seek David and his men on the rocks of the wild goats.

24.zh: 到了路旁的羊圈，在那里有洞，扫罗进去大解。大卫和跟随他的人正藏在洞里的深处。
24.en: He came to the sheep pens by the way, where there was a cave; and Saul went in to relieve himself. Now David and his men were staying in the innermost parts of the cave.

24.zh: 跟随的人对大卫说：「耶和华曾应许你说：『我要将你的仇敌交在你手里，你可以任意待他。』如今时候到了！」大卫就起来，悄悄地割下扫罗外袍的衣襟。
24.en: David’s men said to him, “Behold, the day of which the LORD said to you, ‘Behold, I will deliver your enemy into your hand, and you shall do to him as it shall seem good to you.’” Then David arose and cut off the skirt of Saul’s robe secretly.

24.zh: 随后大卫心中自责，因为割下扫罗的衣襟；
24.en: Afterward, David’s heart struck him because he had cut off Saul’s skirt.

24.zh: 对跟随他的人说：「我的主乃是耶和华的受膏者，我在耶和华面前万不敢伸手害他，因他是耶和华的受膏者。」
24.en: He said to his men, “The LORD forbid that I should do this thing to my lord, the LORD’s anointed, to stretch out my hand against him, since he is the LORD’s anointed.”

24.zh: 大卫用这话拦住跟随他的人，不容他们起来害扫罗。扫罗起来，从洞里出去行路。
24.en: So David checked his men with these words, and didn’t allow them to rise against Saul. Saul rose up out of the cave, and went on his way.

24.zh: 随后大卫也起来，从洞里出去，呼叫扫罗说：「我主，我王！」扫罗回头观看，大卫就屈身、脸伏于地下拜。
24.en: David also arose afterward, and went out of the cave and cried after Saul, saying, “My lord the king!” When Saul looked behind him, David bowed with his face to the earth, and showed respect.

24.zh: 大卫对扫罗说：「你为何听信人的谗言，说大卫想要害你呢？
24.en: David said to Saul, “Why do you listen to men’s words, saying, ‘Behold, David seeks to harm you’?

24.zh: 今日你亲眼看见在洞中，耶和华将你交在我手里；有人叫我杀你，我却爱惜你，说：『我不敢伸手害我的主，因为他是耶和华的受膏者。』
24.en: Behold, today your eyes have seen how the LORD had delivered you today into my hand in the cave. Some urged me to kill you, but I spared you. I said, ‘I will not stretch out my hand against my lord, for he is the LORD’s anointed.’

24.zh: 我父啊，看看你外袍的衣襟在我手中。我割下你的衣襟，没有杀你；你由此可以知道我没有恶意叛逆你。你虽然猎取我的命，我却没有得罪你。
24.en: Moreover, my father, behold, yes, see the skirt of your robe in my hand; for in that I cut off the skirt of your robe and didn’t kill you, know and see that there is neither evil nor disobedience in my hand. I have not sinned against you, though you hunt for my life to take it.

24.zh: 愿耶和华在你我中间判断是非，在你身上为我伸冤，我却不亲手加害于你。
24.en: May the LORD judge between me and you, and may the LORD avenge me of you; but my hand will not be on you.

24.zh: 古人有句俗语说：『恶事出于恶人。』我却不亲手加害于你。
24.en: As the proverb of the ancients says, ‘Out of the wicked comes wickedness;’ but my hand will not be on you.

24.zh: 以色列王出来要寻找谁呢？追赶谁呢？不过追赶一条死狗，一个虼蚤就是了。
24.en: Against whom has the king of Israel come out? Whom do you pursue? A dead dog? A flea?

24.zh: 愿耶和华在你我中间施行审判，断定是非，并且鉴察，为我伸冤，救我脱离你的手。」
24.en: May the LORD therefore be judge, and give sentence between me and you, and see, and plead my cause, and deliver me out of your hand.”

24.zh: 大卫向扫罗说完这话，扫罗说：「我儿大卫，这是你的声音吗？」就放声大哭，
24.en: It came to pass, when David had finished speaking these words to Saul, that Saul said, “Is that your voice, my son David?” Saul lifted up his voice and wept.

24.zh: 对大卫说：「你比我公义；因为你以善待我，我却以恶待你。
24.en: He said to David, “You are more righteous than I; for you have done good to me, whereas I have done evil to you.

24.zh: 你今日显明是以善待我；因为耶和华将我交在你手里，你却没有杀我。
24.en: You have declared today how you have dealt well with me, because when the LORD had delivered me up into your hand, you didn’t kill me.

24.zh: 人若遇见仇敌，岂肯放他平安无事地去呢？愿耶和华因你今日向我所行的，以善报你。
24.en: For if a man finds his enemy, will he let him go away unharmed? Therefore may the LORD reward you good for that which you have done to me today.

24.zh: 我也知道你必要作王，以色列的国必坚立在你手里。
24.en: Now, behold, I know that you will surely be king, and that the kingdom of Israel will be established in your hand.

24.zh: 现在你要指着耶和华向我起誓，不剪除我的后裔，在我父家不灭没我的名。」
24.en: Swear now therefore to me by the LORD that you will not cut off my offspring after me, and that you will not destroy my name out of my father’s house.”

24.zh: 于是大卫向扫罗起誓，扫罗就回家去；大卫和跟随他的人上山寨去了。
24.en: David swore to Saul. Saul went home, but David and his men went up to the stronghold.

25.zh: 撒母耳死了，以色列众人聚集，为他哀哭，将他葬在拉玛—他自己的坟墓里。 大卫起身，下到巴兰的旷野。
25.en: Samuel died; and all Israel gathered themselves together and mourned for him, and buried him at his house at Ramah. Then David arose and went down to the wilderness of Paran.

25.zh: 在玛云有一个人，他的产业在迦密，是一个大富户，有三千绵羊，一千山羊；他正在迦密剪羊毛。
25.en: There was a man in Maon whose possessions were in Carmel; and the man was very great. He had three thousand sheep and a thousand goats; and he was shearing his sheep in Carmel.

25.zh: 那人名叫拿八，是迦勒族的人；他的妻名叫亚比该，是聪明俊美的妇人。拿八为人刚愎凶恶。
25.en: Now the name of the man was Nabal; and the name of his wife Abigail. This woman was intelligent and had a beautiful face; but the man was surly and evil in his doings. He was of the house of Caleb.

25.zh: 大卫在旷野听见说拿八剪羊毛，
25.en: David heard in the wilderness that Nabal was shearing his sheep.

25.zh: 大卫就打发十个仆人，吩咐他们说：「你们上迦密去见拿八，提我的名问他安。
25.en: David sent ten young men; and David said to the young men, “Go up to Carmel, and go to Nabal, and greet him in my name.

25.zh: 要对那富户如此说：『愿你平安，愿你家平安，愿你一切所有的都平安。
25.en: Tell him, ‘Long life to you! Peace be to you! Peace be to your house! Peace be to all that you have!

25.zh: 现在我听说有人为你剪羊毛，你的牧人在迦密的时候和我们在一处，我们没有欺负他们，他们也未曾失落什么。
25.en: Now I have heard that you have shearers. Your shepherds have now been with us, and we didn’t harm them. Nothing was missing from them all the time they were in Carmel.

25.zh: 可以问你的仆人，他们必告诉你。所以愿我的仆人在你眼前蒙恩，因为是在好日子来的。求你随手取点赐与仆人和你儿子大卫。』」
25.en: Ask your young men, and they will tell you. Therefore let the young men find favor in your eyes, for we come on a good day. Please give whatever comes to your hand to your servants and to your son David.’”

25.zh: 大卫的仆人到了，将这话提大卫的名都告诉了拿八，就住了口。
25.en: When David’s young men came, they spoke to Nabal all those words in the name of David, and waited.

25.zh: 拿八回答大卫的仆人说：「大卫是谁？耶西的儿子是谁？近来悖逆主人奔逃的仆人甚多，
25.en: Nabal answered David’s servants and said, “Who is David? Who is the son of Jesse? There are many servants who break away from their masters these days.

25.zh: 我岂可将饮食和为我剪羊毛人所宰的肉给我不知道从哪里来的人呢？」
25.en: Shall I then take my bread, my water, and my meat that I have killed for my shearers, and give it to men who I don’t know where they come from?”

25.zh: 大卫的仆人就转身从原路回去，照这话告诉大卫。
25.en: So David’s young men turned on their way and went back, and came and told him all these words.

25.zh: 大卫向跟随他的人说：「你们各人都要带上刀！」众人就都带上刀，大卫也带上刀。跟随大卫上去的约有四百人，留下二百人看守器具。
25.en: David said to his men, “Every man put on his sword!” Every man put on his sword. David also put on his sword. About four hundred men followed David, and two hundred stayed by the baggage.

25.zh: 有拿八的一个仆人告诉拿八的妻亚比该说：「大卫从旷野打发使者来问我主人的安，主人却辱骂他们。
25.en: But one of the young men told Abigail, Nabal’s wife, saying, “Behold, David sent messengers out of the wilderness to greet our master; and he insulted them.

25.zh: 但是那些人待我们甚好；我们在田野与他们来往的时候，没有受他们的欺负，也未曾失落什么。
25.en: But the men were very good to us, and we were not harmed, and we didn’t miss anything as long as we went with them, when we were in the fields.

25.zh: 我们在他们那里牧羊的时候，他们昼夜作我们的保障。
25.en: They were a wall to us both by night and by day, all the while we were with them keeping the sheep.

25.zh: 所以你当筹划，看怎样行才好；不然，祸患定要临到我主人和他全家。他性情凶暴，无人敢与他说话。」
25.en: Now therefore know and consider what you will do; for evil is determined against our master and against all his house, for he is such a worthless fellow that one can’t speak to him.”

25.zh: 亚比该急忙将二百饼，两皮袋酒，五只收拾好了的羊，五细亚烘好了的穗子，一百葡萄饼，二百无花果饼，都驮在驴上，
25.en: Then Abigail hurried and took two hundred loaves of bread, two containers of wine, five sheep ready dressed, five seahs of parched grain, one hundred clusters of raisins, and two hundred cakes of figs, and laid them on donkeys.

25.zh: 对仆人说：「你们前头走，我随着你们去。」这事她却没有告诉丈夫拿八。
25.en: She said to her young men, “Go on before me. Behold, I am coming after you.” But she didn’t tell her husband, Nabal.

25.zh: 亚比该骑着驴，正下山坡，见大卫和跟随他的人从对面下来，亚比该就迎接他们。
25.en: As she rode on her donkey, and came down hidden by the mountain, behold, David and his men came down toward her, and she met them.

25.zh: 大卫曾说：「我在旷野为那人看守所有的，以致他一样不失落，实在是徒然了！他向我以恶报善。
25.en: Now David had said, “Surely in vain I have kept all that this fellow has in the wilderness, so that nothing was missed of all that pertained to him. He has returned me evil for good.

25.zh: 凡属拿八的男丁，我若留一个到明日早晨，愿　神重重降罚与我！」
25.en: God do so to the enemies of David, and more also, if I leave of all that belongs to him by the morning light so much as one who urinates on a wall.”

25.zh: 亚比该见大卫，便急忙下驴，在大卫面前脸伏于地叩拜，
25.en: When Abigail saw David, she hurried and got off her donkey, and fell before David on her face and bowed herself to the ground.

25.zh: 俯伏在大卫的脚前，说：「我主啊，愿这罪归我！求你容婢女向你进言，更求你听婢女的话。
25.en: She fell at his feet and said, “On me, my lord, on me be the blame! Please let your servant speak in your ears. Hear the words of your servant.

25.zh: 我主不要理这坏人拿八，他的性情与他的名相称；他名叫拿八，他为人果然愚顽。但我主所打发的仆人，婢女并没有看见。
25.en: Please don’t let my lord pay attention to this worthless fellow, Nabal, for as his name is, so is he. Nabal is his name, and folly is with him; but I, your servant, didn’t see my lord’s young men whom you sent.

25.zh: 我主啊，耶和华既然阻止你亲手报仇，取流血的罪，所以我指着永生的耶和华、又敢在你面前起誓说：『愿你的仇敌和谋害你的人都像拿八一样。』
25.en: Now therefore, my lord, as the LORD lives and as your soul lives, since the LORD has withheld you from blood guiltiness and from avenging yourself with your own hand, now therefore let your enemies and those who seek evil to my lord be as Nabal.

25.zh: 如今求你将婢女送来的礼物给跟随你的仆人。
25.en: Now this present which your servant has brought to my lord, let it be given to the young men who follow my lord.

25.zh: 求你饶恕婢女的罪过。耶和华必为我主建立坚固的家，因我主为耶和华争战；并且在你平生的日子查不出有什么过来。
25.en: Please forgive the trespass of your servant. For the LORD will certainly make my lord a sure house, because my lord fights the LORD’s battles. Evil will not be found in you all your days.

25.zh: 虽有人起来追逼你，寻索你的性命，你的性命却在耶和华—你的　神那里蒙保护，如包裹宝器一样；你仇敌的性命，耶和华必抛去，如用机弦甩石一样。
25.en: Though men may rise up to pursue you and to seek your soul, yet the soul of my lord will be bound in the bundle of life with the LORD your God. He will sling out the souls of your enemies as from a sling’s pocket.

25.zh: 我主现在若不亲手报仇流无辜人的血，到了耶和华照所应许你的话赐福与你，立你作以色列的王，那时我主必不至心里不安，觉得良心有亏。耶和华赐福与我主的时候，求你记念婢女。」
25.en: It will come to pass, when the LORD has done to my lord according to all the good that he has spoken concerning you, and has appointed you prince over Israel,

that this shall be no grief to you, nor offense of heart to my lord, either that you have shed blood without cause, or that my lord has avenged himself. When the LORD has dealt well with my lord, then remember your servant.”

25.zh: 大卫对亚比该说：「耶和华—以色列的　神是应当称颂的，因为他今日使你来迎接我。
25.en: David said to Abigail, “Blessed is the LORD, the God of Israel, who sent you today to meet me!

25.zh: 你和你的见识也当称赞；因为你今日拦阻我亲手报仇、流人的血。
25.en: Blessed is your discretion, and blessed are you, who have kept me today from blood guiltiness, and from avenging myself with my own hand.

25.zh: 我指着阻止我加害于你的耶和华—以色列永生的　神起誓，你若不速速地来迎接我，到明日早晨，凡属拿八的男丁必定不留一个。」
25.en: For indeed, as the LORD the God of Israel lives, who has withheld me from harming you, unless you had hurried and come to meet me, surely there wouldn’t have been left to Nabal by the morning light so much as one who urinates on a wall.”

25.zh: 大卫受了亚比该送来的礼物，就对她说：「我听了你的话，准了你的情面，你可以平平安安地回家吧！」
25.en: So David received from her hand that which she had brought him. Then he said to her, “Go up in peace to your house. Behold, I have listened to your voice and have granted your request.”

25.zh: 亚比该到拿八那里，见他在家里设摆筵席，如同王的筵席；拿八快乐大醉。亚比该无论大小事都没有告诉他，就等到次日早晨。
25.en: Abigail came to Nabal; and behold, he held a feast in his house like the feast of a king. Nabal’s heart was merry within him, for he was very drunk. Therefore she told him nothing until the morning light.

25.zh: 到了早晨，拿八醒了酒，他的妻将这些事都告诉他，他就魂不附体，身僵如石头一般。
25.en: In the morning, when the wine had gone out of Nabal, his wife told him these things; and his heart died within him, and he became as a stone.

25.zh: 过了十天，耶和华击打拿八，他就死了。
25.en: About ten days later, the LORD struck Nabal, so that he died.

25.zh: 大卫听见拿八死了，就说：「应当称颂耶和华，因他伸了拿八羞辱我的冤，又阻止仆人行恶；也使拿八的恶归到拿八的头上。」于是大卫打发人去，与亚比该说，要娶她为妻。
25.en: When David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, “Blessed is the LORD, who has pleaded the cause of my reproach from the hand of Nabal, and has kept back his servant from evil. The LORD has returned the evildoing of Nabal on his own head.” David sent and spoke concerning Abigail, to take her to himself as wife.

25.zh: 大卫的仆人到了迦密见亚比该，对她说：「大卫打发我们来见你，想要娶你为妻。」
25.en: When David’s servants had come to Abigail to Carmel, they spoke to her, saying, “David has sent us to you, to take you to him as wife.”

25.zh: 亚比该就起来，俯伏在地，说：「我情愿作婢女，洗我主仆人的脚。」
25.en: She arose and bowed herself with her face to the earth, and said, “Behold, your servant is a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord.”

25.zh: 亚比该立刻起身，骑上驴，带着五个使女，跟从大卫的使者去了，就作了大卫的妻。
25.en: Abigail hurriedly arose and rode on a donkey with her five maids who followed her; and she went after the messengers of David, and became his wife.

25.zh: 大卫先娶了耶斯列人亚希暖，她们二人都作了他的妻。
25.en: David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel; and they both became his wives.

25.zh: 扫罗已将他的女儿米甲，就是大卫的妻，给了迦琳人拉亿的儿子帕提为妻。
25.en: Now Saul had given Michal his daughter, David’s wife, to Palti the son of Laish, who was of Gallim.

26.zh: 西弗人到基比亚见扫罗，说：「大卫不是在旷野前的哈基拉山藏着吗？」
26.en: The Ziphites came to Saul to Gibeah, saying, “Doesn’t David hide himself in the hill of Hachilah, which is before the desert?”

26.zh: 扫罗就起身，带领以色列人中挑选的三千精兵下到西弗的旷野，要在那里寻索大卫。
26.en: Then Saul arose and went down to the wilderness of Ziph, having three thousand chosen men of Israel with him, to seek David in the wilderness of Ziph.

26.zh: 扫罗在旷野前的哈基拉山，在道路上安营。大卫住在旷野，听说扫罗到旷野来追寻他，
26.en: Saul encamped in the hill of Hachilah, which is before the desert, by the way. But David stayed in the wilderness, and he saw that Saul came after him into the wilderness.

26.zh: 就打发人去探听，便知道扫罗果然来到。
26.en: David therefore sent out spies, and understood that Saul had certainly come.

26.zh: 大卫起来，到扫罗安营的地方，看见扫罗和他的元帅尼珥的儿子押尼珥睡卧之处；扫罗睡在辎重营里，百姓安营在他周围。
26.en: Then David arose and came to the place where Saul had encamped; and David saw the place where Saul lay, with Abner the son of Ner, the captain of his army. Saul lay within the place of the wagons, and the people were encamped around him.

26.zh: 大卫对赫人亚希米勒和洗鲁雅的儿子约押的兄弟亚比筛说：「谁同我下到扫罗营里去？」亚比筛说：「我同你下去。」
26.en: Then David answered and said to Ahimelech the Hittite, and to Abishai the son of Zeruiah, brother of Joab, saying, “Who will go down with me to Saul to the camp?” Abishai said, “I will go down with you.”

26.zh: 于是大卫和亚比筛夜间到了百姓那里，见扫罗睡在辎重营里；他的枪在头旁，插在地上。押尼珥和百姓睡在他周围。
26.en: So David and Abishai came to the people by night; and, behold, Saul lay sleeping within the place of the wagons, with his spear stuck in the ground at his head; and Abner and the people lay around him.

26.zh: 亚比筛对大卫说：「现在　神将你的仇敌交在你手里，求你容我拿枪将他刺透在地，一刺就成，不用再刺。」
26.en: Then Abishai said to David, “God has delivered up your enemy into your hand today. Now therefore please let me strike him with the spear to the earth at one stroke, and I will not strike him the second time.”

26.zh: 大卫对亚比筛说：「不可害死他。有谁伸手害耶和华的受膏者而无罪呢？」
26.en: David said to Abishai, “Don’t destroy him, for who can stretch out his hand against the LORD’s anointed, and be guiltless?”

26.zh: 大卫又说：「我指着永生的耶和华起誓，他或被耶和华击打，或是死期到了，或是出战阵亡；
26.en: David said, “As the LORD lives, the LORD will strike him; or his day shall come to die, or he shall go down into battle and perish.

26.zh: 我在耶和华面前，万不敢伸手害耶和华的受膏者。现在你可以将他头旁的枪和水瓶拿来，我们就走。」
26.en: The LORD forbid that I should stretch out my hand against the LORD’s anointed; but now please take the spear that is at his head and the jar of water, and let’s go.”

26.zh: 大卫从扫罗的头旁拿了枪和水瓶，二人就走了，没有人看见，没有人知道，也没有人醒起，都睡着了，因为耶和华使他们沉沉地睡了。
26.en: So David took the spear and the jar of water from Saul’s head, and they went away. No man saw it, or knew it, nor did any awake; for they were all asleep, because a deep sleep from the LORD had fallen on them.

26.zh: 大卫过到那边去，远远地站在山顶上，与他们相离甚远。
26.en: Then David went over to the other side, and stood on the top of the mountain far away, a great space being between them;

26.zh: 大卫呼叫百姓和尼珥的儿子押尼珥说：「押尼珥啊，你为何不答应呢？」押尼珥说：「你是谁？竟敢呼叫王呢？」
26.en: and David cried to the people, and to Abner the son of Ner, saying, “Don’t you answer, Abner?” Then Abner answered, “Who are you who calls to the king?”

26.zh: 大卫对押尼珥说：「你不是个勇士吗？以色列中谁能比你呢？民中有人进来要害死王—你的主，你为何没有保护王—你的主呢？
26.en: David said to Abner, “Aren’t you a man? Who is like you in Israel? Why then have you not kept watch over your lord the king? For one of the people came in to destroy your lord the king.

26.zh: 你这样是不好的！我指着永生的耶和华起誓，你们都是该死的；因为没有保护你们的主，就是耶和华的受膏者。现在你看看王头旁的枪和水瓶在哪里。」
26.en: This thing isn’t good that you have done. As the LORD lives, you are worthy to die, because you have not kept watch over your lord, the LORD’s anointed. Now see where the king’s spear is, and the jar of water that was at his head.”

26.zh: 扫罗听出是大卫的声音，就说：「我儿大卫，这是你的声音吗？」大卫说：「主—我的王啊，是我的声音」；
26.en: Saul recognized David’s voice, and said, “Is this your voice, my son David?” David said, “It is my voice, my lord, O king.”

26.zh: 又说：「我做了什么？我手里有什么恶事？我主竟追赶仆人呢？
26.en: He said, “Why does my lord pursue his servant? For what have I done? What evil is in my hand?

26.zh: 求我主我王听仆人的话：若是耶和华激发你攻击我，愿耶和华收纳祭物；若是人激发你，愿他在耶和华面前受咒诅；因为他现今赶逐我，不容我在耶和华的产业上有分，说：『你去事奉别神吧！』
26.en: Now therefore, please let my lord the king hear the words of his servant. If it is so that the LORD has stirred you up against me, let him accept an offering. But if it is the children of men, they are cursed before the LORD; for they have driven me out today that I shouldn’t cling to the LORD’s inheritance, saying, ‘Go, serve other gods!’

26.zh: 现在求王不要使我的血流在离耶和华远的地方。以色列王出来是寻找一个虼蚤，如同人在山上猎取一个鹧鸪一般。」
26.en: Now therefore, don’t let my blood fall to the earth away from the presence of the LORD; for the king of Israel has come out to seek a flea, as when one hunts a partridge in the mountains.”

26.zh: 扫罗说：「我有罪了！我儿大卫，你可以回来，因你今日看我的性命为宝贵；我必不再加害于你。我是糊涂人，大大错了。」
26.en: Then Saul said, “I have sinned. Return, my son David; for I will no more do you harm, because my life was precious in your eyes today. Behold, I have played the fool, and have erred exceedingly.”

26.zh: 大卫说：「王的枪在这里，可以吩咐一个仆人过来拿去。
26.en: David answered, “Behold the spear, O king! Let one of the young men come over and get it.

26.zh: 今日耶和华将王交在我手里，我却不肯伸手害耶和华的受膏者。耶和华必照各人的公义诚实报应他。
26.en: The LORD will give to every man his righteousness and his faithfulness; because the LORD delivered you into my hand today, and I wouldn’t stretch out my hand against the LORD’s anointed.

26.zh: 我今日重看你的性命，愿耶和华也重看我的性命，并且拯救我脱离一切患难。」
26.en: Behold, as your life was respected today in my eyes, so let my life be respected in the LORD’s eyes, and let him deliver me out of all oppression.”

26.zh: 扫罗对大卫说：「我儿大卫，愿你得福！你必做大事，也必得胜。」于是大卫起行，扫罗回他的本处去了。
26.en: Then Saul said to David, “You are blessed, my son David. You will both do mightily, and will surely prevail.” So David went his way, and Saul returned to his place.

27.zh: 大卫心里说：「必有一日我死在扫罗手里，不如逃奔非利士地去。扫罗见我不在以色列的境内，就必绝望，不再寻索我；这样我可以脱离他的手。」
27.en: David said in his heart, “I will now perish one day by the hand of Saul. There is nothing better for me than that I should escape into the land of the Philistines; and Saul will despair of me, to seek me any more in all the borders of Israel. So I will escape out of his hand.”

27.zh: 于是大卫起身，和跟随他的六百人投奔迦特王—玛俄的儿子亚吉去了。
27.en: David arose and passed over, he and the six hundred men who were with him, to Achish the son of Maoch, king of Gath.

27.zh: 大卫和他的两个妻，就是耶斯列人亚希暖和作过拿八妻的迦密人亚比该，并跟随他的人，连各人的眷属，都住在迦特的亚吉那里。
27.en: David lived with Achish at Gath, he and his men, every man with his household, even David with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess and Abigail the Carmelitess, Nabal’s wife.

27.zh: 有人告诉扫罗说：「大卫逃到迦特。」扫罗就不再寻索他了。
27.en: Saul was told that David had fled to Gath, so he stopped looking for him.

27.zh: 大卫对亚吉说：「我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你在京外的城邑中赐我一个地方居住。仆人何必与王同住京都呢？」
27.en: David said to Achish, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, let them give me a place in one of the cities in the country, that I may dwell there. For why should your servant dwell in the royal city with you?”

27.zh: 当日亚吉将洗革拉赐给他，因此洗革拉属犹大王，直到今日。
27.en: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day: therefore Ziklag belongs to the kings of Judah to this day.

27.zh: 大卫在非利士地住了一年零四个月。
27.en: The number of the days that David lived in the country of the Philistines was a full year and four months.

27.zh: 大卫和跟随他的人上去，侵夺基述人、基色人、亚玛力人之地。这几族历来住在那地，从书珥直到埃及。
27.en: David and his men went up and raided the Geshurites, the Girzites, and the Amalekites; for those were the inhabitants of the land who were of old, on the way to Shur, even to the land of Egypt.

27.zh: 大卫击杀那地的人，无论男女都没有留下一个，又夺获牛、羊、骆驼、驴，并衣服，回来见亚吉。
27.en: David struck the land, and saved no man or woman alive, and took away the sheep, the cattle, the donkeys, the camels, and the clothing. Then he returned, and came to Achish.

27.zh: 亚吉说：「你们今日侵夺了什么地方呢？」大卫说：「侵夺了犹大的南方、耶拉篾的南方、基尼的南方。」
27.en: Achish said, “Against whom have you made a raid today?” David said, “Against the South of Judah, against the South of the Jerahmeelites, and against the South of the Kenites.”

27.zh: 无论男女，大卫没有留下一个带到迦特来。他说：「恐怕他们将我们的事告诉人，说大卫住在非利士地的时候常常这样行。」
27.en: David saved neither man nor woman alive to bring them to Gath, saying, “Lest they should tell about us, saying, ‘David did this, and this has been his way all the time he has lived in the country of the Philistines.’”

27.zh: 亚吉信了大卫，心里说：「大卫使本族以色列人憎恶他，所以他必永远作我的仆人了。」
27.en: Achish believed David, saying, “He has made his people Israel utterly to abhor him. Therefore he will be my servant forever.”

28.zh: 那时，非利士人聚集军旅，要与以色列人打仗。亚吉对大卫说：「你当知道，你和跟随你的人都要随我出战。」
28.en: In those days, the Philistines gathered their armies together for warfare, to fight with Israel. Achish said to David, “Know assuredly that you will go out with me in the army, you and your men.”

28.zh: 大卫对亚吉说：「仆人所能做的事，王必知道。」亚吉对大卫说：「这样，我立你永远作我的护卫长。」
28.en: David said to Achish, “Therefore you will know what your servant can do.” Achish said to David, “Therefore I will make you my bodyguard forever.”

28.zh: 那时撒母耳已经死了，以色列众人为他哀哭，葬他在拉玛，就是在他本城里。扫罗曾在国内不容有交鬼的和行巫术的人。
28.en: Now Samuel was dead, and all Israel had mourned for him and buried him in Ramah, even in his own city. Saul had sent away those who had familiar spirits and the wizards out of the land.

28.zh: 非利士人聚集，来到书念安营；扫罗聚集以色列众人在基利波安营。
28.en: The Philistines gathered themselves together, and came and encamped in Shunem; and Saul gathered all Israel together, and they encamped in Gilboa.

28.zh: 扫罗看见非利士的军旅就惧怕，心中发颤。
28.en: When Saul saw the army of the Philistines, he was afraid, and his heart trembled greatly.

28.zh: 扫罗求问耶和华，耶和华却不借梦，或乌陵，或先知回答他。
28.en: When Saul inquired of the LORD, the LORD didn’t answer him by dreams, by Urim, or by prophets.

28.zh: 扫罗吩咐臣仆说：「当为我找一个交鬼的妇人，我好去问她。」臣仆说：「在隐·多珥有一个交鬼的妇人。」
28.en: Then Saul said to his servants, “Seek for me a woman who has a familiar spirit, that I may go to her and inquire of her.” His servants said to him, “Behold, there is a woman who has a familiar spirit at Endor.”

28.zh: 于是扫罗改了装，穿上别的衣服，带着两个人，夜里去见那妇人。扫罗说：「求你用交鬼的法术，将我所告诉你的死人，为我招上来。」
28.en: Saul disguised himself and put on other clothing, and went, he and two men with him, and they came to the woman by night. Then he said, “Please consult for me by the familiar spirit, and bring me up whomever I shall name to you.”

28.zh: 妇人对他说：「你知道扫罗从国中剪除交鬼的和行巫术的。你为何陷害我的性命，使我死呢？」
28.en: The woman said to him, “Behold, you know what Saul has done, how he has cut off those who have familiar spirits and the wizards out of the land. Why then do you lay a snare for my life, to cause me to die?”

28.zh: 扫罗向妇人指着耶和华起誓说：「我指着永生的耶和华起誓，你必不因这事受刑。」
28.en: Saul swore to her by the LORD, saying, “As the LORD lives, no punishment will happen to you for this thing.”

28.zh: 妇人说：「我为你招谁上来呢？」回答说：「为我招撒母耳上来。」
28.en: Then the woman said, “Whom shall I bring up to you?” He said, “Bring Samuel up for me.”

28.zh: 妇人看见撒母耳，就大声呼叫，对扫罗说：「你是扫罗，为什么欺哄我呢？」
28.en: When the woman saw Samuel, she cried with a loud voice; and the woman spoke to Saul, saying, “Why have you deceived me? For you are Saul!”

28.zh: 王对妇人说：「不要惧怕，你看见了什么呢？」妇人对扫罗说：「我看见有神从地里上来。」
28.en: The king said to her, “Don’t be afraid! What do you see?” The woman said to Saul, “I see a god coming up out of the earth.”

28.zh: 扫罗说：「他是怎样的形状？」妇人说：「有一个老人上来，身穿长衣。」扫罗知道是撒母耳，就屈身，脸伏于地下拜。
28.en: He said to her, “What does he look like?” She said, “An old man comes up. He is covered with a robe.” Saul perceived that it was Samuel, and he bowed with his face to the ground, and showed respect.

28.zh: 撒母耳对扫罗说：「你为什么搅扰我，招我上来呢？」扫罗回答说：「我甚窘急；因为非利士人攻击我，　神也离开我，不再借先知或梦回答我。因此请你上来，好指示我应当怎样行。」
28.en: Samuel said to Saul, “Why have you disturbed me, to bring me up?” Saul answered, “I am very distressed; for the Philistines make war against me, and God has departed from me, and answers me no more, by prophets, or by dreams. Therefore I have called you, that you may make known to me what I shall do.”

28.zh: 撒母耳说：「耶和华已经离开你，且与你为敌，你何必问我呢？
28.en: Samuel said, “Why then do you ask me, since the LORD has departed from you and has become your adversary?

28.zh: 耶和华照他借我说的话，已经从你手里夺去国权，赐与别人，就是大卫。
28.en: The LORD has done to you as he spoke by me. The LORD has torn the kingdom out of your hand and given it to your neighbor, even to David.

28.zh: 因你没有听从耶和华的命令；他恼怒亚玛力人，你没有灭绝他们，所以今日耶和华向你这样行，
28.en: Because you didn’t obey the LORD’s voice, and didn’t execute his fierce wrath on Amalek, therefore the LORD has done this thing to you today.

28.zh: 并且耶和华必将你和以色列人交在非利士人的手里。明日你和你众子必与我在一处了；耶和华必将以色列的军兵交在非利士人手里。」
28.en: Moreover the LORD will deliver Israel also with you into the hand of the Philistines; and tomorrow you and your sons will be with me. The LORD will deliver the army of Israel also into the hand of the Philistines.”

28.zh: 扫罗猛然仆倒，挺身在地，因撒母耳的话甚是惧怕；那一昼一夜，没有吃什么，就毫无气力。
28.en: Then Saul fell immediately his full length on the earth, and was terrified, because of Samuel’s words. There was no strength in him, for he had eaten no bread all day long or all night long.

28.zh: 妇人到扫罗面前，见他极其惊恐，对他说：「婢女听从你的话，不顾惜自己的性命，遵从你所吩咐的。
28.en: The woman came to Saul and saw that he was very troubled, and said to him, “Behold, your servant has listened to your voice, and I have put my life in my hand, and have listened to your words which you spoke to me.

28.zh: 现在求你听婢女的话，容我在你面前摆上一点食物，你吃了，可以有气力行路。」
28.en: Now therefore, please listen also to the voice of your servant, and let me set a morsel of bread before you. Eat, that you may have strength when you go on your way.”

28.zh: 扫罗不肯，说：「我不吃。」但他的仆人和妇人再三劝他，他才听了他们的话，从地上起来，坐在床上。
28.en: But he refused, and said, “I will not eat.” But his servants, together with the woman, constrained him; and he listened to their voice. So he arose from the earth and sat on the bed.

28.zh: 妇人急忙将家里的一只肥牛犊宰了，又拿面抟成无酵饼烤了，
28.en: The woman had a fattened calf in the house. She hurried and killed it; and she took flour and kneaded it, and baked unleavened bread of it.

28.zh: 摆在扫罗和他仆人面前。他们吃完，当夜就起身走了。
28.en: She brought it before Saul and before his servants, and they ate. Then they rose up and went away that night.

29.zh: 非利士人将他们的军旅聚到亚弗；以色列人在耶斯列的泉旁安营。
29.en: Now the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek; and the Israelites encamped by the spring which is in Jezreel.

29.zh: 非利士人的首领各率军队，或百或千，挨次前进；大卫和跟随他的人同着亚吉跟在后边。
29.en: The lords of the Philistines passed on by hundreds and by thousands; and David and his men passed on in the rear with Achish.

29.zh: 非利士人的首领说：「这些希伯来人[在这里]做什么呢？」亚吉对他们说：「这不是以色列王扫罗的臣子大卫吗？他在我这里有些年日了。自从他投降我直到今日，我未曾见他有过错。」
29.en: Then the princes of the Philistines said, “What about these Hebrews?” Achish said to the princes of the Philistines, “Isn’t this David, the servant of Saul the king of Israel, who has been with me these days, or rather these years? I have found no fault in him since he fell away until today.”

29.zh: 非利士人的首领向亚吉发怒，对他说：「你要叫这人回你所安置他的地方，不可叫他同我们出战，恐怕他在阵上反为我们的敌人。他用什么与他主人复和呢？岂不是用我们这些人的首级吗？
29.en: But the princes of the Philistines were angry with him; and the princes of the Philistines said to him, “Make the man return, that he may go back to his place where you have appointed him, and let him not go down with us to battle, lest in the battle he become an adversary to us. For with what should this fellow reconcile himself to his lord? Should it not be with the heads of these men?

29.zh: 从前以色列的妇女跳舞唱和说：『扫罗杀死千千，大卫杀死万万』，所说的不是这个大卫吗？」
29.en: Isn’t this David, of whom people sang to one another in dances, saying, ‘Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands’?”

29.zh: 亚吉叫大卫来，对他说：「我指着永生的耶和华起誓，你是正直人。你随我在军中出入，我看你甚好。自从你投奔我到如今，我未曾见你有什么过失；只是众首领不喜悦你。
29.en: Then Achish called David and said to him, “As the LORD lives, you have been upright, and your going out and your coming in with me in the army is good in my sight; for I have not found evil in you since the day of your coming to me to this day. Nevertheless, the lords don’t favor you.

29.zh: 现在你可以平平安安地回去，免得非利士人的首领不欢喜你。」
29.en: Therefore now return, and go in peace, that you not displease the lords of the Philistines.”

29.zh: 大卫对亚吉说：「我做了什么呢？自从仆人到你面前，直到今日，你查出我有什么过错，使我不去攻击主—我王的仇敌呢？」
29.en: David said to Achish, “But what have I done? What have you found in your servant so long as I have been before you to this day, that I may not go and fight against the enemies of my lord the king?”

29.zh: 亚吉说：「我知道你在我眼前是好人，如同　神的使者一般；只是非利士人的首领说：『这人不可同我们出战。』
29.en: Achish answered David, “I know that you are good in my sight, as an angel of God. Notwithstanding, the princes of the Philistines have said, ‘He shall not go up with us to the battle.’

29.zh: 故此你和跟随你的人，就是你本主的仆人，要明日早晨起来，等到天亮回去吧！」
29.en: Therefore now rise up early in the morning with the servants of your lord who have come with you; and as soon as you are up early in the morning and have light, depart.”

29.zh: 于是大卫和跟随他的人早晨起来，回往非利士地去。非利士人也上耶斯列去了。
29.en: So David rose up early, he and his men, to depart in the morning, to return into the land of the Philistines; and the Philistines went up to Jezreel.

30.zh: 第三日，大卫和跟随他的人到了洗革拉。亚玛力人已经侵夺南地，攻破洗革拉，用火焚烧，
