30.en: When David and his men had come to Ziklag on the third day, the Amalekites had made a raid on the South and on Ziklag, and had struck Ziklag and burned it with fire,

30.zh: 掳了城内的妇女和其中的大小人口，却没有杀一个，都带着走了。
30.en: and had taken captive the women and all who were in it, both small and great. They didn’t kill any, but carried them off and went their way.

30.zh: 大卫和跟随他的人到了那城，不料，城已烧毁，他们的妻子儿女都被掳去了。
30.en: When David and his men came to the city, behold, it was burned with fire; and their wives, their sons, and their daughters were taken captive.

30.zh: 大卫和跟随他的人就放声大哭，直哭得没有气力。
30.en: Then David and the people who were with him lifted up their voice and wept until they had no more power to weep.

30.zh: 大卫的两个妻—耶斯列人亚希暖和作过拿八妻的迦密人亚比该，也被掳去了。
30.en: David’s two wives were taken captive, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.

30.zh: 大卫甚是焦急，因众人为自己的儿女苦恼，说：「要用石头打死他。」大卫却倚靠耶和华—他的　神，心里坚固。
30.en: David was greatly distressed, for the people spoke of stoning him, because the souls of all the people were grieved, every man for his sons and for his daughters; but David strengthened himself in the LORD his God.

30.zh: 大卫对亚希米勒的儿子祭司亚比亚他说：「请你将以弗得拿过来。」亚比亚他就将以弗得拿到大卫面前。
30.en: David said to Abiathar the priest, the son of Ahimelech, “Please bring the ephod here to me.” Abiathar brought the ephod to David.

30.zh: 大卫求问耶和华说：「我追赶敌军，追得上追不上呢？」耶和华说：「你可以追，必追得上，都救得回来。」
30.en: David inquired of the LORD, saying, “If I pursue after this troop, will I overtake them?” He answered him, “Pursue, for you will surely overtake them, and will without fail recover all.”

30.zh: 于是，大卫和跟随他的六百人来到比梭溪；有不能前去的就留在那里。
30.en: So David went, he and the six hundred men who were with him, and came to the brook Besor, where those who were left behind stayed.

30.zh: 大卫却带着四百人往前追赶，有二百人疲乏，不能过比梭溪，所以留在那里。
30.en: But David pursued, he and four hundred men; for two hundred stayed behind, who were so faint that they couldn’t go over the brook Besor.

30.zh: 这四百人在田野遇见一个埃及人，就带他到大卫面前，给他饼吃，给他水喝，
30.en: They found an Egyptian in the field, and brought him to David, and gave him bread, and he ate; and they gave him water to drink.

30.zh: 又给他一块无花果饼，两个葡萄饼。他吃了，就精神复原；因为他三日三夜没有吃饼，没有喝水。
30.en: They gave him a piece of a cake of figs and two clusters of raisins. When he had eaten, his spirit came again to him; for he had eaten no bread, and drank no water for three days and three nights.

30.zh: 大卫问他说：「你是属谁的？你是哪里的人？」他回答说：「我是埃及的少年人，是亚玛力人的奴仆；因我三日前患病，我主人就把我撇弃了。
30.en: David asked him, “To whom do you belong? Where are you from?” He said, “I am a young man of Egypt, servant to an Amalekite; and my master left me, because three days ago I got sick.

30.zh: 我们侵夺了基利提的南方和属犹大的地，并迦勒地的南方，又用火烧了洗革拉。」
30.en: We made a raid on the South of the Cherethites, and on that which belongs to Judah, and on the South of Caleb; and we burned Ziklag with fire.”

30.zh: 大卫问他说：「你肯领我们到敌军那里不肯？」他回答说：「你要向我指着　神起誓，不杀我，也不将我交在我主人手里，我就领你下到敌军那里。」
30.en: David said to him, “Will you bring me down to this troop?” He said, “Swear to me by God that you will not kill me and not deliver me up into the hands of my master, and I will bring you down to this troop.”

30.zh: 那人领大卫下去，见他们散在地上，吃喝跳舞，因为从非利士地和犹大地所掳来的财物甚多。
30.en: When he had brought him down, behold, they were spread around over all the ground, eating, drinking, and dancing, because of all the great plunder that they had taken out of the land of the Philistines, and out of the land of Judah.

30.zh: 大卫从黎明直到次日晚上，击杀他们，除了四百骑骆驼的少年人之外，没有一个逃脱的。
30.en: David struck them from the twilight even to the evening of the next day. Not a man of them escaped from there, except four hundred young men who rode on camels and fled.

30.zh: 亚玛力人所掳去的财物，大卫全都夺回，并救回他的两个妻来。
30.en: David recovered all that the Amalekites had taken, and David rescued his two wives.

30.zh: 凡亚玛力人所掳去的，无论大小、儿女、财物，大卫都夺回来，没有失落一个。
30.en: There was nothing lacking to them, neither small nor great, neither sons nor daughters, neither plunder, nor anything that they had taken. David brought them all back.

30.zh: 大卫所夺来的牛群羊群，跟随他的人赶在[原有的]群畜前边，说：「这是大卫的掠物。」
30.en: David took all the flocks and the herds, which they drove before those other livestock, and said, “This is David’s plunder.”

30.zh: 大卫到了那疲乏不能跟随、留在比梭溪的二百人那里。他们出来迎接大卫并跟随的人。大卫前来问他们安。
30.en: David came to the two hundred men, who were so faint that they could not follow David, whom also they had made to stay at the brook Besor; and they went out to meet David, and to meet the people who were with him. When David came near to the people, he greeted them.

30.zh: 跟随大卫人中的恶人和匪类说：「这些人既然没有和我们同去，我们所夺的财物就不分给他们，只将他们各人的妻子儿女给他们，使他们带去就是了。」
30.en: Then all the wicked men and worthless fellows of those who went with David answered and said, “Because they didn’t go with us, we will not give them anything of the plunder that we have recovered, except to every man his wife and his children, that he may lead them away and depart.”

30.zh: 大卫说：「弟兄们，耶和华所赐给我们的，不可不分给他们；因为他保佑我们，将那攻击我们的敌军交在我们手里。
30.en: Then David said, “Do not do so, my brothers, with that which the LORD has given to us, who has preserved us, and delivered the troop that came against us into our hand.

30.zh: 这事谁肯依从你们呢？上阵的得多少，看守器具的也得多少；应当大家平分。」
30.en: Who will listen to you in this matter? For as his share is who goes down to the battle, so shall his share be who stays with the baggage. They shall share alike.”

30.zh: 大卫定此为以色列的律例典章，从那日直到今日。
30.en: It was so from that day forward that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel to this day.

30.zh: 大卫到了洗革拉，从掠物中取些送给他朋友犹大的长老，说：「这是从耶和华仇敌那里夺来的，送你们为礼物。」
30.en: When David came to Ziklag, he sent some of the plunder to the elders of Judah, even to his friends, saying, “Behold, a present for you from the plunder of the LORD’s enemies.”

30.zh: 他送礼物给住伯特利的，南地拉末的，雅提珥的；
30.en: He sent it to those who were in Bethel, to those who were in Ramoth of the South, to those who were in Jattir,

30.zh: 住亚罗珥的，息末的，以实提莫的；
30.en: to those who were in Aroer, to those who were in Siphmoth, to those who were in Eshtemoa,

30.zh: 住拉哈勒的，耶拉篾各城的，基尼各城的；
30.en: to those who were in Racal, to those who were in the cities of the Jerahmeelites, to those who were in the cities of the Kenites,

30.zh: 住何珥玛的，歌拉珊的，亚挞的；
30.en: to those who were in Hormah, to those who were in Borashan, to those who were in Athach,

30.zh: 住希伯 的，并大卫和跟随他的人素来所到之处的人。
30.en: to those who were in Hebron, and to all the places where David himself and his men used to stay.

31.zh: 非利士人与以色列人争战。以色列人在非利士人面前逃跑，在基利波有被杀仆倒的。
31.en: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa.

31.zh: 非利士人紧追扫罗和他儿子们，就杀了扫罗的儿子约拿单、亚比拿达、麦基舒亚。
31.en: The Philistines overtook Saul and his sons; and the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.

31.zh: 势派甚大，扫罗被弓箭手追上，射伤甚重，
31.en: The battle went hard against Saul, and the archers overtook him; and he was greatly distressed by reason of the archers.

31.zh: 就吩咐拿他兵器的人说：「你拔出刀来，将我刺死，免得那些未受割礼的人来刺我，凌辱我。」但拿兵器的人甚惧怕，不肯刺他；扫罗就自己伏在刀上死了。
31.en: Then Saul said to his armor bearer, “Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and thrust me through and abuse me!” But his armor bearer would not, for he was terrified. Therefore Saul took his sword and fell on it.

31.zh: 拿兵器的人见扫罗已死，也伏在刀上死了。
31.en: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword, and died with him.

31.zh: 这样，扫罗和他三个儿子，与拿他兵器的人，以及跟随他的人，都一同死亡。
31.en: So Saul died with his three sons, his armor bearer, and all his men that same day together.

31.zh: 住平原那边并约旦河西的以色列人，见以色列军兵逃跑，扫罗和他儿子都死了，也就弃城逃跑。非利士人便来住在其中。
31.en: When the men of Israel who were on the other side of the valley, and those who were beyond the Jordan, saw that the men of Israel fled and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned the cities and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.

31.zh: 次日，非利士人来剥那被杀之人的衣服，看见扫罗和他三个儿子仆倒在基利波山，
31.en: On the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his three sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.

31.zh: 就割下他的首级，剥了他的军装，打发人到非利士地的四境，报信与他们庙里的偶像和众民；
31.en: They cut off his head, stripped off his armor, and sent into the land of the Philistines all around, to carry the news to the house of their idols and to the people.

31.zh: 又将扫罗的军装放在亚斯她录庙里，将他的尸身钉在伯·珊的城墙上。
31.en: They put his armor in the house of the Ashtaroth, and they fastened his body to the wall of Beth Shan.

31.zh: 基列·雅比的居民听见非利士人向扫罗所行的事，
31.en: When the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,

31.zh: 他们中间所有的勇士就起身，走了一夜，将扫罗和他儿子的尸身从伯·珊城墙上取下来，送到雅比那里，用火烧了；
31.en: all the valiant men arose, went all night, and took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Beth Shan; and they came to Jabesh and burned them there.

31.zh: 将他们骸骨葬在雅比的垂丝柳树下，就禁食七日。
31.en: They took their bones and buried them under the tamarisk tree in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
